articleTitle: An innovative classroom teaching technology assisted by artificial intelligence of things
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence of things (AIoT), as a technical product of the combination of artificial intelligence and the Internet of things (IoT), is the possibility of innovative education to change the classroom teaching patterns. In practice, the intelligent classroom supported by AIoT is represented by the real-time communication between IoT sensing equipment and intelligent system, which can be diagnosed and analyzed through typical classroom scenes such as cooperation and training during the teaching procedures. To looking back at the evolution of information technology that is applied in the classroom. Although practitioners continue to try to make attempts in technology-enhanced teaching, they have never been able to integrate advanced information technology with education and solve the essential problems of classroom teaching. Since the classroom teaching performance is the fundamental basis for accurately evaluating and diagnosing the teaching effect, intervening in the teaching process, adjusting the teaching mode, and improving the teaching ability. Constructing the AIoT-based teaching performance management system is one of the key directions to solve real classroom problems. It comprehensively constructs a data-driven intelligent system with the help of IoT devices, which captures the multi-modal classroom behavior data of teachers and students’ behaviors in real-time, and carries out feature extraction, data fusion, personalized modeling, and dynamic intervention around teaching problems. Through the practical test of the teaching effect, the AIoT-based classroom teaching management is proved as one kind of sound assistant teaching strategies for effectively monitoring the classroom teaching process and improving the behavior mode of teaching and learning.

articleTitle: Construction of specialized Laboratory of Information and Computing Science based on Big data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper mainly analyzes the feasibility of data mining technology in the application of information and computer science, and uses big data mining technology to promote the intelligent construction of information and computer science laboratory. Through the mining and analysis of large-scale data education information, it is of great significance to comprehensively understand information and the construction of computer science laboratory. In order to accelerate the process of laboratory digitalization, it is necessary to continuously integrate and optimize the teaching structure and teaching operating system, so as to further improve the data processing and analysis ability of information and computing science laboratory. At the same time, in the construction of information and computing science laboratory, experimental teaching as an important part of college teaching, there will be a large number of data types in the operation and use of the laboratory, and the use of data mining technology to obtain valuable data information as an important indicator of laboratory construction. At the same time, data mining technology provides powerful technical support for information and computing science laboratory. Data information processing is the process of standardizing the teaching data obtained in the previous step. Data formats obtained from experimental software platforms or other systems often cannot meet the requirements of mining, such as data missing or useless, the format conversion of original teaching data is carried out according to the standard requirements of data mining algorithm. This paper further promotes the integration and innovation of information computing science major through the application of data mining technology in big data science technology.

articleTitle: The Evaluation of a Blended Teaching Mode Based on an AI Language Learning Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper aims to evaluate a blended teaching mode based on an AI (artificial intelligence) Language Learning Platform. The platform utilizes mainstream digital technology and big data AI analysis. The researcher conducted a blended teaching mode in an experimental class and conventionally in a control class. At the end of the semester, the researcher compared the performance as well as students’ perception toward the course between the two classes. The results show that although there was no statistical difference between the scores of the two classes, students held a positive attitude toward the new mode based on the AI language learning platform.

articleTitle: The composition of VR system and the construction of VR teaching model in innovation and entrepreneurship education
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: VR mainly through modeling and coding to simulate the 3 D world, through VR technology can establish multi-dimensional platform, realize human-computer interaction, enable users can experience the virtual world, and to apply VR technology to innovation and entrepreneurship education field, is bound to study the composition of VR system, and the application of VR tools (MUD \ MOO), build VR technology simulation system and a teaching system based on VR technology. The basic VR technology system is made up of special simulation software and 3D models. The future application of VR technology is predicted that the application of VR technology has unlimited potential, which can bring opportunities for innovation and reform for all major fields.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Framework Study for Twitter Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Nowadays social media shows surging significance in our lives. Sentiment analysis emerged to automatically predict the sentiment expressed by the comments on platforms such as twitter and Weibo. In this paper, a number of classical machine-learning-based methods are introduced, discussed, and evaluated at first. Then, a deep-learning-based model for sentiment analysis is proposed. The main contribution consists of avoiding underfitting and overfitting, dropout, different layers exploration, and LSTM. In addition, a publicly available benchmark dataset is utilized for evaluation. Finally, variety of evaluation methods are used for the proposed model. The results show promising results against other classical machine learning models.

articleTitle: Application of Parallel Computing Thought in Training Model for Computer Talents
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Compared with serial computing, parallel computing can execute multiple instructions at a time, which can increase computing speed and expand the scale of solutions, thereby solving large and complex computing problems. The training of computer talents is also a complex system engineering. Therefore, we propose a parallel dual-system training model for computer talents with industry-education integration and quality-development. Different from general parallel computing, the model we proposed has both temporal and spatial parallelism. The temporal parallelism is reflected in the two system lines being carried out at the same time in the training process, while the spatial parallelism is reflected in the staggering of the two system lines in the same course. In industry-education integration system, we establish the cooperation between schools and enterprises in building a series of curriculums, including mobile application (MA), artificial intelligence (Al), cloud computing (CC), big data (BD), innovation and entrepreneurship (IES), internships at enterprises (IE), to effectively improve students’ technological foresight and mastery. Moreover, the quality-development system consists of the compulsory projects integrated with theoretical courses and the elective projects integrated with extracurricular practice, so as to improve students’ comprehensive quality. In this model, the credits of courses in industry-education system accounts for 37.5%, quality-development system accounts for 32.7%, and other courses account for 29.8%. Practical results show that by applying this talent training model, the counterpart employment rate of computer science graduates in 2021 has increased by 10%, and the number of postgraduate admissions has increased by 80%, compared with graduates in 2020, the number of professional competition awards has increased by 15%, compared with students in 2020.

articleTitle: Analysis of information security problems and countermeasures in big data management of colleges and universities under smart campus environment
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Based on the analysis of smart campus and big data related content, the relationship between smart campus and big data, combined with the information security problems in the big data governance of colleges and universities, including data transmission problems, data processing problems, information control problems, network security problems, equipment access problem. By studying and improving relevant laws and regulations, strengthening access control processing, improving system protection level, strengthening the integration of new technology, improving network intrusion detection system, doing a good job in identity security verification and other measures, the purpose is to improve the smart campus operation environment and improve the security of big data information.

articleTitle: Exploration on Teaching Reform of Material Mechanics in Vocational Colleges Based on Experimental Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper introduces the background of Run-through External Cultivation class, and analyzes teaching characteristics of material mechanics in the docking university Conestoga College. Combined with the questionnaire survey and aiming at the problem that complex formulas of material mechanics are difficult to understand, the solutions of "Using Life Cases to Assist Understanding (ULCAU)" and "Verification with Finite Element Model (VFEM)" are proposed. The teaching experiment results show that ULCAU/VFEM can help students understand formulas and improve students' interest in learning.

articleTitle: The Practice of Ideological and Political Construction of Management Communication Course Under The Background of Digital Information Teaching Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Building Morality and cultivating people is the fundamental task of education. Therefore, it is very important to scientifically integrate the elements of Ideological and political education into various courses. This paper makes an in-depth study on the organic combination strategy of Ideological and political construction of management communication course based on deep reinforcement learning, and designs a method and strategy for the construction of large-scale personalized education cluster intelligent platform.

articleTitle: Self-regulated Learning Model in SPOC of Blended Learning Based on Online Education Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the post-pandemic era, small private online course (SPOC) as one integrated teaching mode in blended learning has attracted more attention in the higher education. Although a growing number of online education platforms, even SPOC platforms, have been constructed, such as Chinese University MOOC, NetEase Cloud Classroom, Xuetang Online, Icourse, how to adopt these online platforms selectively and effectively in the SPOC is still worthwhile to explore. This study introduces the self-regulatory learning models and their intervention and effectiveness in the online learning. Then it analyses features of SPOC in terms of students, teachers and syllabus to illustrate the significance of include the learners’ self-regulated learning in SPOC and how to make use of technology facilities from different online education platform. Therefore, the SPOC self-regulated learning model can be proposed to provide optimal support for blended learning and improve effectiveness and efficiency of SPOC learning based on online education platform.

articleTitle: Automatic Classification of Government Texts Based on Improved CNN and Skip-gram Models
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of government texts with rich semantic information, the impact of convolutional neural network models on the classification and recognition of government text features is studied, and an optimization method to assist in the classification of official government information resources is proposed so that government staff can better investigate public opinion. Based on machine learning and deep learning theories, this paper conducts an experimental study on automatic classification and recognition of texts using convolutional neural network models and conducts a comprehensive comparative analysis from the perspective of information details and core topic sentences. After data cleaning, Word2Vec is used to construct a word vector matrix, and this information is integrated into the convolutional neural network model for comparison and optimization. And based on the use of a convolutional neural network based on the improved convolutional layer technology, combined with a Skip-gram word vector model, the text is converted into low-latitude feature vectors as the input of the improved convolutional neural network model to achieve the automatic classification of government texts. The experimental results show that the model of this study achieves 92.7% F1 mean and 93.4% ACC in the evaluation of automatic classification of government texts, which not only solves the problem of excessive dimensionality but also significantly improves the execution performance and classification accuracy compared with the traditional methods, and effectively solves the automatic classification of information contents and labels.

articleTitle: Applying Artificial Intelligence to Primary and Secondary School Physical Education
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The physical education curriculum reform has been fruitful since the founding of New China, however, the physical education curriculum reform has long neglected the combination with the latest technology and has not broken through the education approach based on physical education and health curriculum. Since the birth of artificial intelligence education, it has provided a solution to break through the limitation of distance and teachers’ resources, and the combination of artificial intelligence education and the physical education curriculum is an important direction to deepen the physical education curriculum reform. The simplified application of "human-computer learning symbiosis" breaks through the current dilemma of insufficient technological power and AI education theory, and helps the application of AI education in the physical education curriculum. It has the application advantages of human-oriented and personalized teaching; promoting the formation of lifelong sports concepts; cultivating higher-order thinking ability; and promoting the development of the sports industry.

articleTitle: How to Maximize the Advantages of Online-learning under the New Blended Teaching Mode for College English
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the era of information technology, college English should make good use of the advantages of online resources to promote the reform and development of college English teaching. This paper discusses how to use online teaching to promote blended teaching of college English based on constructivism theory. Online teaching has many advantages, such as richness, integration, high efficiency, autonomy, supervision and so on. But how to bring its advantages into full play depends on various factors, such as teachers, students, and network resource developers and so on. Our country should strengthen the construction of online courses and improve the development of teaching platforms. Teachers should learn to design the teaching contents reasonably before, during and after class. Students’ learning autonomy should be mobilized. Also, a perfect learning evaluation system for blended teaching is also needed. Only in this way can college English teaching develop better with the help of online teaching.

articleTitle: Exploration on Teaching of Material Mechanics in Higher Vocational Colleges Based on Expansion of Finite Element Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper expounds the background of Run-through External Cultivation class of vocational education, and introduces the characteristics of material mechanics course of Conestoga College, a foreign docking university. In order to expand the thinking of students in the external cultivation class and improve their ability to analyze and solve complex mechanical problems, the research team supplemented the finite element theory for the students in their spare time and introduced the working principle of ABAQUS software. Aiming at the problem of stress and deformation of special-shaped parts proposed by students, the finite element model was established and simulation calculation was carried out by a computer. The simulation results intuitively and clearly show the stress and strain of special-shaped parts, and solve the students’ doubts. The teaching feedback results show that the expansion of finite element theory based on mechanical analysis and the application of ABAQUS software have played an important role in the following three aspects: 1) expanding students’ vision (100%); 2) improving students’ interest in learning (100%); 3) improving the relationship between teachers and students (90.9%).

articleTitle: Research on Information Anxiety of College Students under the Background of Information Overloaded Based on Support Vector Machine Optimization Alogrithm
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of Internet technology, people have entered an era of continuous soaring knowledge and information. This era has brought infinite opportunities and challenges. People are exposed to a lot of information every day, such as the numerous information from Tic Toc and Weibo. However, the ability of receiving information of each person is limited. When the amount of received information exceeds his or her ability, information anxiety will arise. If things keep going like this, information anxiety will have a negative impact on the life and study of the college students. Meanwhile, Support Vector Machine (SVM) as one of the machine learning methods is of importance in statistical learning technology. Because of its high efficiency, good performance and wide applications in classification, forecasting, and estimation, the SVM has become the most recognized method in learning machines. Therefore, this paper applies the Support Vector Machine optimization algorithm in Matlab language to quantify the relationship between the amount of information received and degree of information anxiety, seeking to find a balance point to help students learn more efficient. Through the study of questionnaires, we find the three factors that cause college students information anxiety. We take these three as the independent variables, and the degree of information anxiety as the dependent variable. By the SVM alogrithm, the model between information anxiety, and the amount of information received is created. Then we can calculate the balance point. This paper also analyses the reaction of college students when they are exposed to a large amount of overloaded information, and the main behaviors of information anxiety. As for how to cope with the information anxiety, the redundant information is filtered through optimization algorithms model in order to provide students with effective information. College students can relief information anxiety through the three aspects of individual, school and society, so that they can actively deal with information overload and alleviate information anxiety.

Author Keywords: Support Vector Machine optimization algorithm optimization algorithms

articleTitle: A Study of Evaluation of Higher Education Healthy Development Based on the CIPP model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The higher education system reflects the comprehensive strength of a nation.Its health will determine the sustainable development of higher education . This paper analyzes the health and sustainable of the different nations’ system of higher education by CIPP model , mainly with the entropy method and the cluster analysis method and selected 18 indicators to rich the model. Then, the study apply the model to 42 nations with cluster analysis method to cluster the nations. Educational evaluation systems in these countries can be significantly divided into four categories.This paper is to design four phases to achieve a gradual step-by-step strategy for higher education reform and provides reference for the sustainable exhibition of higher education in similar nations.

articleTitle: Application of Virtual Reality Technology in English Interpretation Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Virtual reality technology can solve the dilemma of lack of real scenes in the teaching of College English interpretation. Based on this, this paper first introduces the constructivist learning theory and virtual reality technology; then, it constructs the interpretation teaching mode and teaching space based on virtual reality technology, which enables the virtual reality technology to energize the educational environment, improve the personalized learning experience, and make the teaching of College English interpretation conform to the needs of the information age, the artificial intelligence era and the 5G era.

articleTitle: BiEAF: An Bidirectional Enhanced Attention Flow Model for Question Answering Task
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Question answering is an crucial module to construct an intelligent chatbot. Traditional question answering system utilizes various of deep learning models to answer the queries requested by users. While BiDAF modelled the interaction between context and query for the first time, which is a milestone attempt in this domain. However, BiDAF only takes the correlation across the sentences into account, but the association within the sentence is not considered. In this paper, based on BiDAF, we present a novel method to both utilize the inter-and-intra sentence interaction by deploying the proposed enhanced attention-flow layer. The experimental results on SQUAD dataset show that our method outperforms the baseline models in terms of both EM and F1 evaluation metrics, which proves our model effectiveness.

articleTitle: Design of an VR-based Immersive Physics Experiment Teaching Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Virtual Reality (VR) is increasingly integrated with other industries since the 20th century, and VR is frequently applied in teaching. VR-based immersive virtual experiments provide a new possibility for the teaching of physics experiments in colleges. In this case, a VR-based physics experiment teaching platform was designed to guide and standardize the experimental procedure in a virtual process. Meanwhile, the platform offered experimenters a nearly real physics laboratory scene, by which the expense of experimental sites and test equipment was significantly reduced. The experiment data showed that the highly pragmatic platform provided excellent experiences.

articleTitle: Application of Big Data Technology in Curriculum Practice and Research Work
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the advancement of information technology, most of the current research work has no longer used the traditional written research methods, but turned to research on the Internet. Internet public opinion analysis based on big data analysis technology is gradually becoming the main data source for research work. Big data technology is aimed at a large number of Internet users, and can provide a large number of experimental samples and survey objects for ideological and political research work. Big data technology can collect data through sensors, logs, and crawlers, store data in the form of distributed storage, perform data calculations based on MapReduce, stream computing, graph computing and other computing models, and use various data mining and machine learning algorithms. Data analysis and big data technology can make ideological and political practice activities more space for development, and make up for the shortcomings of traditional research work. There are now a large number of various types of data on the Internet, which can accurately reflect the current ideological and political situation in society and bring inspiration to the practice of ideological and political courses. The practical research work of ideological and political courses should make good use of Internet resources and big data technology to improve the teaching quality of practical courses.

articleTitle: Adaptive Model for Forecasting Electricity Price Based on Wavelet-ARIMA
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Electricity price is the regulating lever of the power market. In order to improve the prediction accuracy, this study proposes an adaptive model for forecasting electricity price based on wavelet-ARIMA. The model decomposes the original electricity price sequence into approximate sequence and detail sequences by wavelet decomposition, then makes predictions for the decomposed sequences by using ARIMA model, finally reconstructs the predicted sequences to get the final predicted values. At the same time, the model automatically determines the differential number and orders of the model, which avoids the subjectivity of determining parameters manually. Compared with ARIMA model and wavelet-ARIMA model, the prediction accuracy of the proposed model is higher, which verifies the reliability of the model.

articleTitle: Using Machine Learning Method to Predict Stroke Risk
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: To prevent the potential incidence of the stroke and avoid any side effects which further leads to the stroke, it becomes essential to predict whether the individual is at high risk of stroke based on his/her basic information. Previously published most of the studies in stroke prediction used Cox proportional hazards model or other novel integrated models. These models are difficult for individuals who probably do not possess sufficient background knowledge to implement and use those models. Therefore, the main objective of the present study is to identify whether it is feasible to use traditional machine learning models, including logistic regression, K-Nearest Neighbor, and random forest in stroke prediction. Among these models, the random forest outperformed other two models by classifying the sample correctly from the test dataset into binary categories. Our approach proved that simple machine learning models, especially random forest model performed exceptionally well in stroke prediction. Moreover, the classical machine learning model can also be easily implemented compared to other integrated models for stroke prediction.

articleTitle: Application of Mobile Learning Software in College English Vocabulary Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the deep integration of information technology and education, mobile learning software has been more and more recognized by the majority of university teachers and students because it is not limited by space and time. Based on the mental representation and development process of English vocabulary acquisition, the paper discusses how learners, with the assistance of APP English learning software, realize the transition from the formal stage and L1 lemma mediation stage to L1-L2 integration of semantic, syntax, lexical and formal information. Finally, this paper proposes the strategies of mobile micro-learning teaching of college English vocabulary from three aspects: the transition from vocabulary recognition to in-depth vocabulary development, semantic network construction, chunk awareness, and chunk ability.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Second-hand Market Trading Platform in Campus Based on Web
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In recent years, with the application and popularization of internet technologies, people can make online shopping, online booking and online payment anytime, anywhere, which greatly facilitates people’s lives, saves time, and accelerates the pace of the times. Due to the convenience of online shopping, a group of young people like students may purchase a lot of things that they do not particularly need, which results in the idleness of items. Coupled with the lack of economic ability of students, buying a lot of new items can not afford. Based on this type of demand, a second-hand market has been created that can sell and purchase various idle items. The Second-hand Commodity Trading Platform of this project is a trading website designed for users and based on the C2C model. C2C is Customer to Customer, which means transactions between individuals and individuals. Taobao is using this model, each user can freely publish and purchase goods, has been achieved unimaginable success. The system is also designed and implemented using this model. Through this system, users can register and log in, quickly publish their own information on idle items, and also browse and purchase a variety of products by category, providing users with a fast and convenient online trading platform. The system is mainly used for teacher and student second-hand goods transactions, so that idle items can play their due value, and here you can get the satisfaction and cheap second-hand items you need. This has not only achieved social and economic health and environmental protection, but also promoted social progress.

articleTitle: Analysis of Advantages and Disadvantages of Fragmented Learning in the Era of Internet Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper first introduces the concept and characteristics of fragmented learning in the era of Internet big data, and then deeply analyzes the disadvantages and problems of fragmented learning. Fragmented learning has the advantages of being free from time and space constraints, rich learning resources, fast content updating and clear learning topics, but it also leads to weak links between knowledge, lack of teaching feedback links, interference with systematic learning and other shortcomings, mainly including learners’ difficulties in deep thinking, distraction, and difficulty in paying attention to the whole knowledge, serious entertainment tendency of knowledge content and so on, It also puts forward effective strategies to solve the cognitive problems of fragmented learning: using knowledge visualization tools to manage fragmented knowledge, improve metacognitive ability, correct distraction, provide practical content and reduce entertainment tendency.

articleTitle: Research and application of artificial intelligence in law
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, artificial intelligence is more and more widely used, and artificial intelligence technology can be seen everywhere in people’s life. The combination of artificial intelligence and law has become a hot topic in recent years. Artificial intelligence technology can provide judges with objective, factual and statistical data to help judges better hear cases. Based on a large number of factual civil judgment theories, the computer can extract the features, construct the knowledge map, and realize the in-depth learning of the artificial neural network. The fitting of the artificial neural network to various discretionary factors can meet the needs of the complexity of discretionary factors. Moreover, the artificial neural network can select the implicit maturity and the number of neurons in the discretion factors, realize knowledge transformation by defining matching rules, and learn big data on the basis of classification rules. These advantages of artificial intelligence can help judge cases. As long as artificial intelligence technology can be applied properly, our legal system can be improved.

articleTitle: Artificial intelligence application of virtual reality technology in digital media art creation
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The artistic creation of digital media in the new era needs to further expand its information capacity and realize diversified functions on the basis of traditional forms of expression such as graphics, audio and video, so higher requirements for technical means are put forward. With the development of artificial intelligence technology in China, virtual reality technology plays an increasingly important role in digital media art creation. Virtual reality technology in artificial intelligence has the characteristics of immersion, interaction and imagination, which can provide more abundant technical means for digital media art creation. This paper will analyze the virtual reality technology methods and technology application paths that are commonly used in digital media art creation at present.

articleTitle: Research on the Teaching Reform of Ideological and Political Education in College Mathematics Based on Information Technology Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The development of information technology and its wide application in the field of education have greatly changed the traditional mode of education. As far as higher mathematics ideological and political education is concerned, the process of integrating with informatization is relatively slow, and college mathematics teachers should further increase the research and application of the teaching mode of the informatization platform. This article uses new technology and information platform to innovate teaching methods, combined with case teaching, under a student-centered teaching model, and explores a solution to the current lack of ideological and political education awareness of teachers, students’ fear and resistance to knowledge, heavier psychology, knowledge teaching new approaches to problems such as lack of integration with value guidance and single teaching mode. Practice has proved that making full use of the information-based teaching platform can inspire students to tap the subjectivity of the ideological and political resources of mathematics courses in colleges and universities, maximize the education-oriented role of mathematics courses, and promote the overall development of students.

articleTitle: Speech Synthesis of Tibetan Amdo Dialect Based on Attention and Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper proposes a speech synthesis method of Tibetan Amdo Dialect based on an attention mechanism and Recurrent Neural Network(RNN). This paper mainly introduces the Sequence to Sequence structure with an attention mechanism. The advantages of this structure are it can receive the input of characters, and output the corresponding original spectrum- diagram, then finally directly generate speech by using the vocoder algorithm. In order to solve the problem of information overload and improve the efficiency and accuracy of task processing, an attention module is added between the encoder and the decoder to learn the alignment information from text sequence to Mel spectrum sequence, this can make full use of the information carried by the input sequence. Using the above structure and the synthetic corpus of Tibetan Amdo Dialect, we realize and explore the speech synthesis of syllables and phonemes in Tibetan Amdo Dialect. The experimental results show that the speech quality synthesized by this method is further improved compared with the traditional speech synthesis method.

articleTitle: Network Information Dissemination Model and Development Analysis under New Media Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: New media provides a foundation and platform for the dissemination of network information, and makes the dissemination of network information resources more convenient. However, the unhealthy content in the new media environment has a certain negative impact on the dissemination of network information. Therefore, the transmission model of network information should be updated to actively guide users to identify information resources in the new media environment and hence improve the usefulness of network information. In the dissemination of network information, we must grasp the direction and positioning of mainstream information to guide users to cultivate a positive outlook on life and values, and improve the dissemination effect of new media environment network information.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Analysis of English Teaching Effect based on Online and Offline Teaching Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The wide application and promotion of online and offline mixed teaching mode has led to changes in teaching concepts and teaching relations, such as changes in teaching and learning, teachers and students, offline classroom and online learning. Adjusting according to its changes to establish a scientific and effective teaching effect evaluation is an important measure to ensure the quality of online and offline mixed teaching. According to the characteristics of the course and the teaching practice, establish a comprehensive evaluation index, covering the whole process of online learning and offline classroom learning, pay attention to the record of the teaching process, and use the evaluation function of the teaching platform to feed back the teaching analysis in time, so as to ensure the teaching quality and effectively improve the learning effect of students.

articleTitle: Forgery Attack And Improvement on Certificateless Aggregate Signature Schemes As Cases In Courses For Ideological And Political Education Based on Vehicular Networking Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In Internet of Vehicles (IOV), there is a lot of information transmission. Security and efficiency on the authentication of vehicle identity and information are very important problems. Certificateless aggregate signature (CLAS) scheme can improve the computation and communication efficiency by aggregating n signature into one signature. In this paper, as cases, for Wang and Zhang’s CLAS scheme in IOV proposed recently, we present a forgery attack on their scheme and we show that their scheme cannot resist forgery attack from the adversary who can replace the public key of the vehicle. We also give a security analysis that Wei and Jiang’s attack on Hashimoto and Ogata’s CLAS scheme is not correct and the attack cannot success if two identities for the vehicles are different. So, these insecure cryptographic schemes or security technologies cannot be applied in practice and it is important to integrate courses for ideological and political education on cryptography or network security into the postgraduate or undergraduate curriculum system. As an improvement, finally we also present an improved scheme and extend Wang and Zhang’s CLAS scheme with good efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Association Rule Model of Humanistic Care in Ideological and Political Education of College Students
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Humanistic care is the essential appeal of ideological and political education in colleges and universities. This paper analyzes some problems existing in the humanistic care of ideological and political education of college students: first, the tendency of educational ideas is common, and the lack of personalized training; Second, the humanities work is formalized and lacks substantive content; Third, highlight the dominant position of teachers and weaken students’ subjectivity; Fourthly, one - sided emphasis on knowledge infusion, ignoring the emotional process. We collected data from some students, applied Apriori Algorithm for frequent sets. We established an association rule model between humanistic care and ideological and political education by digging frequent K-term sets and pruning the infrequent. The solutions to these problems are made from experimental results: to carry out theoretical research and practical activities, to improve educators’ quality, to perfect effective mechanism and to create a good environment, so as to realize the reform and innovation of humanistic care in ideological and political education of college students.

articleTitle: Metrology Atlas Research on the CNKI Literature Big Data of Sports Artificial Intelligence Based on COOC/VOSviewer
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Through the bibliometric method and VOSviewer, an emerging literature big data bibliometric visualization tool, the keywords of CNKI literature big date of sports artificial intelligence are sorted by word frequency as reflected by co-occurrence matrix network model, and clustering visualization atlas. The results of analysis show that the literature high-frequency words of sports artificial intelligence research in the current CNKI database include artificial intelligence, sports, college students, interests, and Computer vision. And the co-occurrence matrix network for keywords consist of 91 nodes and 381 lines; with artificial intelligence, sports and college students as the hotspots, the clustering characteristics are embodied in five aspects, namely system, content, direction, scope and trend.

articleTitle: Research on the teaching reform facilitated by digital technology in Chinese universities - based on the operation design of virtual teaching and research section
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In recent years, owing to the lack of importance given to relevant policies and other multi-factors, the diverse and complex characteristics of problems have emerged in the construction of undergraduate teaching and research sections in Chinese universities. The prominent issues–typically, loose organizational management and unitary organizational structure and teaching activity–have adversely affected the teachers’ teaching behaviors, scientific research work, and social service, which closely concern the quality of undergraduate teaching. With the emergence of Digital Humanities Age, digital technology and methods promote the reform and innovation of higher education. In this context, this paper provides a new approach to the study of a university’s basic teaching organization–the operation design of virtual teaching and research section, aiming to upgrade traditional undergraduate teaching and research sections and guide educational and teaching practice. The virtual teaching and research section emphasizes the digital technology for support. And it stresses the build of the virtual teaching team, via a method of combining online and offline (020) and contribute, in particular, to achieving the cross and fusion of multi-disciplinary, sharing of educational resources, applying advanced teaching concept and design to practice.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Role of Short Knowledge Videos in Bridging the "Knowledge Gap" in School Education in the 5G Era : ——Take bilibili as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Pierre Bourdieu regards family and school as two important places for the inheritance of cultural capital [1]. In the 5G era, people’s access to information and knowledge is no longer limited to homes and schools. Short videos have become an important way to spread knowledge and a new educational approach, effectively narrowing the "knowledge gap". This paper focuses on applying short videos in education innovation based on the characteristics of 5G. We found that the bullets of the short video platform and the "class representative" in the comment area break the limitations of the school classroom, expand knowledge horizon, and strengthen communication and interaction. This paper takes Bilibili.com (hereinafter referred to as Bilibili) as the research object, scrapes the bullets through Python, and does big data analysis. The research found that the short video bullet function can realize the interconnection of knowledge points; the "class representative" in the comment area has the function of summarizing knowledge; and the short knowledge videos play a specific role in bridging the "knowledge gap" in school education.

articleTitle: Analysis of China's education informatization in the post-epidemic era based on SPSS Chi-square test and SWOT model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In this paper, the SPSS Chi-square test is used to analyze whether gender differences in 133 valid questionnaires have a significant impact on online teaching attitude, and a preliminary investigation of a case of students’ attitudes to online teaching, the results show that 93.24% of students think online teaching software is helpful to them, the satisfaction of online teaching is 64.02%. Then, SWOT analysis is used to analyze the advantages, disadvantages, opportunities , and threats of educational informatization. Finally, SWOT strategic model matrix diagram is drawn according to the analysis results, in order to put forward reference suggestions for further improvement and development of educational informatization.

articleTitle: Evaluation for Education of the Sustainable Development of Engineering College Students Base on NLP Method
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Engineering is one of the keys to solve the problem of sustainable development, and engineers with sustainable development concepts are necessary to realize sustainable development. It is of great significance to develop the education of sustainable development (ESD) for engineering college students to cultivate their non-technical literacy. This paper, taking the communication engineering major students in North China University of Technology (NCUT) as an example, obtains data through questionnaire surveys, and explores methods for evaluating the effects of sustainable development education based on questionnaires and natural language processing technology (NLP). Use TF-IDF to obtain the keywords of students’ answers, and compare them with the keywords collection of official documents. At the same time, use Bert Embedding to convert text to word vector, compare the vector space similarity. Through statistics and analysis of the result, it can be seen through to carry out the sustainable development education, students’ sustainable development concept has the obvious improvement, compared with commercial major student survey at the same time, it can be seen that the engineering students awareness of sustainable development is closely related to the engineering major, therefore, The ESD for engineering students should focus on the professional characteristics, which is more conducive to the improvement of the effectiveness of ESD.

articleTitle: Networking College’s Smart Education System Based on Omnidirectional Interaction Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The traditional two-way information transmission process between teachers and students cannot guarantee that the subject will recognize the other in a neutral rather than a self-centered manner during college classroom teaching activities. SMART education is regarded as an intelligent, tailored instruction-learning supporting system in ‘Internet + Education’ context, and we should reshape human-technology relationship. The results show that the ‘human-machine’ interaction method lacks direct spiritual interaction and emotional communication, and that smart classroom is a highly complex and interactive teaching-learning system, therefore a new model of omnidirectional interaction needs to be constructed according to the informatization of smart education. Finally, the three-dimensional interaction features of ‘teacher-technology-student’ can better meet the demands of ‘digital natives’ for strong interaction and optimize the interaction behaviors of smart education in the open technology-embedded environment.

articleTitle: Research on Artificial Intelligence Network Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Deep learning is part of the latest trends in machine learning and artificial intelligence research. This is part of the most popular trends in scientific research today. However, as deep learning develops rapidly, its progress is hard to keep up. Adaptive optimization methods, such as Adam, Adagrad, or RMSprop, have poor generalization performance compared to stochastic gradient descent (SGD). These methods tend to perform well in the initial stages of training, but SGD performs better in the latter stages of training. This article explains what problems artificial neural networks can be used for and the basic structure of these problems shows the development of deep learning and proposes solutions and related optimization methods for different problems.

articleTitle: Reform and Practice of Mixed Teaching of Computer Specialty in Higher Vocational Colleges Based on MOOC + SPOC : Taking the course of C language programming as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Internet plus education has hitherto unknown the opportunities and challenges of the development of modern occupation education. Based on the super star "one level and three ends" intelligent teaching system, modern information technology is deeply integrated into the reform and practice of mixed teaching mode of computer specialty in higher vocational colleges. Taking the teaching of C language programming as an example, reconstruct multiple curriculum objectives, reform the curriculum teaching content system, create MOOC courses with higher vocational characteristics, build a "MOOC + SPOC + flipped classroom" teaching mode, carry out "3 + 2" mixed teaching, and build a three-dimensional curriculum ideological and political system of "country, society and individual", Create a diversified assessment method combining process and summative assessment, organically integrating online and offline classes and three teaching stages before, during and after class. Teaching practice shows that this model is conducive to stimulate higher vocational students’ learning interest, cultivate higher vocational students’ autonomous learning ability, promote higher vocational students’ in-depth learning, improve higher vocational students’ learning ability, and achieve good teaching results.

articleTitle: VR Technology Applied in The Teaching of Equipment Courses
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Nowadays, virtual reality (VR) technology has been widely used in the field of education. Especially in equipment courses of post-oriented education, utilizing VR technology can provide a realistic simulating training environment and effectively solve the problems of lacking new actual equipment, reducing training risks of certain dangerous operations, etc. However, the improvement of teaching effect based on VR technology still needs to be continuously studied. In this paper, we mainly study the approach of applying VR technology in equipment courses. Firstly, we discuss the technical characteristics of equipment teaching based on VR technology. Then, in developing the VR teaching system for the teaching of equipment courses, the main functional components and the corresponding application process are analyzed. Finally, we propose the specific method of applying VR technology in equipment courses to achieve better teaching effects from the aspects of information teaching resource allocation, training task construction, training mode selection, exploratory practice enhancement and evaluation method design.

articleTitle: Innovation and application of animation art design based on digital media background
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The rapid development of computer and information technology promotes the development and application of digital media technology. At present, digital media is widely used in audio and video processing, image photography, animation design, multimedia, software research and development and other related fields, showing its strong vitality. As an important application branch of digital media technology, digital animation has been effectively innovated and developed. With the launch and version update of 3DSMax, Maya, Mental Ray, Flash and other animation production software, modeling, material mapping, rendering and other technologies are increasingly perfect, digital animation production technology tends to mature, animation forms are more colorful and vivid. Digital media technology plays a great role in optimizing animation production process, improving production speed and broadening design concept. This paper focuses on the transformation and influence of digital media technology on animation art, and analyzes the application and development of animation art under the background of digital media.

articleTitle: Research on College Students’ Network Responsibility Behavior Based on Big Data Technology and SPSS Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the continuous development of big data technology and network technology, the network always affects the study, life and work of college students, and college students’ lack of awareness of network responsibility and problems of anomie behavior frequently become more complicated. This article uses big data technology, uses smart campus and big data network to extract data, and uses SPSS software to analyze the obtained college students’ network responsibility behavior data from vertical links and horizontal dimensions, and finds that college students’ non-network responsibility behaviors have decreased and appeared. A certain degree of "disconnected knowledge and action" and other issues provide a reference for further promoting the improvement of college students’ network responsibility.

articleTitle: The influence of maker education on the innovation ability of secondary vocational students Based on Experimental Analysis of SPSS
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the development of society, maker education has begun to enter various schools. Maker education is believed to be able to effectively enhance students’ sense of innovation and spirit of cooperation. To verify this view, this paper analyzes the literature on the relationship between maker education and creativity at home and abroad, designs and relies on SPSS for data analysis to complete the experiment. This experiment conforms to the complex teaching concept of Maker Education, and evaluates from three aspects: teacher evaluation, student self-evaluation, and student mutual evaluation. This article uses Excel to collect and organize the data by measuring the four aspects of creativity. After obtaining the data through questionnaires and interviews, the descriptive analysis and correlation analysis in SPSS are used to analyze and study the characteristics of the data and Pearson’s coefficient. It can be concluded that maker education does have a positive impact on students’ creativity, and it has a significant effect on students’ creative thinking.

articleTitle: The Application of Computer Technology in English Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: For the database of computer English teaching platform, the specific application of computer technology in English teaching is an important way to improve its English teaching ability. Secondly, based on the construction of computer algorithm application system platform, this paper puts forward the basic mode of formulating English teaching objectives. Finally, through data collection, storage, mining and analysis, it provides strong computer data model support for modern English teaching reform, This paper discusses the importance and necessity of improving the quality of innovation and entrepreneurship education by using the computer mathematical analysis and experiment platform, introduces the general modeling theory, comprehensive simulation theory and method, planning theory and method, safety theory and method, and systematically summarizes the operation optimization and control, benefit evaluation and operation mechanism The existing problems are summarized and analyzed.

articleTitle: Enhance High School Students' Grit by Parental Rearing Style: a Moderated Mediation Model and the Accurate Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Grit refers to the passion and persistence towards long-term goals and it is the most reliable trait to predict one’s future success. Therefore, the research of grit quality among teenagers, including relevant factors and models, has significant practical value. The current study conducted a survey to 880 students at a high school in Gansu Province, including grit scale, the scale for parental rearing style, hope scale, and the scale for clarity of self-concept. The survey also collected each student’s demographic information. A total of 850 valid responses have been collected, and SPSS 24.0 was taken for data analysis. A variety of analytic methods were used in this study, including analysis of variance of grit among demographical variables, Harman’s Single Factor Test for Common Method Bias, Pearson’s Correlation, regression analysis, and Process Marcoes for SPSS for mediating analysis, moderating analysis and moderated mediating analysis. The conclusion is that positive parental rearing styles can promote grit among high-school students, which is partially achieved by improving their sense of hope. Meanwhile, clarity of self-concept contributes to the increase of grit by parental rearing style through enhancing the sense of hope. This moderated mediation model can provide specific suggestions and guidelines for developing teenagers’ grit. Also, this model can be used in conjunction with intellectual tools such as high-school students’ profiles, personalized analysis, and accurate recommendations to help promote the development of grit.

articleTitle: Teaching Mode of Operations Research Course Based on Internet Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, Internet technologies are widely used in various fields. College teaching is also encouraged to join this rank to improve teaching levels and enhance students’ interest in learning through modern teaching modes. Combined with the characteristics of operations research, this paper mainly explores how to make full use of network teaching from two aspects: First, build a teaching platform based on the Internet and build an interactive teaching mode with students as the center. That is, recording short videos before class - aided by Rain Classroom in class - holding TikTok live broadcasts after class. Second, introduce Quantitative Systems for Business, LINGO, and other computer software technologies into the classroom teaching of operations research to enhance students’ autonomous learning ability and practical ability.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Smart Employment Service Platform Based on Internet Plus Initiative
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The employment of college graduates is related to national economic construction, social stability and the fundamental interests of the people. With the rapid development of mobile Internet and big data technology, employment services have changed from traditional form to precision employment, from pursuing employment rate to improving employment quality. Based on the "Internet plus initiative", the smart employment service platform of universities can achieve orderly employment policy guidance, accurate placement of employment information, accurate employment process assistance, and employment data system analysis. Starting with the analysis of the current situation of employment guidance service in colleges and universities, this paper puts forward the idea of building a smart employment service platform in Colleges and universities by using big data, cloud computing, Internet of things and other technologies. Through the design of five modules, such as personal information data, smart employment service, employment policy attention, employment experience exchange and employment data analysis, realizes the connection between the personalized development needs of graduates and social and economic development, and achieves win-win results.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of "AR/VR+" Traditional Cultural Education Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The increasing progress of artificial intelligence(AI) technology affects the development across the board. As an important base for cultivating talents in the new era and nurturing development forces, colleges and universities will inevitably usher in unprecedented intelligent changes. Based on big data analysis platforms such as statista, this paper analyzes the AI industry and predicts the development of VR market scale. The research found that AR/VR has great potential in education and can profoundly affect teaching reform. Therefore, this paper combines the development of AI technology in AR/VR and discusses the use of "AR/VR+" technology in traditional cultural teaching in colleges and universities before, during and after class. The purpose of is to explore the intelligent, new and technological teaching mode, and provide appropriate suggestions and countermeasures for intelligent teaching, the deep integration of education and technology, and the improvement of teaching quality.

articleTitle: Research on the application of computer technology in legal practice
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, many industries begin to use computer technology to improve work efficiency. From the facts of many practices, we can see that computer technology is a good technology for many industries and can bring many benefits to the industry. Computer technology is also deepening into legal practice. In legal practice, modeling, simulation and other calculation methods can be used to analyze legal relations, so that legal information can be transformed from traditional analysis to an information and intelligent system with higher efficiency and accuracy. The inclusion classification in legal procedures can be simply summarized as a model, and the eigenvalue table structure is built to make the case enter the computer into data that can be calculated and judged. This method simplifies the case trial and makes the case context clearer. The deep integration of Computational Thinking and legal thinking is conducive to enrich and develop the basic theory of law, improve the scientificity and coordination of various departments in the judicial system, and improve the efficiency of the judicial system. Computer technology plays a positive role in improving legislative and judicial efficiency, coping with and avoiding technical risks.

articleTitle: Application of VR Technology in Criminal Law Education Practice Teaching and Countermeasures Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Virtual reality technology is widely used in many fields. VR technology takes computer technology as the core, generates virtual three-dimensional environment, and carries out real-time interaction with the help of sensing helmets, data clothes and other equipment, which can fully mobilize people’s senses and make people feel there. With the rapid development of China’s economy, VR technology is no longer limited to military, aerospace, medical and other fields. Under the idea that the Party and the country strongly advocate education first, and with the input of policies and social capital, VR has gradually entered the field of education. However, this article is concerned with the shortcomings of the application in the practical teaching of criminal law education, and puts forward relevant alternative treatment methods corresponding to VR technology.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Wild Edible Mushroom Detection Based on Multi-scale Features
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Every summer, there are frequent poisoning incidents of eating wild edible mushrooms in China, and many people are poisoned by eating wild edible mushrooms. Due to the slight differences in the characteristics of wild edible mushroom species and the complex image background in the actual scene, it isn’t easy to distinguish them with naked eyes. In response to this problem, a method of yolov5 combined with multi-scale feature input is proposed to improve the recognition accuracy of edible wild mushrooms. The model’s specific performance in this paper is that when the Map value reaches 75.9%, 1.4% higher than the original model, the Fps value can go 40 during the model detection at the same time. In the final stage, the obtained model will be simplified and deployed to Android devices to increase its practicality and solve the current problem of the frequent occurrence of wild edible mushroom poisoning.

articleTitle: The status quo of the development of multidisciplinary and "double innovation" talent training models in the field of education in China
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Based on the data from China HowNet, this paper uses citespace visual analysis software to draw a map of scientific knowledge in this research field. Through literature clustering and data analysis, the development status of the multi-disciplinary "double innovation" talent training model in my country’s education field is sorted out, and the new talent training model is sorted and summarized from the three perspectives of the country, enterprises, and universities.

articleTitle: 2P-Analysis of the Effect of Higher Education on Fair Mobility of Social Classes Based on the Perspective of Intergenerational Mobility under the Background of Internet Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Intergenerational mobility,especially the intergenerational mobility of education, reflects the fairness of society to a certain extent. Based on the perspective of intergenerational mobility, this article aims at the educational intergenerational mobility of 6358 domestic families based on descriptive statistical analysis and regression coefficient analysis. A case study was carried out to explore the impact of parents’ educational level on children’s educational level. The research in this paper finds that the education level of domestic children will be significantly affected by the education level of their parents. The intergenerational mobility of education is relatively poor and the fair mobility of social classes needs to be further improved.

articleTitle: Exploration on the Application of Circuit Board Design Course Combined with Internet Technology in Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Internet technology is also changing with each passing day, and the curriculum of circuit board design still stays in the monotonous and boring educational concept. In view of the current situation that the curriculum theory of circuit board design is strong, monotonous and boring, students’ practical ability is poor, and even tired of learning, combined with the application of Internet technology, the "Curriculum Ideology and politics" is introduced. After front-line teachers go to the enterprise for field research, enterprise engineers and personnel managers are hired to participate in the formulation of talent training scheme. This paper puts forward a circuit board design course development idea in vocational colleges, which combines the application of Internet technology and takes the professional standard as the guidance. The teaching goal is clear, the difficulty is moderate, the curriculum is vivid and the participation number of students is high. The course development focuses on arousing students’ interest, improving students’ practical ability and improving the curriculum theory of circuit board design through the application of Internet technology. Be aimed at the monotonous and boring current situation, combined with Internet technology and comprehensively practice the "curriculum thought and politics", students have high ideological level, deep knowledge and strong ability. Curriculum planning allows students to learn in hands-on practice, practice in learning, teaching in fun, and achieve remarkable teaching results.

articleTitle: Application of VR technology in ideological and political teaching in colleges and universities
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: VR technology has highlighted a huge role in ideological and political teaching in colleges and universities. The architecture of VR is used to define the component model and interactive topology of the Internet of Things application system, which is the basis of constructing ideological and political teaching system supporting horizontal interconnection, heterogeneous integration, resource sharing and dynamic maintenance. At present, service-oriented software architecture is the most commonly used style to construct ideological and political application system. VR technology is oriented to the reference model of Internet of Things software architecture centered on “object end” in ideological and political teaching in colleges and universities. This paper compares and analyzes the reference models of ideological and political teaching, points out the differences in the types of teaching software components based on them, the principles of teaching design adopted and the structural attributes, and shows that these reference models are suitable for guiding the construction of Internet of Things application systems with different scales and different application requirements. The formal modeling and model detection methods of ideological and political teaching application system based on software architecture are analyzed. Finally, VR technology points out the specific work that needs to be carried out in the future to establish the application system development method of ideological and political teaching in colleges and universities based on software architecture.

articleTitle: The Application and Thinking of Big Data in the Career Planning Education of College Students
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Doing a good job of career planning education for college students is one of the key tasks of colleges and universities, and it is an important guarantee for improving the quality of employment and the success rate of employment, and the employment of college graduates is related to the country’s economic and social development and social stability. This paper comprehensively analyzes the current situation of college students’ career planning, discusses the technical characteristics of big data in college education applications, and studies the impact of big data on college students’ career planning education. At the same time, it puts forward the practical strategy of applying big data technology to the career planning education of college students to improve the professional ability of the career planning guidance team and provide students with a full range of career planning guidance services.

articleTitle: Application of Big Data in Language Formation and Computing Science
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper focuses on the background of big data, from the perspective of information and computing science professional experimental courses, enriches the information and computer science professional experimental courses, and further expounds the specific application on of big data in the information and computer science professional experimental course system. Among them, the artificial intelligence technology shown by big data in the experimental teaching helps students to better carry out professional experiments. Meanwhile, the data analysis can make the experimental information get rapid results, reflecting the characteristics of fast speed and high accuracy. The research goal of this paper is to achieve the role of new technologies created under the integration of big data technology and information and computing science major, especially data analysis in the information and computer major, as well as the data analysis technology applied in the experimental course.

articleTitle: The Enlightenment of Information Technology Development to Education——Based on embodied cognition theory in psychology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development of information technology, there are also new opportunities and challenges in the education field. Education informatization is an important content of education modernization. The integration of emerging information technologies such as the Internet, big data, and artificial intelligence with education and teaching has not only changed the traditional educational concepts and methods, but also challenged teachers how to improve teaching. In addition to the current psychological research on embodied cognition theory, human body experience accounts for a large part of learning. Different feelings in different parts will make understanding more comprehensive and faster. Therefore, through new multimedia interactive devices, VR, AR, 3D, The new generation of information technology such as big data, combined with embodied cognition, has developed "VR + HapticV" as an emerging teaching tool and method, which aims to improve the efficiency of learners. Based on the combination of embodied cognition theory and emerging information technology, the relevant teaching of physical experience is carried out, and the learning effect is improved while paying attention to individual creativity to better achieve the goal of quality education.

articleTitle: The Research of Online Classroom Status Feedback Based on Facial Expression Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the case of the difficulty of teachers to know the learning status of students in the online classroom, this paper mainly proposes a learning status feedback method based on facial expression recognition. With the students’ images captured on class, the OpenCV facial detection is used to extract the facial information, which will be classified into seven emotion categories through the ResNetl8 convolutional neural network model. Through the PAD emotion model, the seven types of emotions are mapped to the three dimensions of the PAD emotion space, and the mapping values are used to calculate the students’ learning engagement with the formula, so that it can numerically quantify the abstract learning emotion status. Based on statistical principles, the learning engagement is refined to three characteristics - level, volatility, and persistence. Taking an online physics class divided into different teaching sessions as an example, this paper analyzes the study status of students with PAD model and provides feedback, which confirms the feasibility of using facial emotion recognition technology in online classroom status. In this way, teachers can easily judge students’ learning engagement in online classroom and adjust their teaching strategies to improve the quality of online classroom teaching.
