articleTitle: A Study on College English Teachers' Informatization Teaching Ability in Private Colleges Based on Information Technology in Blended Teaching Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Improving teachers’ informatization teaching ability has become the key and core competence to improve the quality of blended teaching. This research first introduces the connotation of college English teacher’s information literacy, then summarizes the survey on the current situation of the information-based teaching ability of college English teachers in private colleges under the blended teaching mode through questionnaire and interviews. Research shows that college English teachers in private colleges have a strong sense of information technology, but most of them are not confident and skillful enough in applying information technology to blended teaching. In the hope of providing references for the development of information-based teaching ability of college English teachers in private colleges, finally the study proposes corresponding development strategies. It is necessary to improve teachers’ self- efficacy in information-based teaching, motivating teachers to make good use of online English teaching resources and teaching platform. Upgrading information technology supporting facilities, setting up smart classroom and enhancing the regular training of information technology for teachers are also critical to develop informatization teaching ability of the college English teachers in private colleges.

articleTitle: Research on the Mixed Teaching Practice of Curriculum Ideological and Political Integration Based on Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Under the background of new engineering construction, in order to give full play to the role of higher education in cultivating talents for socialism, implement the ideological and political education effect of college courses, and solve the problem of emphasizing knowledge and skills over value shaping in the talent cultivation of local application-oriented undergraduate colleges, this paper carries out teaching reform for automobile specialty courses. This paper mainly explores the practical path of integrating curriculum ideology and politics into the hybrid teaching of "Automobile Chassis Construction".SPSS statistical software was used to analyze the data of applied students’ learning characteristics, learning data of mixed learning, teaching evaluation and teaching reflection, and the correlation analysis of qualitative variables, Logistic model analysis and cluster analysis were carried out to form a comprehensive and whole-process curriculum ideological and political education model of "four in one, multiple education".

articleTitle: Research on Influencing Factors of English Mobile Learning Based on Structural Equation Model TAM
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Based on the theory of TAM model, this research combines literature research, theoretical analysis (qualitative) and empirical research (quantitative) to analyze and summarize the key factors affecting the intention and acceptance of English mobile learning in higher education. This study combines the characteristics of English subject and introduces new variables on the basis of TAM model. The direct or indirect effects of newly added variables such as Self-efficacy (SE), Professional Relevance (PR), Social Influence (SI) and Resource Optimization (RO) on behavioral intention are demonstrated by data. Among them, resource optimization variables have direct or indirect effects on behavioral intention of mobile English learning in higher education. The impact is most obvious. The influencing factors model of English mobile learning behavior intention is constructed, and the corresponding research hypothesis is put forward.

articleTitle: A Novel Data Recovery Algorithm for FAT32 File System
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The data recovery technology of the FAT32 file system is widely used in computer forensics. Based on the traditional scanning algorithm, this paper draws on and improves the Sunday algorithm and the AC automata algorithm, combined with the characteristics of data decoding by the hexadecimal dump, and proposes a specific scanning strategy to classify and scan purposefully and recover and obtain evidence. Documents and information are displayed to realize a stable and fast scanning traversal program. For incomplete Office files, it can also analyze a series of streams of its compound documents, and finally obtain valuable relevant information to obtain evidence.

articleTitle: Design of OBE Based Closed-loop Teaching Mode for University Course
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This article improves the traditional closed-loop teaching mode with outcome based education (OBE) idea. First, the outcome which is the core of OBE is relined in two dimensions, and a formalized learning outcome model is established; then, the exercise library is revised to support the learning outcome model. On this basis, an exact model is designed for OBE based closed-loop teaching mode, which adopts a four-level test and teacher-student two-level feedback operating mechanism. And the specific strategies of OBE based plan, OBE based test, OBE based evaluation, and feedback instruction ensure the closed-loop mode and OBE idea. OBE based closed- loop teaching mode combining two excellent modes is beneficial to the university course. Our research takes object-oriented programming course as the object, supports stable operation of the mode and also provides a foundation for informatization construction of the mode.

articleTitle: Research on Measures to Improve the Employment Competitiveness of Students Majoring in Power Based on the PDCA Program
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Taking a college as an example, this paper expounds on how to solve the problem of low competitiveness of power students in employment based on PDCA program and new energy simulation technology platform. In this paper, the fishbone diagram is firstly used to find out the main reasons for the low employment competitiveness of the students majoring in power in this college. Then, countermeasures are put forward for the main reasons, such as adding waste incineration power generation simulation unit and biomass power generation simulation unit. Finally, after participating in the online National Power generation technical skills competition and vocational skills grade certificate examination, the goal of increasing the number of certificates has been realized, and the way to improve the employment competitiveness of student majoring in power has been found.

articleTitle: Research on information security user behavior path of agricultural logistics industrial park under big data environment
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the development of digital and information technology in logistics industry, big data has become one of the most important Means of production in logistics industry. It brings new impetus to the development of the logistics industry, but it also brings some challenges to the information security, especially the logistics industrial park which is supported by the information platform. This paper takes agricultural logistics industrial park as an example to analyze its information demand and information structure. And on this basis, through constructing the supply chain model in the logistics industrial park, TSP algorithm is used to solve the shortest path of the logistics business in the supply chain, its logistics operation must rely on the original supply chain shortest path structure. Taking the user behavior behind the logistics information security management as the carrier object, this paper constructs the variation user behavior entropy TSP model. The information security problem of the network is abstracted as the shortest path that does not repeatedly connect all nodes. Based on this, the user behavior path is simulated and optimized, and relevant conclusions are drawn.

articleTitle: Research on the Development of Secondary Vocational Students' Computational Thinking Based on Gamiflcation Teaching : —Taking the Secondary Vocational Information Technology Course as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Current information technology courses have problems such as insufficient attention from students, unclear training goals and single teaching methods. Traditional teaching can no longer meet the needs of modern education, and the teaching reform of information technology courses is imperative. Therefore, this article proposes to apply gamification teaching to information technology courses to increase students’ interest in learning and cultivate students’ computational thinking, that is, the ability to use the basic concepts of computer science to solve complex problems. This article takes the secondary vocational information technology course as an example to study the specific application of gamification teaching, and proposes a case of “Gobang Game” to provide a reference for the implementation of gamification teaching.

articleTitle: Research on agricultural logistics distribution path optimization based on ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Considering the fixed cost, transportation cost, cargo damage cost of distribution vehicles and the penalty cost caused by failing to meet the service time window invited by customers as the objective function, this paper constructs the agricultural product distribution path optimization model, and puts forward an improved ant colony algorithm combined with 2-opt local search mechanism to solve this problem, which can provide reference for the distribution decision-making of logistics enterprises.

articleTitle: Learning disability early warning system based on classification algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Machine learning technology quantifies the educational experience of excellent teachers and assesses student learning differences and key data. Start the risk early warning of college students' learning failure, and the system actively displays the list of early warning students and suggests intervention measures. The data preprocessing technology the scikit learn framework is adopted to explore the data, feature selection, screening, filtering, data set division, sample rebalancing, and standardized processing. Valuable data can be obtained after the operation. The processed data are modeled and trained by using a machine learning classification algorithm. The data set is divided into a test set and training set by using a random forest algorithm, logistic regression algorithm, support vector machine algorithm, and AdaBoost algorithm. The accuracy, recall, F1 value, AUC value of the predicted results of the four classification algorithms are compared, and the most suitable optimal algorithm is selected for visual analysis. From various performances in the process of model training, use Matplotlib to draw and analyze, show the effect and function of the drawing, and screen out the orientation of students due to low learning effect and whether human intervention measures should be taken in time due to the prompt early warning system.

articleTitle: Application exploration of BIM simulation model in teaching of Landscape engineering budget
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the continuous development of BIM technology, colleges and universities are actively exploring ways to integrate BIM technology into professional teaching. In this paper, from the perspective of BIM simulation model, combined with teaching materials, taking the application of BIM simulation model in the teaching of landscape engineering budget as an example, the advantages of BIM simulation model in the teaching of engineering cost are fully demonstrated, and various forms of BIM technology into the teaching of engineering cost are analyzed. Through the experience of teaching practice, the author thinks about the methods and strategies of contemporary teachers in the teaching process, explores how to apply new technology to teaching, expands the traditional teaching methods and theories, and provides a new perspective for the continuous improvement of teaching methods and teaching ideas.

articleTitle: The role of distance education and teaching in the psychological consulting industry : Take the time of COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The outbreak of COVID-19 and the global epidemic in 2019, according to the survey data in China, showed a gradual increase in the rate of pneumonia, resulting in a series of mental health problems. In this case, it becomes particularly important for psychological counseling and psychological pressure relieving by distance education teaching technology. In particular, based on artificial intelligence and cloud storage technology, the use of hybrid cloud mode and P2P network and other forms of distance education teaching technology, to a certain extent to help the psychological consulting industry, to achieve online professional consultation without leaving home. <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>

articleTitle: Research and Practice of Blended Teaching of Digital Electronic Technology Course for Application- oriented Undergraduate
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: According to the objective of talents training and teaching characteristics of application-oriented undergraduate colleges, the teaching objectives of digital electronic technology course are refined, and a four-step teaching process including preclass, in-class, after-class, and practical training is designed, as well as the teaching activity of integrating truth and reality, stratified and, segmented of The teaching activity. Finally, it analyzes the teaching effect after the implementation, and, finds that blended teaching of digital electronic technology courses has higher learning enthusiasm and participation, and better teaching effect.

articleTitle: System Construction of Virtual Simulation Experimental Teaching platform under Network Security and Computer Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: At present, there are deficiencies in network security experiment resources, experiment environment, experiment management and computer technology virtual simulation experiment teaching in China. This paper proposes to explore the virtual simulation experiment teaching platform of network security and computer technology, provide high-quality experimental resources for experiments, and further improve students' practical ability and innovation ability. The key of network security and computer technology lies in computer algorithm. Based on the analysis of virtual experiment teaching mode, this paper expounds the application of computer algorithm in experimental modeling. Computer algorithm is a virtual experiment platform system model including computer programming modeling and computer software modeling. The construction of virtual experiment platform model is inseparable from the help of computer algorithm. This paper mainly expounds the construction process of virtual simulation experiment teaching resources and introduces the sharing mode of teaching resources.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Algorithm in Linear Algebra Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In this paper, a new method for linear algebra teaching was proposed, which was to integrate machine learning algorithms into teaching. Through investigation and research, there’re two long-standing problems in the teaching of linear algebra: students didn’t know its usefulness or how to use it. However, machine learning algorithms contain rich linear algebra theory. Taking eigenface as an example, this paper introduced how to disassemble the algorithm and applied it to daily teaching.

articleTitle: Model construction of artificial intelligence technology in interior residential space design
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the progress of science and technology and the improvement of residents’ aesthetic level, indoor living space has brought a broader application prospect. In this direction, it is undoubtedly very important to explore the application mode of artificial intelligence technology in interior living space design. In this paper, through the three-dimensional model construction of space design, auxiliary design software, intelligent scene analysis in-depth exploration, using three-dimensional three-dimensional model to establish a comprehensive space design system model, can efficiently and scientifically carry out space design work. And expounds the modern intelligent design system based on the combination of artificial intelligence technology and space design industry, strengthening the digital process of space design industry, and then expounds the application of artificial intelligence technology in space design mode, improving the innovative development of the current artificial intelligence technology.

articleTitle: A Novel Cloud-Based System for Student Evaluation of Teaching and Self-Reflection in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Feedback is a vital part of improving the learning of students and the teaching of instructors in higher education. However, feedback has not worked efficiently and effectively as expected at present. In this paper, we present a novel cloud-based system for collecting student feedback on teaching and their self-reflection on learning with the K.I.S.S (Keep-Improve-Stop-Start) Framework based on the theory of social-constructivism theory about teaching and learning. With this system, students participate in evaluations of teaching and self-reflection of their learning process anonymously from their mobile phones, pad, or other devices. Instructors share and discuss the feedback with students in the classroom. This new framework motivates students to participate in the evaluation of teaching. And it also encourages students to reflect on self-learning. The case study shows that the feedback from students is objective, reliable, and accurate and can harness teaching and learning.

articleTitle: Research on Strategies for Improving College and University Cultural Security based on 5G
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper starts with analyzing the current status of cultural security of college students and uses a big data platform to scrape 419,597 pieces of data on a hot issue. From the analysis, it is concluded that West is currently promoting content that endangers China’s cultural security through different channels (such as social network, Website, forum, short video). These channels benefit from the rapid development and application of 5G technology and the influence on the audience is increasingly far-reaching. College students are sensitive to emerging technologies and difficult to distinguish the authenticity of external information, so they are more likely to be induced and deceived by western culture. Therefore, we must pay more attention to the cultural security of college students. Finally, this paper proposes strategies to ensure the cultural security of colleges and universities by improving the education governance system and teaching capabilities, using 5G technology to strengthen cultural self-confidence from various channels, and providing high-quality content.

Author Keywords: Cultural security in colleges and universities

articleTitle: Development Strategy Research of Anime Pilgrimage Tourism from the Perspective of IP Operation Based on Statistical Quantitative Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the substantial increase of ACGN works, the anime pilgrimage has become an emerging tourism model for the development of the cultural industry. While China’s anime pilgrimage market is still at an early age, its sustainable development is restricted by the lack of IP strategic operation mode and the imperfect industrial chain. In the context of "Internet+", intellectual property (IP), as a core resource and sustainable business asset for the diversified development of cross-media, cross-form and cross-industry in the cultural industry. This paper uses the market statistical quantitative analysis method to survey the market scale of China’s online copyright industry from 2016 to 2020 and its exponential growth trend, then analyzes the operation and market performance of Chinese and Japanese IP industry chains to explore the optimization ideas for developing the anime pilgrimage tourism in China.

articleTitle: Research on Mobile Teaching Design of Higher Vocational Education under Ubiquitous Network Technology-Taking ‘Basic Piano Course’ as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: When designing the ‘Piano Basic Course’ teaching plan, the introduction of ubiquitous mobile thinking can improve the quality of piano education in higher vocational education. Based on this, this article discusses the advantages of using ubiquitous mobile mode in the teaching of basic piano courses, and elaborates on the teaching design of pre-class preparation, practice teaching design in class, teaching design after class, and teaching evaluation based on ubiquitous mobile technology. The design realizes an in-depth analysis of the ubiquitous and mobile design of piano teaching in higher vocational colleges, and aims to help the construction of higher vocational teaching systems.

articleTitle: Teaching evaluation model design and data analysis based on the concept of "Postioning as the Core, Designing as the Soul" : —Take the science and engineering course "Signals and Systems" as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Science and engineering courses are very important for students to improve their working thinking and to engage in professional research in the future. However, the reasons for the difficulty of formulas and the disconnection of practical theories often lead to poor learning effects. With the continuous development of multimedia and digital information technology, blended teaching has emerged combining the advantages of online courses and offline classrooms, which has strongly promoted new progress in science and engineering courses. In contrast, the existing literature lacks a model that can quantify the evaluation of students’ learning effects, and lacks strong data analysis as a support. This article will take a typical science and engineering course "Signal and System" as an example, and put forward a new hybrid teaching concept of "Postioning as the Core, Designing as the Soul". In order to effectively illustrate the reliability of the concept, the following test experiments will be designed: On the one hand, the amount of barrage during online learning is used as the research object, and a measurement model of student participation in the classroom is designed, and the effect of teaching implementation can be reasonably evaluated through the calculation results. On the other hand, taking the student performances collected by our group in two semesters as the research object, four sets of data are obtained through statistical calculations to scientifically analyze the feasibility of the blended teaching concept model proposed in this article. In summary, the quantitative analysis of educational effects is realized by designing the evaluation model of students’ learning effectiveness, and then the inevitable trend of the development of blended teaching is effectively displayed.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Computer-Assisted Software in Teaching English Scientific Paper Writing under Blended Teaching Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The rapid development of modem information technology has brought great changes to people’s daily work and life, and the extensive application of network information technology in modern English teaching will bring about a series of innovations to the traditional English teaching mode. The application of computer-assisted software to English teaching can improve the teaching quality and increase the learning efficiency of students. Based on the blended English teaching model under the network environment, this paper attempts to clarify and present the research on application of computer-assisted software (Rain Classroom) in teaching English Scientific Paper Writing. This new teaching mode can not only record students’ learning data throughout the whole process, so that the evaluation can be based on the data, but also can improve the teaching effect of the course from many different links, stimulate students’ interest in learning. Taking English Scientific Paper Writing course as the research object, this paper discusses the blended teaching mode based on rain classroom (Rain Classroom +Offline Teaching) in teaching by taking English scientific paper writing course as an example. English scientific paper writing course requires students to read a lot of theses before class. Before class, teacher arranges tasks through rain classroom, and supervises students to finish reading and analyzing tasks in advance. In class, students make reports and statements, and then teacher answers questions and clears up doubts. Through this method, the learning efficiency and students’ enthusiasm are improved. After class, based on the classroom data analysis of rain classroom, students’ learning dynamics are mastered in real time and guidance is provided, which lays the foundation for the scientific evaluation model based on full data-driven. By analyzing the data and results recorded in rain classroom using rain classroom data statistical software, it is concluded that computer-assisted software (rain classroom) is more convenient and objective in assistant means of English writing teaching, which will provide some reference for improving the quality of Chinese college English teaching.

articleTitle: The Teaching Effects of Online-offline Hybrid Mode in the Course of Finance—a Questionnaire-based Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the continuous progress of science and technology, the Internet is deeply combined with education, which is more open, comprehensive and innovative than the traditional teaching style. Online-offline hybrid teaching mode has become the new trend of education reform and innovation. It deeply integrates offline learning and online teaching, which can enable students to form strong learning motivation and improve learning efficiency significantly. Taking courses of financial discipline as examples, teachers can choose online platforms such as Treenity and MOOC to explain theoretical knowledge to students in advance, while using offline tools such as Duifenyi and Rain Classroom to enrich teaching design and improve classroom interaction between teachers and students. In order to study the teaching effects of online-offline hybrid teaching mode in the finance courses, this paper takes the course of Finance as an example to discuss the main influencing factors of the teaching mode. The study shows that teachers should enrich offline teaching materials and forms, supervise students' learning and teach students according to their aptitude.

articleTitle: Research on Effect Evaluation of Ideological and Political Education Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In today’s rapid development of information technology, big data technology is an emerging technology developed based on the Internet and computer. Big data technology is a new technology with modern characteristics. With its strong data processing ability and systematic analysis, it shows a strong functionality in college ideological and political education. Big data technology in college ideological and political education establishes a professional systematic ideological and political teaching model for ideological and political education. In addition, big data technology involves all aspects of teaching in the ideological and political education evaluation, including data perception and collection, data processing, storage, teaching model establishment, etc. The big data of ideological and political education is systematically analyzed with the means of network log analysis and social analysis. This paper mainly analyzes how big data technology uses data processing and system model framework to help ideological and political education establish a scientific education system model.

articleTitle: Research on the Second Class Comprehensive Education of Private Colleges and Universities Based on PEST Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Colleges and universities are the socialist builders and successors, and the cultivation of talents is a systematic project that requires synergy from all aspects. Private colleges and universities must always implement the party’s educational policy, and put morality and talents in the first place. The second lesson is a useful supplement to the comprehensive education of the first classroom. Through questionnaires and field interviews, this study analyzes the status quo of comprehensive education in the second classroom in private colleges and universities, and uses PEST to propose some construction ideas. (Political System), (Economic), (Social), (Technological), which provides a reference for the construction of second classrooms in private colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Statistic analysis of the reasons and factors influencing transportation-majored students to change their majors based on chi-square test and p-value test
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In recent years, with the development of transportation, many talents want to enter the transportation industry, especially for those undergraduates who want to learn related knowledge for future career planning by switching their majors at school. To help students to solve the problem of switching majors to transportation, a self-administered questionnaire was released to 64 undergraduate and graduate students in Shandong University, to investigate the reasons and their influential factors for switching majors. The collected data were processed by questionnaire star, EXCEL and SPSS, descriptive statistical analysis and significance analysis were conducted by chi-square test and p-value test. It was found that the main reasons for switching majors were good employment prospects and wide development space in the transportation industry. The influencing factors for switching majors were mainly found in the weak basics of related professional knowledge and the decline of teaching quality due to the online teaching mode under the influence of the COVID-19 epidemic.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Mass Entrepreneurship and Innovation Training System for Tourism English Majors Based on Cloud Learning Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Under the current background of “mass entrepreneurship and innovation”, a cloud learning platform for innovation and entrepreneurship training has been established based on cloud computing technologies such as virtualization and distribution, which is of great significance to improve the comprehensive ability of contemporary college students in mass entrepreneurship and innovation and promote the development of tourism English major education in colleges and universities. Through the establishment of non-relational database system (NoSQL) and distributed design to complete data collection and storage, and combining with Internet application technology, this paper builds a mass entrepreneurship and innovation training guidance platform and a mass entrepreneurship and innovation training management platform that meet the requirements of college tourism English professional entrepreneurship and innovation to realize the analysis and call of various data. Finally, the goal of strengthening the cognition of “mass entrepreneurship and innovation” education, effectively constructing the practical training system and perfecting the teaching content of the practical training system will be achieved, so as to improve the application ability of professional technology of tourism English students and promote the development of tourism English mass entrepreneurship and innovation in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Exploring the design co-teaching model from the perspective of user experience
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The teaching mode of collaborative teaching and group cooperation is accepted by many schools, yet there is not enough analysis and discussion on this teaching mode. Therefore, based on design collaborative teaching theory, this paper constructs a basic idea of applying user experience theory to design collaborative teaching, and forms a teaching model with knowledge collaboration, value collaboration, and organizational collaboration as the core; and designs a teaching objective oriented to group-based, integrated problem analysis and team collaborative design. Through the teaching implementation of the graduate course "Research on Art and Design Methods" at Wuhan University of Science and Technology, student feedback was collected and interviews were conducted. The results show that the design collaborative teaching model can effectively cultivate students’ problem analysis ability and improve their collaborative and innovative thinking ability and teamwork ability.

articleTitle: Application of process assessment method in calculus course teaching reform based on Web technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In this paper, through the use of Web server, MVC framework, database, HTTP, procedural assessment method and other technologies or methods, combined with the problems of traditional calculus course assessment, This paper constructs the application system of process assessment in calculus course teaching under Web technology with online learning, online task challenge, online course discussion area, course homework, online chapter test and other functional modules. Relying on the combination of online and offline methods to achieve the construction of the system, in order to meet the basic assessment function, but also to answer the students in the process of learning calculus will encounter a variety of problems, cultivate students to reflect, problem-solving habits. In addition, it solves the problems existing in traditional calculus, such as imperfect feedback mechanism, too long assessment method, which is not conducive to the cultivation of learning habits and so on

articleTitle: Research on the Design and Evaluation of Comprehensive Business English Course under the Blended Teaching Mode Based on Teachermate
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The rapid development of modern multimedia technology and networking and the widespread popularity of smart phones have provided convenience for blended teaching mode. The purpose of this paper is to explore the design and evaluation methods of the "Comprehensive Business English" course under the blended teaching mode based on Teachermate, and to make formative assessment from three aspects: before class, during class and after class. With the assistance of Teachermate, teachers can design online and offline classroom activities. This combination of traditional classroom and online teaching not only gives full play to the leading role of teachers but also highlights the main role of students, which fully stimulates students’ enthusiasm, initiative and creativity in learning and improves students’ learning.

articleTitle: Internet Voting with Panic Passwords Card
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: We propose an Internet voting scheme based on the panic passwords card, which is end-to-end verifiable. After registering once, voters can vote in any election. Voters use the mnemonic phrase to cooperate with the passwords card to vote. The voter's passwords card and the passwords sequence during voting are secured by multiple constraints. The identity of the voter is hidden throughout the voting process. Voting also has the ability to coerce-resist. When voters are coerced, they can use the panic passwords to vote, and it is impossible to directly see from the results of the voting whether it is a valid.

articleTitle: Research on Experimental Course Teaching Reform of Electronic Information Specialty in Application-oriented colleges and Universities : -- Taking the course of "electronic circuit design experiment" as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Paying attention to practical teaching and strengthening the training of applied technical talents is not only an important link to cultivate students’ practical ability and innovation ability, but also an important way to improve students’ social professional quality and employment competitiveness. Taking the course of "electronic circuit design experiment" as an example, this paper explores the comprehensive application of embedded system development and application related knowledge in course teaching from the aspects of the necessity of teaching reform, teaching content, teaching objectives, teaching tasks, teaching assessment and evaluation. This paper focuses on the minimum system of stm32f103c8t6 single chip microcomputer, introduces the principle of serial communication based on ch340 chip, and studies the communication mechanism between capacitive touch keys and host computer, so as to provide reference to the teaching reform of other experimental courses of electronic information specialty.

articleTitle: Research on Blended Learning Model Based on Bibliometric Method
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Blended learning is of positive significance for improving students’ core literacy ability, enhancing classroom teaching effects, and improving the quality of talent training as one of the important learning methods in the Internet era. The article is based on the blended teaching research data collected by CNKI from 1995 to 2020, uses bibliometric methods to analyze the publication time of the article, the distribution of journal sources, the author’s institution, and the funding support. The study draw analysis results that blended learning is the mainstream of future learning, and blended teaching models also have broad prospects. The use of information-based teaching methods will surely bring vitality to Internet teaching, online learning, and blended learning.

articleTitle: Discussion on the reform of incorporating socioscientific issues into science education in China based on NVivo : Discourse analysis of middle school textbooks
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This study mainly adopts text analysis, supplemented by literature retrieval and comparative research. A text analysis model of science textbooks was designed based on Fairclough’s text discourse analysis framework, including three analysis indicators: knowledge expression, teaching-learning process, and social practice and application. Then, the qualitative analysis software NVivo is selected to conduct qualitative analysis on the text analysis data, the frequency analysis in the four textbook samples. The e-books of 4 samples were reviewed by NVivo coding function; The case node, automatic coding and manual coding function are used to combine the data of four samples; the text search function is used to scan specific chapters of 4 samples to compare the frequency of various discourses, etc. The first purpose of this study is to help the teacher better understand students’ learning methods in science, the value of science teaching and learning to make reasonable changes in science classrooms under the new requirements of incorporating Socioscientific issues (SSI) methods into science teaching. The second purpose is to provide a reference for compiling science textbooks in line with scientific development rules, conducive to cultivating students’ Scientific Literacy and expected to present more local cultural characteristics by comparing Chinese textbooks and two westerns.

articleTitle: Research on Blended Hierarchical Teaching of Sergeants Education Based on the Course of “Optical Fiber Communication System”
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The blended learning model is a new teaching form which is guided by the blended learning theory and takes information technology as an important means. It is one of the research hotspots and important development directions of teaching reform in sergeant education colleges. This paper uses the blended learning theory combined with the idea of hierarchical teaching to design the teaching process, puts forward the hierarchical teaching design ideas under the blended learning theory, gives the design examples of related courses. Finally, taking the learners of the "optical fiber communication system" course as the research object, the effect of the course design is verified and briefly analyzed by SPSS.

articleTitle: The Application of Data Mining in Archives Management
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the development process of the new era, more and more advanced technology affect people’s daily life, not only brought the convenience in life, also changed the way of daily work, big data information technology and data mining technology can be comprehensive collection and analysis of massive data, and help people to data information content automated management and identification, is also because of this data mining in file management has its unique significance and value. Based on this, this paper studies and analyzes the application of data mining in archives management, hoping to further promote the data development of archives information management in China.

articleTitle: PAD Class-A New Teaching Mode of Online and Offline in China: : A systematic review of the literature
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the passage of time and advances in educational technology, Chinese students are increasingly unwilling to accept traditional teaching modes. PAD paradigm is a relatively novel teaching model proposed in the field of education in China in recent years. This paper takes 938 journal literatures about PAD class published from 2014 to June 2018 CNKI which is the acronym of China National Knowledge Infrastructure. It includes China knowledge resource database, digital publishing platform and literature data evaluation. that educational uses of PAD as the research object, combs and studies the literatures about PAD class on Chinese CNKI, and using qualitative and quantitative methods, focusing on four Research Questions (RQ) were reviewed and analyzes and reflects on the distribution of articles published by PAD Class on CNKI, the authors, the characteristics of PAD Class, and the challenges it faces now and in the future. It is found that the number of articles has increased rapidly in recent years, and the research institutions, research topics and research methods are diversified. However, some studies are superficial and lack of depth, and some topics have not been deeply explored. Through analysis, this paper finds out the enlightenment of these studies to future education and teaching. Based on PAD class, it expounds the effectiveness of PAD course in improving students' active learning ability. The research results show that since 2014, with the emergence and application of PAD class paradigm, the biggest advantage of PAD classroom is that it can promote the improvement of classroom efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on the physical and mental health of flight attendants in the post-epidemic period in the information background
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Nowadays, people have entered the post-epidemic period, and the epidemic prevention situation has improved, but the sequelae caused by the epidemic still exist, especially the physical and mental health of some special professions deserves attention under the impact of the epidemic.Therefore, this paper using Excell2016 software and spss16.0 statistical software for statistical data analysis, highlighted after outbreak attendant physical and mental health status, generally from inner mood, work behavior, burnout three aspects to discuss, finally concluded after outbreak effective countermeasures to promote physical and mental health: namely to strengthen flight attendant psychological counseling, take flexible scheduling policy, organize the corresponding vocational training, rich flight attendants spare time life.

articleTitle: An Online Instant Assessment System Based-on Constructivism for Classroom Teaching in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Assessing students’ classroom learning outcomes from each class is usually complicated (if not impossible) with traditional methods in higher education. A key reason is that most instructors cannot find an effective and efficient tool to evaluate students' classroom learning outcomes. Therefore, we presented an online assessment system for students’ classroom learning outcomes based on social constructivism learning theory. The system consists of five modules, including a library of questions, the task design, the task management, the results management, and the user management. Instructors can easily set up an online test with this system. And students can submit their answers on their mobile phones. We used this system experimentally in classroom teaching in higher education. The results show that students participated in the interaction actively. More students answered questions on the mobile phones with this system, while fewer students raised hands to answer questions. The system helps both the teacher and students better to understand learning objectives and learning outcomes than the traditional question- answer method. The teacher could timely perceive students' learning outcomes through the submissions, which guides successive strategies for teaching and learning. Therefore, instructors can employ this system in their classrooms to improve the quality of learning in higher education.

articleTitle: Evaluate a country’s system health of higher education based on PCA and GA-BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The expansion of higher education has had a far-reaching impact on all dimensions of society and higher education system. Thus, the paper constructs three indexes (Development Index, Innovation Index and Opportunity Index) according to the selected ten indicators through PCA and puts forward a new method to evaluate a country’s system health of higher education from 3 indexes with GA-BP neural network and BARS. Combined with 8 years’ data (2013-2020) from WDI, it fits the fact to some degree (America ranks the first in the system health of higher education, South Africa ranks the last and Germany, Japan and Australia rank the same). Taking Japan as an example, the author proposes 3 suggestions but they all need the government’s support, which brings some difficulties to Japan’s government. Consequently, to propose a method has significant importance for the sustainable and healthy development of higher education and lays a solid foundation for further empirical researches on policies.

articleTitle: Research on the Live Teaching Effect Based on Multimodal Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the intelligent education era, multimodal data fusion analysis becomes a trend and a key method to address issues in education and teaching. As live teaching grows rapidly, the analysis of teaching effect is facing challenges of dynamic data collection, as well as multimodal data fusion analysis. Based on analyzing the connotation of multimodal data as well as research status-quo of live teaching, and with the assistance of EEG identification and facial expression identification among other technologies, the article carried out the analysis and experiment on live teaching performance based on multimodal data fusion, and discussed the role that multimodal data fusion played in the analysis of live teaching performance with respects to knowledge retention, students satisfaction, sense of presence, and interaction, etc., and eventually came with an optimization strategy for lives teaching activities with the support of multimodal data fusion and analysis. The research concluded that multimodal data fusion analysis enabled the all-round multidimensional recording of the live teaching process, brought about more comprehensive performance analysis of different teaching periods, and provided data support to tutoring.

articleTitle: Multimodal and Multidimensional Interaction in the Gold Course Construction of Military English Based on Data and Information Processing Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The rapid integration of modern information technology with higher education essentially facilitates the ongoing Gold Class construction of military English course which claims innovativeness, higher order, and challenge. Dwelling upon Cloud Computing, Big Data, Artificial Intelligence, and other new media technologies, a data and information processing model can be established by taking into account such variables as students’ static features of academic learning, dynamic behaviors of class performance, and constraint conditions like teaching content, topic and so on. Through the model, appropriate materials can be precisely selected and processed, and multimodal and multidimensional interaction can be scientifically designed, which essentially promotes the quality and efficiency of teaching and learning.

articleTitle: Research on Multimedia Technology in Music Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In today's rapid development of information technology, multimedia computer technology has become one of the hot research topics, multimedia has accelerated the communication of human information, greatly shortened the path of human information transmission, it has brought a huge impact on all aspects of the traditional computer technology. Internationally, educational technology is rapidly toward multimedia, realizing the combination of computer technology and education, embodied in: computer assisted teaching (CAI), computer assisted learning (CAL), computer management teaching (CMI), computer assisted education management (CAEM), educational information processing, educational information database, computer education, teaching consulting, etc., and computer multimedia assisted teaching involves the widest and the greatest influence. Aiming at the application research of multimedia in music teaching, this paper puts forward its own opinions and analyzes the actual situation of multimedia teaching.

articleTitle: Diverse Teaching Methods of Detector Circuits Based on Signal Theory and Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The principles and noise suppression characteristics analysis of detector circuits are the focus and difficulty in the course of measurement and control circuits. Through the working principle’s theoretical analysis of detector circuits, which is based on the combination of time domain and frequency domain and the combination of formula and waveform, the Matlab-based theoretical simulation, the circuit principle analysis of detector circuits, the Multisim-based circuit simulation, and the in-depth analysis of noise suppression characteristics, which is based on the combination of signal system theory and actual circuit, students are able to understand and master the principles and characteristics of phase-sensitive detector circuits and envelope detector circuits. The diversified three-dimensional teaching methods based on the signal theory and the information simulation technology have been practiced and validated in the teaching of measurement and control circuits, which can serve as a model for other circuit-related courses.

articleTitle: Research on application of cloud computing technology in blended learning based on access control model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Nowadays, with the rapid development of information technology, Internet informatization in the field of education is moving forward in continuous expansion. Educational informatization is an opportunity and challenge that must be met in education and teaching. The MOOC based on information technology based on cloud computing technology platform arises at the historic moment, the web-based storage resource and computing resource technology for large-scale high quality learning experience to create a new environment, and access control model covers all the entities in cloud computing, cloud computing access control is to ensure that the user security access to important aspects of cloud resources. The safe and effective implementation of blended learning is also achieved by cloud computing under access control. Through theoretical and practical analysis, this paper explores whether the blended learning supported by such technology is effective for college students who have more opportunities for independent learning, and studies the effect of blended learning by combining computer model and real questionnaire survey, in order to provide beneficial help for the innovation of education informatization in China.

articleTitle: Analysis of Application Algorithm Based on Information Entropy Uncertainty in College Entrance Examination Volunteer Report : Taking Inner Mongolia College Entrance Examination as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: China’s college entrance examination has always been closely watched. With the access of big data technology, examinees across the country have different calculation and analysis methods in the selection of colleges and major objectives during the application process of college entrance examination. Because the college entrance examination policies are not completely the same in all provinces and cities, this paper predicts the risk of Inner Mongolia college entrance examination voluntary filling, and puts forward a trinity comprehensive evaluation algorithm. The first dimensional algorithm mainly introduces the theory of information entropy and calculates its uncertainty to quantify the value-at-risk, setting the discrete information source through probability statistics. The second dimensional algorithm and the third dimensional algorithm are evaluated by the current mainstream algorithms. Through the cross analysis of three different dimensions of algorithms, an effective and feasible application algorithm can be formed, which can realize the risk prediction of all targets by using the open data in college application. Through the test of the real data, t The final prediction error in admit fractional line 2-3 points or so. This algorithm has been one of the high precision algorithms among all the visible prediction algorithms in the current society, and it also provides a novel reference direction for researchers in this field.

articleTitle: Informationized classroom risk analysis and coping strategies
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Project risk management plays an important role in the whole project life cycle and has a key influence on the final success of the project. According to the risk analysis theory of project management, this paper analyzes a series of Informationized classroom pilot project and makes corresponding measures. This paper mainly includes five parts: project establishment background, risk identification, risk quantification, risk countermeasures, monitoring and summary. The risk analysis of the Informationized classroom project can be used as a reference to promote and apply the risk analysis method studied to other projects.

articleTitle: Research on Student Curriculum Selection Recommendation System Based on Graph Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In recent years, the recommendation systems based on knowledge graph have been widely used by researchers, however, existing systems are mostly applied in people’s daily life. This paper proposes a new model of student curriculum selection recommendation system based on graph convolutional network, aiming at providing personalized curriculum selection recommendation for students. In this model, the graph convolution network is used to propagate the embedding from the neighbor of nodes to update the new representation of the nodes, then aggregate the representation of students and curriculums, and output the predicted matching score, so as to realize the personalized curriculum selection recommendation of students.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Post Competency Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The good construction of vocational education needs support from rich course resources of all posts. This paper puts forward the Post Competency Model into solving this requirement in vocational education, refining the post competency elements, establishing the competency model, and constructing the professional curriculum system based on post competency, and all-round implementation of learning on a specific post. The construction of post competency model makes the staff’s post ability improvement and career planning have a fundamental follow.

articleTitle: The Chain Mediation Roles of Mastery Goal Orientation and Cognitive Flexibility between Perceived ICT Competence and Reading Strategy: Based on the PISA 2018 Data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The current COVID-19 pandemic increased most students’ utilization of Information and Communication Technology (ICT). This study was designed to examine the impact of students’ ICT use on a specific contributing element to their academic performances, reading comprehension strategies. In order to test the mediational effect of mastery goal orientation and cognitive flexibility in this relationship, the researcher conducted a secondary analysis using computer-delivered survey data from PISA 2018 with over one hundred thousand 15-year-old students from various countries and regions. Pearson correlation analysis and mediation model with the Bootstrap method from SPSS were adopted to examine relationships between variables and verify the hypotheses. This study supported the researcher’s three hypotheses, demonstrating a significant positive correlation between students’ perceived competence in ICT and the productiveness of their approach to comprehend and remember reading passages. In addition, it revealed significant mediational effects for mastery goal orientation and cognitive flexibility both individually and combined as a chain mediation.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction Method of Sergeant Education Practice Teaching Condition Based on Smart Classroom
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Aiming at the current problems in the practice and teaching of sergeant education such as weak teachers, lack of teaching resources, and single training environment; Introduce smart classrooms into practical teaching of noncommissioned officers, make full use of the network cloud platform to promote the construction of practical teaching conditions, and give principles for the construction of practical teaching conditions for noncommissioned officer education. From the perspectives of faculty optimization, training materials construction, actual combat training environment construction, and support system development, the countermeasures for the construction of practical teaching conditions for non-commissioned officer education under the perspective of smart classrooms are proposed; students can learn and consolidate course content and absorb the latest knowledge anytime and anywhere. Effectively improve the actual combat ability of trainees.

articleTitle: Research on the Visual Language Application of Guangxi Bronze Drum Decorations Based on SPSS Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the rapid development of new media technology, there are many problems to be solved in the decoration of new media bronze drums. This paper takes Guangxi local bronze drums as the research sample, based on the results of SPSS analysis, from the perspective of semiotics, through literature research and field research, using Saussure's signifier and signified Language Semiotics Theory and Morris's trisection semiotics theory system, The visual symbols of Guangxi bronze drum decoration are systematically analyzed, and then a high- quality media is established according to the data information of cloud computing and big data platform from the perspective of new media. The morphological evolution of the logo decoration is carried out by using the design methods of "decoration generalization", "scattered reconstruction" and "repeated addition" in modern design, and an intelligent data platform for bronze drum decoration visual language design is established, Realize the inheritance and innovation of bronze drum cultural design.

articleTitle: Blended Teaching Design in Higher Education Based on Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper aims to compare the advantages and disadvantages of traditional offline teaching and massive open online course (MOOC) learning, build a three-space system of blended teaching in higher education, and explore blended teaching design based on the deep learning model. Through online and offline blended teaching, a data set of multifaceted teaching information is formed to provide strong support for learning diagnosis, classroom observation, and course assessment, which finally brings about effective, efficient, engaging, and personalized teaching design. Statistics show that blended teaching design based on the deep learning model can significantly improve students' satisfaction with courses and enhance their practical ability to analyze and solve problems.

articleTitle: Research on “Interactive” Teaching Mode of Business English Major under the Background of “Internet plus”
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Under the background of the continuous development and wide application of Internet information technology, there is a problem of insufficient interaction between teachers and students and between students in the current business English teaching process in colleges and universities. The interactive teaching platform of business English based on Web technology developed through MVC mode and process languages such as ASP and PHP can effectively meet the demand of applied talents cultivation of business English major in colleges and universities, and change the teaching mode of business English major in colleges and universities, so as to realize the teaching reform of business English in colleges and universities under the background of "internet plus" and improve the efficiency of talents cultivation.

articleTitle: Using Web Crawler Technology to Realize the Cross- cultural Communication of "Foreign online Celebrities" Videos on the Internet Platform : —Take the example of "I am Jerry Kowal"
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the continuous iteration of online video platforms supported by big data, artificial intelligence, and internet technology, the phenomenon of "Foreign Online Celebrities" is increasingly becoming an important subject in the creation, production and dissemination of online video content. Behind this is an inevitable choice for the connection of existing network media. And more blessings of new media technology and algorithm tools. With the help of data mining methods of computational communication and the analysis theory of digital humanities, this paper analyzes how " Foreign Online Celebrities " use media platforms to connect Chinese and foreign cultures and their audiences. Using computer crawler technology to obtain the "I am Jerry Kowal " account data on the Bilibili platform as the research content, and using "the DEEPL Model" and "the Hidden Markov Model" to visualize the video keywords. The paper explores the main factors of the blogger’s use of internet technology to spread video narratives across cultures, and investigate the technical and non-technical characteristics of its content dissemination In-depth analysis, pointed out that the cross-cultural communication network video narrative strategy from the perspective of the "other" has an enlightening effect on the "going out" of local video uploaders and the innovative exploration of digital communication.

articleTitle: On-line and Off-line Teaching Reform of Inorganic and Analytical Chemistry Course based on Chaoxing Learning APP
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The essence of education is to cultivate people. In order to meet the needs of social development and cultivate high quality applied talents with innovative spirit, the Inorganic and Analytical Chemistry Courses in colleges and universities take the starting point of establishing moral education, and use Chaoxing Learning APP multimedia informatization teaching platform. This paper explores the implementation of ideological and political education in the online-offline hybrid teaching model, to reform teaching methods, to combine knowledge points with cases and ideological and political education, to reform examination methods, to break the limitation of time and space in the classroom, and to evaluate students’ comprehensive performance in the whole process of learning, improve the professional knowledge and skills of students and moral civilization, promote the overall development of students, to meet the changing employment environment and market demand.

articleTitle: Gender Difference in study habits & school engagement and their reflection on average test scores in Mathematics and Spanish by data processing
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper focuses on investigating gender differences in study habits and school engagement, and how these gender differences translate into average test score differences in Mathematics and Spanish by data processing. Data being used was in a nationwide database from Mexico that covers both students from public and private schools in grades 3,4,5,6,7,8,9 and 12, which was obtained from a large random sample of schools administered to students, parents, teachers, and principals. This paper uses linear regression lines from the OLS(Ordinary Least Square) model to verify the existence of gender inconsistent of both Mathematics and Spanish scores and males’ advantages in both subjects. This paper also concludes that gender differences had a positive influence on the scores of both males and females. However, due to the lack of tracking from the data that sample size is sharply dropping by years, this paper failed to avoid all the omitted variables that would influence the result, but they also might be balanced by other variables.

articleTitle: Challenges and Countermeasures of the Ideological and Political Education for Social Enrollment in Higher Vocational Colleges Based on SPSS Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Expanding enrollment by one million is both an opportunity and a challenge for higher vocational colleges. Based on the data analysis of educational level, enrollment source and age structure of social enrollment of Foshan Polytechnic, SPSS and EXCEL are used for data processing, we find three prominent ideological characteristics of social enrollment which are socialization of thinking mode, practical learning motivation, and multiple stress anxiety. These characteristics have brought great challenges to the current education concept, teaching mode and position of ideological and political education. Therefore, higher vocational colleges must take morality education as the soul, persist in the "leading" role of ideological and political courses, strengthening the "syncretic" effect of professional courses, bring into play the "harmony" effect of culture, and enhance the function of "enlightenment" of practical teaching in order to effectively improve the pertinence and effectiveness of ideological and political education.

articleTitle: Research on the Reform of Practice Teaching Based on OBE-CDIO
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems in practical teaching of industrial engineering courses, in order to cultivate students’ abilities and comprehensive qualities at different levels, this paper discusses the construction of practical teaching system of industrial design courses under the OBE-CDIO. After analyzing the curriculum design features and combining with industry demand, the specific courses are reverse-designed. According to the OBE-CDIO, taking students as the center, the curriculum was reformed and practiced in terms of design content, teaching methods, teaching schedule, and evaluation methods by using group learning and team design methods. The purpose is to cultivate students’ comprehensive ability of independent learning, teamwork, innovation, and solving practical problems. The practice shows that the curriculum reform plays an effective supporting role in the cultivation of students’ comprehensive ability under the background of innovative ability cultivation.

articleTitle: Literature Review of SPOC’s Development in China
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Although the concept of SPOC was not first put forward by Chinese scholars, it has been fully applied all over in China. SPOC is a kind of online offline blended learning whose online teaching resources are limited to MOOCs. It is generally recognized that in the teaching design of a SPOC course, 20% - 50% of the teaching time should be arranged for students to carry out independent online MOOCs learning, and the remaining time should be used for offline learning. Therefore, when doing SPOC’s literature review, we should also review the development of blended learning and MOOC in China, because they are highly related.

articleTitle: Visual Analysis of Research Progress of Design Management Based on Citespace
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Through the theoretical framework and practice of design management, the evolution of domestic design management in the past 20 years and the hot spots. In this paper, CNKI was used as the data source, literature research method, scientific measurement method and knowledge graph software Citespace and SATI were used to draw knowledge graphs of authors, institutions, journals and keywords, and to make frequency statistics. The research literature of design management was divided into three stages in time, and the authors, institutions and journals were analyzed. The cluster map was used to reveal the research hotspots, and finally the summary and suggestions were put forward.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of the Topic Selection and Guidance System of College Graduation Thesis Based on Web
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Graduation design is the main method for colleges and universities to assess students’ learning during college. It is a severe challenge for college students who are about to embark on the society. Whether or not they can successfully complete the challenges will also be related to the graduation of college students. Over the past years, the task of thesis selection for domestic colleges and universities has been more onerous, and there are many problems, such as statistical data, modify data. The content of this design is the topic selection and guidance system of graduation thesis. The system uses the Java language for development, combines the SSH framework optimization code, and the JSP dynamic page development technology. The development tool uses the more comprehensive MyEclipse, and the database uses the more common MySql.The development and research of this system was developed to meet the needs of the development of higher education informatization. Since the topic of graduation thesis is required for each student to complete, the statistical data of the selected topic is also more tedious. After the data statistics are completed, it needs to be summarized to the academic affairs. In the management department, traditional manual topic selection methods are prone to unavoidable errors, resulting in low accuracy of the data. The text data is susceptible to loss due to many factors, resulting in poor data integrity. The educational administration department and students cannot communicate directly. Teachers interact with each other, leading to inefficiency and waste of human and material resources. There will also be missed elections, by-elections, re-elections, etc., and the implementation will be very complicated. Due to the influence of many factors above, it is difficult to select topics for graduation. The system can meet the real-time and effective work of the dissertation without geographical constraints. It is a major breakthrough in time and space. The thesis selection and guidance system It can ensure the fairness and openness of the topics selected, as well as ensure the accuracy and integrity of the data.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Learning Environment in the Education of People with Dyslexia
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the intelligent learning environment, the full use of intelligent teaching system and artificial intelligence technology to help teachers achieve accurate teaching and promote the development of dyslexia is still quite vacant in China. This paper takes "intelligent learning environment" as the main line and summarizes the intelligent education technology and application in different historical development stages. At the same time, based on the behavioral characteristics of dyslexics, the functions and characteristics of the most promising intelligent technologies such as intelligent perception, learning analysis and affective computing are analyzed in detail, and the future prospects of the application of intelligent learning environment in the education of dyslexics are proposed.

articleTitle: Elaboration of Mobility Dependent on Temperature in Doped Semiconductors with Proposed Playground Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: A playground model is proposed to elaborate on the dependence of carrier mobility on temperature in doped semiconductors. In the proposed model, carriers are subject to coulomb scattering of ionized impurities and move clockwise in a circular motion. When the carrier moves to the position underlying the ionized impurity, it moves away from the ionized impurity along a straight line. When it moves to the position underlying the neighboring ionized impurity, the carrier is captured by the ionized impurity, and its motion trail converts from the linear motion to the clockwise uniform circular motion. Thus, the playground model is constructed, and the carrier is constrained by two neighboring ionized impurities which are far apart. The carrier’s motion period is composed of both the coulomb scattering time in the circular motion and the non-coulomb interaction time in two straight lines. When the temperature increases, the velocity of the carrier increases, and it moves toward the direction far away from the ionized impurities because the Coulomb force is not increased.
