In this progress, the velocity of the carrier reduces because the carrier does work against the Coulomb forces. Finally, the carrier moves in a larger circle with decreased velocity. Thus, the Coulomb scattering time increases in the high temperature, and non-Coulomb interaction time also increases due to the reduced velocity. According the calculation formula of the mobility in microscale, the conclusion that the mobility in doped semiconductors increases with the increased temperature is easily drawn due to the increased free movement time. Up to now, we think that the proposed playground model provides a useful manner to elaborate on the dependence of carrier mobility on temperature in doped semiconductors, and the concept is clearly defined, and the calculation process is simple, logical, and easily accepted by the beginners.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Knowledge Graph for Aerospace Product Quality Problems
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Aiming at the decision-making problem under the condition of information overload in the quality management of aerospace products, a method is proposed to improve the quality and the efficiency of decision-making by establishing a quality problem knowledge graph. We established a top-down quality problem knowledge graph construction process model and designed the data model layer of the quality problem knowledge graph. With the reference of the designed knowledge graph, we constructed the concept-attribute-relationship ontology model of quality problem knowledge and put forward the strategy of knowledge entity and relationship integration. Finally, a knowledge management system for product quality problem was developed and initially applied in an aerospace product development enterprise. The results of the research can provide a reference for the intelligent application of quality big data.

articleTitle: Explore the IP-based Development of New Media on the Internet : Taking WeChat Public Platform as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the intensification of market competition and audience differentiation, IP-based development has become an important development tool for online new media. The paper summarizes the three main models of vertical matrix, horizontal linkage and cooperative authorization for IP development of online new media, taking WeChat public platform as an example, and points out the considerations for IP development of online new media, such as user demand-oriented, original content-based, maximizing value through the development of diversified products and continuous effective fan interaction.

articleTitle: Network Information Security Management in the Era of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the advent of the era of big data, information technology has been rapidly developed and the application of computers has been popularized. However, network technology is a double-edged sword. While providing convenience, it also faces many problems, among which there are many hidden dangers of network information security. Based on this, based on the era background of big data, the network information security analysis, explore the main network security problems, and elaborate computer information network security matters needing attention, to strengthen the network security management, and put forward countermeasures, so as to improve the level of network security.

articleTitle: The Study of Design and Restoration of The Architecture Digital System in Hebei Ancient Villages
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the advent of the digital architecture era that features the combination of "traditional architectural art elements" and "digital technology", we need to deconstruct the texture and color of the ancient village building surface materials and architectural components design characteristics, and reconstruct a standardized, modular, information-based digital model to form the digital language. As a result, the cultural and artistic elements of the ancient village architecture in Hebei Province can be fully preserved and even extended in various forms in contemporary architectural design. The design and restoration of the digital architectural model system provide a new way to display and preserve the architectural heritage of ancient villages.

articleTitle: College ideological and political teaching resource system model based on multimedia technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The teaching resource model of ideological and political education in colleges and universities uses multimedia technology to build a complex deep network model and extract rich teaching knowledge from massive Internet data. Through the data analysis function of multimedia technology, the ideological and political system of colleges and universities is systematically analyzed, including three parts: exploratory data analysis, model selection analysis, data inference analysis, and accurate judgment and analysis of ideological and political model by using data statistics method. Multimedia technology shares data collection in ideological and political teaching resources in colleges and universities, thus providing powerful data extraction, conversion and loading capabilities for the teaching system. This paper mainly studies from three aspects of teaching system model, platform model construction and model evaluation. Combined with the practical application of multimedia in the ideological and political field of colleges and universities, it analyzes the problems existing in multimedia technology and provides a new direction for comprehensively mastering the research of teaching resource sharing mode.

articleTitle: Research on the design of campus culture and art workshop from the perspective of intelligent design
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Intelligent design makes the computer more intelligent by integrating modern information technology. The campus culture and art workshop from the perspective of intelligent design takes college students as the main body and campus culture as the object. It takes the spiritual culture, environmental culture, behavior culture and design culture of the university campus as its main content. Combined with the professional practice needs of college students, it creates a professional practice space suitable for college students and enriches their professional practice experience. Through the preliminary analysis, it explores the requirements suitable for the function of college students' art workshops. The art workshop creates an art space suitable for the actual needs of college students and provides more employment opportunities for college students.

articleTitle: Study of the flexible control of the robot welding and its application in the training teaching of the welding technology and Engineering
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: High flexibility and high reliability robot welding technology represents the development direction of high-end manufacturing industry in the future. In this paper, the flexible control process of robot welding was studied, and a robot workstation that could realize flexible welding was established. Taking the specialty of welding technology and engineering as an example, the robot was integrated into the undergraduate training teaching, the control accuracy of the robot was analyzed, and the automatic welding of robot was investigated by using the method of tungsten argon arc welding, Effects of welding speed and welding current on mechanical properties of stainless steel welded joints. The results showed that the control accuracy could reach 0.1mm through this robot workstation and the welding effect was reliable, which significantly stimulates the students' enthusiasm for the practical training of welding technology and engineering. The effect results of welding speed and welding current on the mechanical properties of antibacterial stainless steel welded joints indicated that the welding speed affected the tensile strength greater.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study Based on the Analysis of Spss Technology in Group Psychological Counseling to Promote the Mental Health of Community Residents
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The spss software is often used to process data such as variance analysis and regression analysis between factor variables to verify the empirical utility of the research. This article uses SPSS software technology to analyze the empirical effect of group psychological counseling on improving the mental health of community residents. Through the comparison between the experimental group and the control group, the empirical effect of group psychological counseling on improving residents' mental health and subjective well-being is verified. The study found that the mental health level of the experimental group changed significantly, and the subjective well-being was significantly improved, while the control group had no significant difference, indicating that group psychological counseling has good practical value for improving the mental health and subjective well-being of residents.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of the Internet Technology on the Self-identity of College Students Based on Support Vector Machine Optimization Alogrithm
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The college students’ self-identity refers to the process of self-exploration and self-affirmation formed. Internet technology has triggered the contradiction between real-world communication based on physical identities and virtual social communication. College students’ desire for careness and the "identity absence" in the virtual world are contradictory, causing a crisis of self-identity among college students. Meanwhile, Support Vector Machine (SVM) as one of the machine learning methods is of importance in statistical learning technology. Because of its high efficiency, good performance and wide applications in classification, forecasting, and estimation, the SVM has become the most recognized method in learning machines. Therefore, this paper applies the Support Vector Machine optimization algorithm in Matlab language to quantify the relationship between college students’ online time and identity, seeking to find a balance between virtual and real life for college students. Through the study of questionnaires, we find three characteristics of college students’ self-identity. We take these three data as the independent variables, and the average hours of weekly online time of college students as the dependent variable. By the SVM alogrithm, the model between self-identity and the hours of the network usage per week is created. Based on this, we can calculate the balance point, which means the healthy self- identity with surfing the Internet. The model shows that 40 hours should be the best hours for college students spending time online per week. Exceeding these hours will have a negative impact on the self-identity of college students. Also, it is necessary to lead college students to improve their comprehensive ability, and finally overcome the challenge of Internet technology to college students’ self-identity.

articleTitle: Exploring the application of computer network technology in international cooperation and communication of universities in the post-epidemic era
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the post-epidemic era, the international cooperation and exchange work of universities faces a new development pattern and diversified challenges. The complexity and diversity of information resources are becoming more and more obvious, and the importance of computer network technology development and the difficulty of development are gradually increasing. Universities should make full use of data and information processing technology to actively carry out education and teaching, academic exchange, scientific research and teachers' professional growth with the idea of online education and "local internationalization". According to the categories of comprehensive universities, engineering and technology universities, and application-oriented undergraduate universities, they should dig out valuable data from the huge amount of information, expand the scale of Sino-foreign cooperative education, improve the level of education, and adhere to the development of special features.

articleTitle: The Effect of Big Data on English Teaching on the Application of Big Data in English Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In recent years, the application of big data technology in various fields has also attracted very close attention from many scholars and experts. Some experts proficient in big data technology connect English teaching with big data technology, which also helps to further develop the application and development of English teaching in big data technology. This article will also study through the analysis of the significance and function of big data technology, and also explores more new development ideas and points out the difficulties of English teaching in big data technology. At the same time, this article also points out the specific implementation measures, paths and methods of computer big data technology in English teaching. This also helps to enrich computer big data technology to conduct English teaching, and also lay a very good foundation for the quality of English teaching.

articleTitle: Bert-based Text-to-SQL Generation method with question-table content enhancement and template filling
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Generating SQL queries through natural language is a way to both reduce the cost of learning SQL for users and improve the efficiency of data queries, and has attracted great interest in recent years. To address this problem, the text proposes a new approach: building feature vectors by linking question and table contents, then building a classification model on top of a pretrained BERT for fine-tuning, and breaking down the Text2SQL process into multiple sub-processes based on template populated multi-classification, using both a general classification model and a conditional value classification model to generate SQL. The conditional value model relies on the results of the general classification model and is optimized using an exhaustive combination. This approach was tested on the WikiSQL dataset and yielded at least 9.8% improvement in accuracy and very good results on the decomposed subtasks, with an accuracy of 85.3% on the test set.

articleTitle: Research on the Interactive Technology Enabling the Animation Display and Dissemination of Jingchu Famous Towns" from the Perspective of the Rural Revitalization Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With development of the society, improvement in intelligent technology, interactive technology comes into being and becomes a strong support for rural vitalization development in a new era. Under the grand background of digital strategy, interactive technology should be applied to the display and dissemination of "Jinchu famous towns" animations. It’s an innovation on traditional animation as it can fully display the art of animation and allows viewers to participate. In the meantime, we shall creatively use interactive technology to enhance viewer’s sense of fulfillment and experience and realize the goal of using interactive technology to support the innovative development of "Jinchu famous towns" animations.

articleTitle: An empirical analysis of the flipped classroom about information literacy education in Chinese university based on SPSS 19.0
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The flipped classroom provides a teaching-learning method for colleges and universities concerning information literacy under the new technology environment. This study is an empirical study on the flipped classroom of information literacy lectures in a university in Guangzhou. The study compares students’ learning situations and feedback information before and after the experiment by SPSS 19.0 software; then sorting the students’ performance data, T-distribution and Pearson by using the data editing function of SPSS; finally, the data editing function of SPSS is used to remove outliers of students’ classroom evaluation. The results show that applying flipped classrooms to information literacy courses possesses remarkable effects in improving students’ learning initiative and sustainability, cooperation and innovation, learning satisfaction, understanding and application of knowledge. It aims to explore the influencing factors of flipped classroom teaching on students’ learning and provide a reference for relevant teaching-learning and research in universities in the future.

articleTitle: Research on R & D post demand analysis system based on K-means clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In recent years, there has been a structural contradiction of mismatch between supply and demand in China’s talent market, especially in the field of big data. Accurately perceiving and describing the demand of the labor market is an important means to solve this problem. In this study, the names of recruitment posts are clustered by big data analysis methods such as Chinese word segmentation and K-means, and four job clusters such as software engineer, algorithm engineer, a product manager and product architect are identified; Then, the probabilistic topic allocation (LDA) model is used to cluster the recruitment requirements, and five skill sets such as database, machine learning, pattern recognition, big data and programming are obtained; Finally, the demand matrix of job clusters for their skill sets is obtained by LDA to analyze the demand degree of job clusters for their job skills. The results show that the programming ability is the most important for AI software engineers. The theory and technology of pattern recognition are the most important for algorithm engineers. The post of a product manager has strong skill requirements for database, machine learning and big data technology. The theory and technology of machine learning are the most important to product architects. The research results can provide technical support for universities and enterprises to normalize or accurately perceive and describe the labor market demand of big data technology R&D posts in real time.

articleTitle: Application of Data-Driven Learning in College English Writing in Multimedia Network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Data-driven learning method is the main way for college students to learn English and strengthen their self-study ability. Data-driven learning method has the characteristics of various learning modes. By using data-driven learning method, searching in the corpus and analyzing the corpus, the language rules can be summarized.

articleTitle: The L2 Motivation Factors and L2 Intended Learning Effort: A Model-based Data Analysis of Chinese College EFL Learners
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This study was aimed to investigate the relationship between the theory of L2 Motivational Self System(L2MSS) and the learners’ actual achievement. A total of 838 Chinese undergraduate students who are majoring in agriculture and engineering, responded to a questionnaire based on the three main constructs of L2MSS, included Ideal L2 self, Ought-to L2 self, and L2 learning Experience. The participants’ L2 achievement was then measured with the College English Test 4 and 6 (CET4/6). This study analyzed the data based on a model method. Descriptive analyses of the data revealed that the main constructs of the L2MSS were predicted well of the learners’ intended learning efforts. Furthermore, some suggestions for research on the motivation of technical-related major college students to learn English are also given.

articleTitle: Research on the interaction between higher education structure and industrial structure in Liaoning Province Based on Experimental Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the development and progress of society, education and economy are closely related, and higher education is an important part of the social development process, and whether its internal structure is reasonable or not is very crucial for economic development. Taking Liaoning province as the research object, the interaction between higher education structure and industrial structure in Liaoning province is analyzed by using the combination of theoretical analysis method and empirical analysis; after that, the interaction between higher education structure and industrial structure is not formed by using gray correlation analysis; finally, it is combined with the proposal of optimizing the discipline setting to adapt to the industrial structure adjustments and realizing the dynamic balance between higher education and industrial structure Finally, we propose the suggestions for optimizing the discipline settings to adapt to industrial restructuring and realize the dynamic balance between higher education and industrial structure.

articleTitle: Capability analysis of American Military communication System based on advanced information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Communication system is composed of transmission, exchange, terminal and other elements, using transmission, communication network and security, optical communication, multimedia communication and other technologies to achieve information transfer of all kinds of networks and systems. This paper first introduces the main situation of the strategic, theater and tactical communication systems of the United States army. Secondly, it analyzes the three main characteristics of the communication system of the US army, namely, the development of the technology-driven by the operational concept, the close connection with the important command organization and the emphasis on the integration of mature commercial technology. Finally, four kinds of capabilities of the US military communication system are summarized, which can ensure the uninterrupted command, provide a safe and reliable command environment, provide a highly elastic command communication network and compress the period of command decision.

articleTitle: An Index Analysis Method Reflecting the Influence of Film Works Based on Experimental and Mathematical Statistics Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Based on the concept of H factor proposed by Hirsch, this paper first searches out the top 135 domestic box office movies in the past 10 years, filter the data that will cause interference, and use the same method to get the number of times they appeared in academic journals. Through the correlation analysis and comparison with Douban score and box office performance, we draw a conclusion, that is, the number of times films appeared in academic journals can reflect the influence of film works. It is highly correlated with Douban score and the number of evaluators, but not with the box office. By analyzing the data, some conclusions are drawn. The criteria for judging the success of a film should not be limited to box office performance, and also should comprehensively consider the influence of the film in other aspects. The number of films cited in academic journals is also an indicator of film influence, which needs to be analyzed by relevant research.

articleTitle: Intermedia agenda setting between Microblog and WeChat - A Case Study of "Fake Jindong" Event
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The boom of new media has not only changed the traditional media structure, but also make the agenda setting between media become a new research hotspot. In this paper, third-party retrieval tools are used to retrieve the "Fake Jindong" event information on Microblog and WeChat platforms, and web crawler technology is used to capture the data. Content analysis is used to analyze the information flow between Microblog and WeChat platforms, with the purpose of verifying whether media agenda setting exists between the two new media platforms. It is found that there is a phenomenon of issue interaction between Microblog and WeChat platform in the first level of issue setting, while "interaction" and "rupture" coexist in the second level of attribute agenda setting. This discovery can provide reference for the dissemination and guidance of online public opinion.

articleTitle: Research on market data mining of business plan based on dynamic time series
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: At present, most dynamic data mining algorithms are improved algorithms of static data mining algorithms. The business plan contains a variety of different types of market data. The correlation of market data and the prediction of data are applicable to subsequent roadshows. Therefore, this paper proposes an analysis and Research on market data mining technology based on dynamic time series. Making full use of the interdependent characteristics of various time series data, the likelihood space transformed from time series data is created by hidden Markov model, and then the dynamic characteristics of time series data are classified by hierarchical clustering. The practical application results show that the proposed algorithm is suitable for the analysis and mining of required data, and supports the writing and roadshow of business plan.

articleTitle: Research on Online Public Opinion Education of College Students Baesd on Internet Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the new development period, the network ideological and political education of college students has problems such as insufficient supervision of network information, insufficient effectiveness of network education content, insufficient construction of teaching staff, and poor network literacy of college students. This paper applies Association Rules for extracting the rules behind public opinion education, takes advantage of Linear Regression to describe the relationship among the variables that models the relationship between one or more independent and dependent variables using a least-square function called a linear regression equation. It puts forward that the effective integration with information technology can accelerate the collection of public opinion samples, and comprehensive analysis of communication channels and public opinion types, and can carry out early warning and prediction, then pays attention to the strategies of strengthening the network supervision, purifying the network environment, improving the effectiveness of the content of network education, strengthening the construction of teachers and cultivating the network literacy of college students, so as to promote the development of the network ideological and political education of college students in the new period.

articleTitle: New progress in the paradigm of elicited deception : Application of human-computer interaction in deception detection
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Deception is common in our lives, and over the past few decades. There has been a great deal of scientific interest in the field of deception and deception detection. The question of whether microexpressions can detect deception is controversial, but the introduction of iBorderCtrl at EU borders in recent years seems to have answered the question. IBorderCtrl uses human-computer interaction technology to identify people at the border when they are visiting. In view of this, human-computer interaction may be one of the future research trends of face recognition, micro-expression recognition and deception detection. In general, there are still few types of research on micro-expression deception detection in the world. In particular, there is little systematic information about how to induce deception states. This work is an important work for micro-expression deception detection. Therefore, this paper first reviews the research on deception detection and how to induce deception state in the last twenty years. Then the application of human-computer interaction in deception detection is discussed and a new prospect of the combination of human-computer interaction and deception detection is proposed.

articleTitle: The application of big data technology in the assessment model of college student’s entrepreneurial intention
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the continuous development of China’s Internet technology, the entrepreneurial trend of " Internet + innovation and entrepreneurship " concept has emerged. In the era of "Internet+ ", how to make full use of big data to seize the opportunity for in innovation and entrepreneurship while better preventing the risk of entrepreneurship has become a serious realistic problem. Based on the triadic interaction theory, the conceptual model between influencing factor, entrepreneurial self-efficacy and entrepreneurial intention was constructed. Through descriptive statistical analysis, correlation analysis, and regression analysis of 291 questionnaires by SPSS 23.0 software, the study found that personal traits had a significant positive influence on college students ' entrepreneurial intention ; entrepreneurial self-efficacy played a mediating role in the influence of influencing factor on entrepreneurial intention.

articleTitle: Exploration of "Tace to Point" Practical Teaching Mode Based on Online and Offline Blending Teaching — Taking the Course of Fundamentals of Web Design As an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In view of the problems existing in the practical teaching of the course "Fundamentals of web design" in local colleges and universities, such as the separation of theory and skills, backward teaching design, compressed class hours and few practical links, this paper constructs a practical teaching system of "technology supported, face-to-point" based on online and offline blending teaching, focusing on the cultivation of technical ability to improve students’ application and practical ability, so that the quality of talent training can meet the requirements of applied talents.

Author Keywords: the Course of Fundamentals of Web Design

articleTitle: The linear characteristics of concept time: synchrony and diachrony, N-Gram Markov Language Model, new media education
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Saussure introduced us to synchronicity and diachronism; indicators and meanings in general linguistics courses. This basic set of opposites can study any human phenomenon, which is based on a system of contrasts and combinatorial relations between regularized indicative elements. In this article, the author is committed to analyzing and summarizing the concept of N-Gram Markov language Model and specific steps, and using this language model to analyze the manifestation of time linear characteristics in language variants. We try to find out the role of the concept of time in the change of youth are in different eras, and the cause of youth ar. The research method used in this article is based on Saussure’s theory- synchronicity and diachronicity. And the author use the N-Gram Markov language model to try to explore practical problems in new media education. The academic research results can be used in foreign language teaching, social media and educational psychology.

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing Subject Organizing by TTD Model Based on Stepwise Refinement Framework
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Natural language processing is an important research field of computer science and artificial intelligence. It studies various theories and methods that can realize effective communication between humans and computers with natural language. In order to meet the needs of academia and industry, we have offered natural language processing courses. Natural language processing course is a compulsory course for the major of artificial intelligence and an elective course for the major of computer science and technology. With the continuous development and progress of artificial intelligence research, the previous teaching organization of natural language processing course has no longer adapted to the current situation. This paper introduced our improvement in teaching practice that is the natural language processing subject organizing by TTD Model based on stepwise refinement framework. Using TTD model of the organization of natural language processing subject will be more reasonable and the contents will be more completed. Considerable improvement results have been achieved in practical teaching.

articleTitle: Exploration on Informatization Reform of C Language Programming Based on Mobile Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The informatization of education and teaching based on mobile platform is the trend of teaching development in colleges and universities. With the research background of "C language programming" course, this paper presents a mature teaching scheme with the help of a mobile platform to carry out the exploration and practice of information teaching reform. The introduction of scientific computing, mathematical physics disciplines or engineering technology fields as information cases in the information teaching is designed. In order to guide students to complete information modeling, grammar structure selection, program design, effectiveness test, etc., Internet + technology to build an information teaching mode is fully applied, the students’ participation, independent learning and active exploration ability are improved, and the improvement and promotion of information teaching level in colleges and universities are realized. A series of digital information resources have been constructed along with the exploration of information teaching reform. At the same time, intelligent teaching, open teaching and information teaching are gradually integrated into the teaching of basic courses.

articleTitle: Construction and Practice of Blending Teaching Mode of Course of “Principle of Machinery” based on Engineering Case
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the vigorous development of Internet education, the traditional classroom teaching and Internet online teaching hope to be organically integrated by blending teaching mode. Taking course of “principle of machinery” as an example, this paper explores the construction and implementation of blending teaching based on the application of MOOC teaching platform with the combination of mobile teaching tool “Mu Classroom”. Some typical engineering case discussions are introduced to link the offline and online teaching & learning. The practice results show that this blending teaching mode provides an online and offline integrated teaching solution for the deep integration of education and information technology.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Application of Internet Information Technology in the Formative Evaluation of Spanish Teaching in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In Spanish teaching in colleges and universities, objective evaluation of students’ language learning is conducive to the improvement of students’ language learning ability. However, the current evaluation system used in Spanish teaching in colleges and universities has certain drawbacks, and it is difficult to make a comprehensive evaluation of the students’ language learning process. In view of this, Internet information technology is used in the formative evaluation of universities in Spain. This article puts forward the theory of formative evaluation and advocates the application of Internet information technology to the evaluation system. With the help of information technology, it realizes the diversification of evaluation subjects and promotes the continuous improvement of Spanish teaching evaluation.

articleTitle: The direct effect and spillover effect of education investment on economic growth: Based on the application of Feder model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The relationship between educational investment and economic growth has always been a classic issue in educational economics research. Based on the development statistics of China from 2001 to 2019, the paper constructs the Feder model, uses the perpetual inventory method to measure capital, and uses SPSS data processing software to analyze the relationship between education investment and economic growth. The results show that: (1) The value of γ is positive, indicating that education investment has a positive promoting effect on economic growth, and the effect is very significant. With every 1% increase in education investment, the economy will increase by 0.52 percentage points. (2) δ value is 2.54, that is, every percentage point increase in education investment, the non-education sector increases by 2.54 percentage points; Education investment has a positive spillover effect on the non-education sector, and the effect is significant. (3) θ=3.762, indicating that the factor productivity of the education sector is greater than that of the non-education sector.

articleTitle: The Model Construction of Computer Network Technology in Vocational Education under the Rural Revitalization Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the continuous development and progress of society and the active implementation of the Rural Revitalization Strategy, modern big data technology is also constantly improving and updating. With the support of computer network analysis technology, vocational schools can develop professional education management analysis system, use computer technology to establish a data analysis model in line with vocational education, and help vocational schools better carry out targeted teaching and management, data processing and other four application stages for students through the data analysis model, Further reconstruct the function of vocational education management system. In vocational education, computer algorithm refers to the application of relevant mathematical knowledge to solve practical problems, which requires continuous mathematical analysis in complex systems. Before and after the operation and practice of system data, the conclusion must be simplified into abstract processing. First, the practical problems must be transformed into relevant mathematical problems, and then the systematic teaching model is constructed. Through the design and development of intelligent campus system, we can help schools and teachers deal with student data and information quickly and effectively, and improve work efficiency. At the same time, the intelligent campus data management platform supported by large-scale computer technology continues to create new functions to promote the further development of vocational education management.

articleTitle: A Blended Learning Approach to American Literature in the Era of “New Liberal Arts” Based on Modern Information Technologies
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Modern information technologies, which are highly valued in the era of the new liberal arts in China and the practice of blended learning, can bring fascinating effects to China’s higher education of foreign languages. This paper sets out to discuss a pedagogical reform of American Literature in application-oriented universities. With an analysis of current situations in this course, it points out that we should answer the call of new liberal arts construction and implement blended learning based on the school running characteristics and objectives of local application- oriented universities. During the process of teaching practice, various modern information technologies, such as web-based Learning Management Systems and data association mining are employed to update teaching contents and resources, innovate teaching modes, perfect teaching evaluation, improve teaching efficiency and eventually help to cultivate compound talents to satisfy the needs of local economic development.

articleTitle: The Application of the Key Technology and Security Model in University Ideological and Political Network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the continuous development of the Internet, the ideological and political network security problem in universities has attracted wide public attention. According to the domestic security situation and the development of high technology, this paper expounds the key technology and safety model in the ideological and political network.This paper will focus on the computer network security model, hoping to provide a certain value reference for the majority of practitioners.

articleTitle: Bibliometric Analysis of Research Articles on China's Corpus Discourse Analysis In the Last Ten Years
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Using the visual analysis software CiteSpace 5.8.R1 and bibliometric methods, this paper presents a systematic visual analysis of the core journal literature in the field of corpus discourse research in the CNKI database. It elucidates the evolution of hot words in this field in China and interprets the data from the aspects of time, authors, institutions, etc. Thus the study determines the research status and shortcomings of corpus discourse research in China and puts forward targeted suggestions to provide a reference for future research in related fields.

articleTitle: Study on Student engagement in the Context of Popularization of Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Since the gross enrollment rate of higher education reached 51. 6% in 2019, China's higher education has entered the stage of popularization. However, the connotative development of higher education from scale expansion of quality improvement comes with the simultaneous development of quantity growth and quality improvement in higher education. In the face of quality accountability, the previous concept of education quality is no longer in line with the current development of colleges and universities, and it has become an urgent problem of China's higher education to seek more scientific evaluation methods and more appropriate evaluation subjects. Therefore, this study uses student participation as the evaluation carrier to reflect the educational quality of colleges and universities, uses the appropriate and mature learning input questionnaire—NSSE as a research tool to explore the basic situation of the educational quality of the public colleges in my country. The problem puts forward appropriate and reasonable suggestions in order to improve the quality of education in such institutions.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Information Technology in Computer Teaching in Universities
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In view of the current teaching situation and existing problems of computer courses in Colleges and universities, combined with the application of information technology in computer basic education in universities and the latest development trend of information education technology, this paper puts forward a new BOPPPS hybrid teaching mode based on rain classroom, focusing on strengthening the cultivation of computing thinking ability. The purpose is to improve the teaching quality and teaching effect of college computer basic education.

articleTitle: Research on University Network Security Management Assistant Decision System Based on Semantic Ontology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The research on university network security management assistant decision-making system for massive heterogeneous and multi-source is an important and difficult topic in the construction of university network security system. Firstly, this paper proposes a multi-source heterogeneous university network security knowledge integration strategy based on semantic ontology technology, constructs a network security management auxiliary decision-making knowledge base based on computable and reasoning resources, and designs and develops a university network security management auxiliary decision-making system platform. The system can better realize the support services such as association query, knowledge reasoning and auxiliary decision-making of university network security events, and provides an effective solution for multi-source heterogeneous data integration, knowledge modeling and intelligent management in the field of university network security.

articleTitle: The Development and Practice of Online and Offline Hybrid Golden Course Using the “Intelligent Hardware Experimental Course” as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The golden course is based on the standard of “Two characters One Degree” and was proposed at the New Era Chinese Undergraduate Education Work Conference of National Colleges and Universities. For example, the “Intelligent Hardware Experimental Course” explores an online and offline hybrid teaching model. The study proposes online teaching based on a massive open online course (MOOC) model. Furthermore, this study designs a portable offline version (POV) of the experimental teaching instrument with an outline of the implementation of its teaching process. The application of the developed curriculum has significant effects on learning, namely memorizing core knowledge, improving practical ability, and cultivating the spirit of patriotism.

Author Keywords: online and offline hybrid teaching mode

articleTitle: Design of Online Pollution Source Monitoring System Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: At present, the automatic water environment monitoring sensors are generally expensive and have a large maintenance workload. The monitoring methods adopted for the environment are still mainly manual monitoring, supplemented by a few automatic monitoring points. The frequency is low, the data representation is poor, and there is no immediate and true reflection of the water environment. It is be found that the environmental problems are very backward, resulting in the science and accuracy of environmental management Refinement is difficult to guarantee, and the cost of later management is very high. The system integrates sewage and flue gas online monitoring devices, sensor networks, data collectors, controllers, etc., obtains data from analytical instruments, and automatically reports the data to the pollution source online monitoring platform of the environmental protection department. Based on the cloud platform architecture, the pollution source online monitoring platform uses the industrial Internet of things to collect emission data, working condition operation data and instrument and equipment operation status data in real time. It also monitors the real-time data of pollution factors of emission enterprises, the status of production and treatment facilities and the status of real-time monitoring instruments. Through big data analysis means and monitoring model, timely find information such as excessive emissions and abnormal treatment facilities, so as the provide data support for environmental protection law enforcement decisions. The public, enterprises, operation and maintenance and law enforcement can all conduct real-time monitoring and management through mobile app. #

articleTitle: Research on innovation and entrepreneurship ability based on Social Network Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The national innovation-driven development and the promotion of economic quality and efficiency become more and more rapid. To accelerate the cultivation of innovative and entrepreneurial talents and to deepen reform of the innovation and entrepreneurship education, this paper establishes a network centrality model of innovation and entrepreneurship ability indicators extracted from the materials of the published academic documents, interviews materials, excellent and award-winning business plans based on the Social Network Analysis (SNA). According to the centrality value of each indicator, this paper filters out 22 key indicators of innovation and entrepreneurship ability which can be classified into four categories of technical skills, entrepreneurial consciousness, personal ability, financial and management literacy, and draws out the horizontal and vertical ability map of innovation and entrepreneurship from perspectives of personal and life cycle respectively.

articleTitle: Analysis on the construction of counselor team in “Double High” colleges based on grey correlation analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Counselor is the backbone to carry out the ideological and political education, construction of a contingent of college students has a close relationship with the growth and progress, based on the excellent "double high" construction of colleges and universities as the research sample, take the grey correlation analysis method to build model were analyzed, and the "double high" exploration on the mechanism of college counselor team construction, so as to improve the level of team construction

articleTitle: Research on Implicit Knowledge Sharing of Alliance Enterprises Based on Improved SIR Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Based on the classical infectious disease model, the influence factors such as connection strength, knowledge failure rate and knowledge guarantee rate were added to optimize, and the emotional infection theory was introduced to construct the dynamic evolution model of tacit knowledge sharing in alliance enterprises, and the dynamic evolution law was discussed. Finally, MATLAB software was used to realize the model and numerical simulation. The results show that connection strength, knowledge failure rate, knowledge guarantee rate and integration rate have a specific influence on knowledge sharing of alliance enterprises. Finally, it is proposed to strengthen communication and interaction between alliance enterprises, strengthen trust and knowledge integration to guarantee the long-term stable development of alliance enterprises and alliance enterprises.

articleTitle: Spearman’s correlation coefficient analysis of the impact of the artificial intelligence industry on college students' employment in Heilongjiang Province
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: As a traditional industrial province, Heilongjiang Province has perfect supporting facilities related to smart industry and a high level university, hut it also has the problems of talent loss and slow development of new industries. In this paper, we analyze the economic indicators of intelligent industry in Heilongjiang Province and the employment quality reports of graduates from various universities from the current situation of the development of intelligent industry in Heilongjiang Province, collect sample data from graduates in the province, and use SPSS software to calculate the Spearman correlation coefficient of the employment impact of the artificial intelligence industry on graduates in the province, and conduct an empirical analysis on the non-parametric indicators of the dependence of multiple variables. At the same time, the employment characteristics and influence mechanism of intelligent industries in this province are sorted out and corresponding suggestions are given.

articleTitle: Research on the new application of information technology in the model of innovation and entrepreneurship education based on big data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Big data information technology plays an essential role in innovation and entrepreneurship education, which changes existing college students' learning and education environment. This paper establishes a new engineering innovation and entrepreneurship education reform model based on the big data of current college students' characteristic information. Finally, it analyzes the development and application of information technology to the existing innovation and entrepreneurship education system.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Mass Entrepreneurship and Innovation Practice Curriculum System for English Majors in Colleges and Universities under the Background of internet plus
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Under the background of internet plus, in order to better keep up with the development of the times, this paper first analyzes the mass entrepreneurship and innovation practice courses for college English majors. By using the B/S framework of Internet technology, and aiming at the problems existing in the mass entrepreneurship and innovation practice course for English majors, this paper constructs a system with the functions of curriculum setting and evaluation guarantee, which emphasizes the idea of strengthening the combination of mass entrepreneurship and innovation consciousness and practice course. It not only improves the system of mass entrepreneurship and innovation practice courses for English majors in colleges and universities, but also improves the high-quality teaching effect of students’ mass entrepreneurship and innovation practice courses.

Author Keywords: Mass Entrepreneurship and Innovation Practice Course for English Majors

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation System of Undergraduates’ Entrepreneurship Core Literacy Based on Delphi Method and AHP
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Enhancing entrepreneurial literacy education is of great significance for enhancing the personal abilities of college students and promoting social and economic development [1][2] [3]. But how should Chinese universities evaluate the cultivation results of entrepreneurial core literacy? Based on the literature review, this article preliminarily plans to construct the evaluation index of college students' entrepreneurial core literacy from the four dimensions of entrepreneurial awareness, entrepreneurial spirit, entrepreneurial ability, and entrepreneurial knowledge. Then 20 college teachers and business experts were invited to form an advisory group (the average authority coefficient of experts is 0.819), applied two rounds of the Delphi method to modify relevant indicators, and used the analytic hierarchy process to establish indicators weights. Finally, we formed the college students' core entrepreneurship literacy evaluation system, including 4 first-level and 20 second-level indicators. In addition, this study also selected a Shanghai university to issue a questionnaire with applying the above evaluation system. The data analysis results show that the evaluation system proposed in this study is highly scientific and reliable and can be used as a reference for follow-up research.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Errors in Google Neural Machine Translation
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Google Neural Machine Translation employs an encoder-decoder framework with an attention mechanism and it has resulted in a tremendous increase in efficiency. However, the quality of its translations is not yet comparable to that of human translations. In order to discover the specific problem of GNMT, the study analyzes the accuracy rate and types of errors in Google Neural Machine Translation by means of case studies. Based on the data collected, it is found that errors at the lexical level are most significant. The sparse data for certain terms in the Google Translate database, such as buzzwords, make undertranslation, a subcategory at the lexical level, the most significant translation error. These results proved that the users and developers may pay greater attention to the lexical level and try to match the selflearning capability of machine translation to the speed of partial vocabulary updates.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of New Media Application on Learning Performance under the Background of Modernization of Elderly Education
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: At present, the construction of socialism with Chinese characteristics has entered a new era. The modernization of education and the construction of a powerful country in education have been accelerated, and the deep integration of new Internet technologies and education has been continuously promoted. In particular, the emergence of new media with many advantages such as rich information resources, fast communication methods, and powerful interactive functions has created new opportunities and conditions for the development of education for the elderly. New media and old-age education are deeply integrated and developed. Promoting the reform of learning methods for the elderly under the digital information environment is conducive to ensuring the right of lifelong learning for the elderly and has far-reaching strategic significance for the construction of a learning society and the sustainable development of an aging society. By discussing the connotation and characteristics of the new media and the value and significance of old-age education, this paper puts forward the corresponding strategies for developing old-age education.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of university performance Appraisal System based on responsibility center
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper mainly puts forward corresponding solutions for the design and implementation of university performance compensation a management system. The steps of computer university performance compensation management system mainly include system analysis, system design, system implementation and system maintenance. In the design of the computer system, the various modules, the required database table and the table field menu design are shown in detail. In the implementation of the system, the event, code and menu implementation of the corresponding functional controls in the form are presented. This paper analyzes the design and implementation of the university performance compensation management system of computer technology with data input, data storage, information calculation and modification book removal. Its data analysis technology has promoted the further development of performance compensation management system in universities.

articleTitle: Research on Translation Teaching Combining Online News and Online Artificial Intelligence Translation
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the significant improvement of online artificial intelligence translation quality, the paper is intending to figure out the attitude of the students towards the translation class combining the fresh online news and online artificial intelligence translation to engage the students and foster the students’ "readers" awareness by focusing on the exact meaning of online translated sentences; and then the paper puts forward the related suggestions.

articleTitle: Development and research of virtual simulation training system for Tourism Management Major in Higher Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the reform and innovation of higher vocational teaching, the application of VR technology to the construction of virtual simulation training room in tourism management can provide students with new learning experience and continuously cultivate students’ practical operation ability and professional thinking ability. In the virtual simulation system, a large number of data mining technologies are used. The mining steps of the virtual simulation system are mainly divided into two parts. The first is the data mining of the learning process of tourism management knowledge. Its focus is to use statistical algorithms to calculate the actual data, screen and process the relevant knowledge structure, and integrate a series of relevant learning resources. The virtual simulation system can build a digital and realistic working situation for students. It can not only achieve the teaching practice goal, but also quickly improve students’ practical skills and practical ability. This paper mainly analyzes the functions of virtual simulation system in the construction of tourism management training room in higher vocational colleges, such as virtual teaching scene, virtual workbench and virtual intelligent operation, so as to give full play to the role of virtual simulation system in the cultivation of tourism talents.

articleTitle: New exploration of the mixed teaching mode about student-centered on information technology platform
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, especially the spread of the Internet, the traditional classroom teaching appears many disadvantages, which is not conducive to the development of education in the future. Aiming at the problems of course content, teaching form and course awarding process in traditional teaching, this paper combines with the idea of student-centered, and explores the new method of mixed teaching. Firstly, design of student-centered blended teaching model comes from teaching objectives, teaching content, teaching process, teaching form and so on. Then, this research takes advantage of information technology platform to assist the teaching model. Finally, the teaching about course of logistics Information Technology is taken as an example to verify the effectiveness of the method. The results show that, compared with the traditional method, student-centered blended teaching can improve teaching quality, and further speed up the professional development of higher education modernization.

articleTitle: Model study of VR technology in the professional teaching of preschool education
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Virtual reality technology is a computer simulation system that can create and experience a virtual world, it uses a computer to generate a simulation environment, is an interactive three-dimensional dynamic vision and entity behavior of multi-source information fusion, to immerse users in that environment. The teaching of preschool education based on VR technology, preschool education major integrates simulation technology, graph construction technology, visualization technology, computer, sensing positioning technology and artificial intelligence technology into the course content display and practical teaching, realizing the realization of virtual kindergarten work scene, typical work task setting and human-computer interaction evaluation functions. In a big data environment. The front-end open-source tool for presentation analysis has JasperSoft, Pentaho, Spagobi, Openi, Birt wait a minute; The commercial analysis tool used for presenting the analysis has the Style Intelligence, RapidMiner Radoop, Cognos, BO, Microsoft Power BI, Oracle, Microstrategy, QlikView, Tableau; And the domestic has BDP, National Cloud Data (Big Data Magic Mirror), Smet, FineBI, etc.VR technology is conducive to reducing the teaching cost, improving the degree of class and post integration, expanding the space of school-enterprise cooperation, creating teaching content and methods, and providing a new teaching means for preschool education majors to carry out social services. In the preschool education industry, I believe that the application of VR technology will also become more skilled and deep, and gradually integrate with it.

articleTitle: Reform and Exploration of Higher Vocational English Teaching Mode under the Background of "Internet +"
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: On March 5,2015, Premier Li Keqiang proposed the "Internet +" plan at the Third Session of the 12th National People’s Congress held in the morning. Since that day, the "Internet +" has been widely circulated. On July 6, 2015, China officially issued the Guiding Opinions on Actively Promoting the "Internet +" Plan. The release of this document made steady progress in China’s "Internet +" plan. China is actively developing towards the era of "Internet +", following the pace of The Times, and the original traditional higher vocational English teaching mode is also reformed under this background. In the era of "Internet +", a variety of emerging technologies are emerging, such as cloud flash payment, big data and cloud computing, and the rise of many technologies provides extremely favorable conditions for information processing in the education industry. In terms of higher vocational English teaching mode is concerned, the new environment of "Internet +" provides many new development opportunities for the reform of higher vocational English education, and lays a foundation for the exploration of the teaching mode of higher vocational English education.

articleTitle: Design of School User Archives Management System Based on Consortium Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The database design based on blockchain is regarded as a distributed ledger combined with technologies such as distributed storage and encryption algorithms. It has the characteristics of decentralization and high security. Multiple entities of the Consortium Blockchain are subject to centralized supervision and have strict access mechanisms. Therefore, this paper attempts to study the data management model based on the Consortium Blockchain in the context of education big data, with the school archive management as the entry point, which is a safe and reliable information system with low data sharing cost, non-tamperable, and traceable. Design and application exploration route.

articleTitle: Research on Construction of the Course "University Computer Fundamentals" in Colleges and Universities Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This article focuses on the construction of the curriculum to study the teaching of basic computer courses in colleges and universities, discusses how to realize the cultivation of students’ values and patriotism in the silent moisturizing of things, and uses data analysis and visualization technology to show the specific implementation in the teaching organization and teaching effectiveness. This thesis proposes to solve worries in cultivating students with excellent teacher ethics, promoting the construction of the faculty team; to build a curriculum view of cultivating and educating people with morality and war; to optimize the content of the course by teaching knowledge points, including longitudinally organizing the history of computer science, telling stories about scientists’ exploration and discovery to build up confidence; to introduce information technology into the classroom, compare and analyze with foreign countries, increasing responsibility; Big data analysis is adopted to analyze and present the competition results in a multi-dimensional manner, providing more focus and reference for the subsequent optimization of course teaching, and laying a solid practical foundation for further improving the quality of course teaching.

articleTitle: Blended Learning in College English Teaching under the Background of Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In recent years, “Ideological and Political Theories Teaching in All Courses” has emerged as a necessity in higher education, including the course of Colige English. With the boom of information technology and the emergence of online learning platforms such as “Unipus”, “Chinese University MOOC” and "pigai.net", the blended approach of “online learning” and “offline learning” provides College English teachers with a new teaching method, which helps to make the relatively dull way of ideological and political education full of cultural and artistic colors and maximize the teaching effect. Based on specific teaching cases, through the comprehensive application of “online” and “offline” learning, this paper aims to explore an effective way for blended learning to integrate ideological and political education in College English teaching.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of the Quality Evaluation Indicator System of "Online Golden Course" Based on Experimental Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: "Online Golden Course" is the new demand in the new stage of China’s higher education. A set of scientific and reasonable quality evaluation indicator system has great significance for the "Online Gold Course" construction. Based on the Total Quality Management theory and the influencing factors of curriculum quality, this paper preliminarily constructs the evaluation indicator system of curriculum quality from the 4 dimensions of teaching, student performance, curriculum and learning platform. Firstly, Delphi method is used to test the rationality of the questionnaire. Then use the correlation analysis to delete the indicators with high correlation to complete the preliminary screening. Finally, the Principal Component Analysis is used to improve the quantitative evaluation of student-centered "Online Golden Course" quality. This paper provides a high operational evaluation tool for "Online Golden Course ".

articleTitle: Dilemma and Countermeasures of Online Science Teaching in Primary Schools under the Background of COVID-19 Based on Lag Sequential Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Online teaching, with its advantages in breaking through regional restrictions and enriching learning methods, has become the main teaching mode in the field of primary education to deal with the global COVID-19 pandemic. However, in the practice of online teaching, especially in science teaching, some shortcomings of the existing teaching model have gradually emerged. To evaluate the effectiveness of online science teaching, and to explore the problems existing in courses, this paper combines data analysis and lag sequential analysis by using Nvivol2. The overall situation of the online science class and the proportion of time that teachers and students respectively take in the online class is evaluated based on data and videos from Wuhan Education Cloud. The results show that the main issues affecting online science teaching are not covering all students, insufficient class hours, inadequate consideration of home quarantine, lack of interaction in teaching, and ignoring students’ thinking and practice. Based on the assessment of the reality, the countermeasures proposed in this paper are first to coordinate the overall implementation of online courses of science. The second is to ensure the effective implementation of science courses in the way of (1) carrying out online and offline activities to guarantee adequate time, (2) comprehensive use of textbook and self-developed tutorials to cultivate students’ scientific literacy, (3) developing a new teaching model that combines online live broadcast, offline exploration, and online evaluation, (4) encouraging students to self-made teaching resources. The research in this article provides an effective improvement strategy for the online teaching of primary science courses grounded on fact.

articleTitle: Exploration on curriculum reform of "power electronic technology" based on engineering education certification under the background of new engineering
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the current situation and problems in the teaching of "power electronic technology" in our university according to the goal and orientation of talent training in Application-oriented Universities under the background of new engineering. Aiming at the specific objectives of engineering education certification and the requirements of new engineering education for talent cultivation, the teaching reform of power electronic technology course is explored, mainly including theoretical teaching reform and practice teaching reform. Through the exploration of teaching reform of this course, we hope to achieve the goal of engineering education certification, meet the requirements of new engineering education for personnel training, innovate the practical teaching of power electronic technology course, cultivate students’ innovative practice spirit, comprehensively improve students’ engineering practice ability, and cultivate high-level innovative applied engineering talents.

articleTitle: Measurement of coaxiality of rectangular spline shaft based on image processing
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The existing measurement methods of coaxiality of rectangular spline shaft include rotation axis method, coordinate method and V-frame method. These methods belong to the contact measurement, which are low measurement efficiency and can not realize the real-time on-line measurement of coaxiality of rectangular spline shaft. In this paper, a visual measurement method of coaxiality of rectangular spline shaft based on image processing is proposed, and it is an active non-contact measurement method. The on-line measurement of coaxiality of rectangular spline shaft is achieved, and its feasibility is verified by experiments, therefore the robustness of coaxiality measurement of rectangular spline shaft is improved.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of University Student Knowledge Management Service System Based on Weixin JSAPI
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the expansion of enrollment scale, college management is facing more and more challenges. The contradiction between the original management model and the number of management and individual needs has become increasingly prominent. This article is based on the most popular mobile application APP Weixin for design and development research. Call the JS-SDK interface to build a knowledge management system based on Weixin official account, and analyze in detail the three characteristics of the knowledge management system and its design process. Draws the process of data fusion and internalization at the back-end, through spiraling, generating personalized information and providing personalized services.

articleTitle: Research And Application of Inquiry Teaching Model Under Virtual Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: To address the shortage of teaching aids, this paper proposes a new inquiring teaching model via the virtual simulation technology. The proposed model is specific to the maintenance crew. The interactive virtual environment is first built with the aid of virtual training software and the simulation technology. The constructed platform provides a practically interactive mode for the trainee. The thinking skill of students can be then enhanced by consecutive exercise. Multiple teaching practices prove that the proposed method could arouse the student’s enthusiasm fully. The teaching effectiveness can be therefore improved significantly. It is valuable to extend the proposed method to much more trainee accordingly.

articleTitle: Research on the Education Evaluation System of Chinese Higher Vocational Colleges Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
