abstract: This study analyzes the education evaluation connotation and research status at home and abroad, It analyzes the existing problems in educational evaluation in China, puts forward the method of applying information technology to education evaluation, and also proposes the implementation plan of the application of Internet, big data, artificial intelligence and other information technology to educational process evaluation, students’ ability evaluation and education dynamic evaluation. Further, this study puts forward the educational evaluation system and educational evaluation model of higher vocational colleges, including the evaluation methods, technical means and evaluation content of teacher evaluation and student evaluation, in order to provide theoretical reference for the development and application of educational evaluation.

articleTitle: Application of Educational Philosophy in Robotics Curriculum Design Based on 5G Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Educational philosophy is the thought and theory of curriculum design and the soul of curriculum design. In my robotics instructional design, teaching students according to their aptitude, pragmatism, beyond the current situation and other educational ideas. With 5G low delay and high rate, combined with VR/AR/MR/holographic image technology, it can realize real-time transmission of image information, provide holographic interactive teaching services, improve teaching experience; combined with big data and artificial intelligence technology, students’ learning portrait can be constructed to visualize, simplify and experience profound theoretical knowledge. Practice has proved that students can happily master new knowledge and achieve the purpose and effect of teaching.

Author Keywords: teach students in accordance with their aptitude

articleTitle: Construction of College English "2+2" Blended Learning Mode Based on MOOC in Post Pandemic Era
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Blended Learning has got a fast development based on a variety of mature platforms such as MOOC, Coursera. Influenced by the outbreak of COVID-19 in the whole world, education has come into the stage of post pandemic era. More and more scholars and educators begin to find a more flexible and effective way to conduct Blended Learning based on the increasingly developed ICT, aiming to achieve more effective learning outcomes. This essay will focus on the design of "2+2" Blended Learning mode for college English courses based on MOOC and explain its basic idea and way of operation.

articleTitle: Research on management methods of automotive cybersecurity tools
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the in-depth integration of informatization and automobiles, automobiles are transforming from traditional means of transportation to a new type of intelligent travel carrier<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. While it has brought great changes to the automobile industry, it has also increased cyber security threats. Automotive cyberecurity tools are an inevitable element introduced in the process of automotive cyberecurity transformation, and become one of the important factors affecting automotive cyberecurity. Therefore, the management of automotive cyberecurity tools as a necessary link in automotive cyberecurity assurance has been paid more and more attention by various enterprises.

articleTitle: The application of Korean language and slang corpus based on big data technology in teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the context of informatization and big data, corpora based on foreign language teaching and application are developing rapidly. This paper introduces and analyzes the construction of the teaching corpus in the context of big data, and uses big data application technology to construct the Korean colloquial corpus, and studies how to use the constructed corpus to provide teaching methods for the teaching and research of Korean colloquialism. Provides a new way of thinking for Korean language educators.

Author Keywords: Korean Language and Folk Talks Corpus

articleTitle: The Construction of a Mixed University English Teaching System Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence technology is widely used in English teaching, the application of artificial intelligence technology in the English teaching mainly adopts data real-time monitoring, data acquisition, data mining and other auxiliary English model system, auxiliary system of artificial intelligence application in English on the experiment platform are mainly composed of data acquisition, on the experimental platform for data integration analysis of English. The English experiment platform system has the characteristics of wide data range, large computation and high complexity. This paper mainly studies the practical role of artificial intelligence in college English teaching and discusses the application of artificial intelligence in English teaching. At the same time, through the systematic analysis of the current AI-assisted language learning software and system defects put forward relevant solutions, artificial intelligence technology is conducive to improve the application of intelligent human-machine system in English teaching, and provide technical support for the cultivation and development of English talents in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Research on the exploration and effectiveness of new media photography courses in higher education for modern education based on blended learning
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the context of the gold course construction in the new era, to meet the standard of "high-level, innovative and challenging", the group started to pilot the blended teaching for the course "Photography Fundamentals" of art majors in 2018, to let students experience a more open and integrated photography class. The experiment used Internet technology to combine online and offline courses, reversed the roles of teachers and students, increased the degree of discussion in the course, and used a new score rule to sort out and calculate and establish a database of teaching effectiveness from post-class questionnaires and other teaching reference data on students. The results show that the average score of each item is stable around 85, 91.8% of the students' performance is "good" (⩾ 80), and 99.08% of the students are "satisfied" with this innovative teaching model. The experiment has reaped the expected results and for building Golden Course for art provided experience and reference.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Technology in the Information Construction of Student Status Management in Undergraduate Colleges
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the popularization of the Internet, modern archive information management gradually develops towards digital and informatization. For college student status information with a large number of people and complex information materials, it is necessary to adopt intelligent management. The undergraduate college student status management system designed in this paper uses a system architecture method combining C/S and B/S to process a large amount of data and complex business processing logic processes in the school. The information construction of student status management uses the browser-web server-database server development model on the basis of demand analysis, which can save the tedious work caused by the client development, download, installation and other processes, and is more flexible. This article analyzes the application of current computer technology in the management of student status in undergraduate colleges, and puts forward the existing problems in the construction of student status management information in current undergraduate colleges, and then designs a reasonable and feasible student status management website for college learning Prospects for the future development of management information construction.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Online Public Opinion in Higher Vocational Institutions : ——Content-based analysis method
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In order to accurately grasp the public opinion information and manage higher vocational education, we conducted an empirical study by data mining and content analysis on the public opinion of Baidu postings of Shenzhen higher vocational institutions from August 1, 2020 to July 31, 2021. It is found that the theme of public opinion communication in higher vocational education mainly revolves around student affairs. Amateur life and admissions categories account for more public opinion. Finding friends, psychological activities, and learning and practice were the next most popular categories. There are relatively few public opinions in the categories of epidemic prevention and control, association activities and insertion or advancement to undergraduate degree. The main subjects of public opinion are mainly students, who are energetic, sunny and willing to share, reflecting high media literacy. The public opinion peaks in September, then gradually decreases and tends to be stable. The study summarizes the themes of higher vocational online public opinion through quantitative analysis and reflects the current situation of higher vocational students, which is important to promote the management of higher vocational education.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Framework Design of Smart Trade Union Based on Government Affairs WeChat
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the continuous popularization and application of network information technology in China, this research mainly uses government WeChat as a platform through layout design and method implementation. It can develop an intelligent architecture platform suitable for the application of current trade union organizations. The research process first conducts the project concept, design process, etc. The research also sorts out the analysis and clarifies the research direction. Secondly, software methods or models related to science and engineering such as mathematics are adopted. The specific research steps include main architecture design, module architecture design, software architecture design, functional architecture design. The research integrates modern trade union organization mode and service points into the system requirements and design. The smart union structure is realized through database technology and software applications, which reflects the wisdom nature and system functions of the smart union, and facilitates future work development, communication, real-time sharing, and community organization.

articleTitle: Research on Internet-based Practical Teaching System of Logistics Management in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In order to solve the problems such as the disconnection between the theory and practice of logistics management in Colleges and universities, and further improve the comprehensive practical ability of logistics management students in Colleges and universities, a practical teaching system of logistics management in Colleges and Universities under the background of Internet is designed. The network layer of the system provides network support for the support layer through network environment, host and storage modules; The support layer uses the operation module, server management module and middleware to provide hardware support for data exchange, processing and management in various databases in the data layer. The application layer completes the functions of learning, management and practice by calling the data of the data layer. The school practice module adopts the combination of special practice and comprehensive practice to deeply infiltrate the classroom theory into practice; The teaching resource sharing module recommends teaching resources according to user preferences through the collaborative filtering algorithm based on clustering, and presents the results in the display layer, which is convenient for teachers, students and cooperative enterprises in the user layer to call at any time. The experimental results show that the system can accurately recommend teaching resources, apply the knowledge learned in class to practice, improve the traditional boring theoretical courses, improve students' performance and practical ability, and obtain better teaching results.

articleTitle: Research on Cultivating Big Data Applied Talents for E-commerce Major Based on Hypernetwork Model : Research on Universities in Hubei province
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The big data technology has been widely penetrated into all aspects of life. E-commerce majors in universities have a more diversified direction of talent cultivation due to the rise of big data technology. Also, research on the cultivation of big data application-oriented talents has huge theoretical and practical significance. This paper combines the hypernetwork model with the cultivation of E-commerce-majored talents, setting three nodes of enterprise demand, application ability and curriculum to build the model. And has comprehensively analyzed the cultivation situation of big data application talents in E-commerce majors in general universities in Hubei Province, and discusses the cultivation strategy of big data application talents in E-commerce majors.

articleTitle: BIM simulation model based on BIM technology in the application of engineering to calculate quantity of teaching research
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Traditional teaching method in engineering calculation teaching have been eliminated and cannot keep up with the pace of The Times, so new teaching ideas and methods should be found. With the emergence of BIM technology, colleges and universities are studying how to introduce BIM technology into classroom teaching and realize teaching reform. BIM simulation model based on BIM technology coming, which promotes the reform of engineering calculation teaching. Combining with teaching materials, the author comprehensively demonstrates the advantages of BIM simulation model in engineering calculation teaching by the practical application of BIM simulation model based on BIM technology in teaching, and thoroughly analyzes the feasibility and necessity of applying BIM simulation model in engineering calculation teaching, and the teaching reform results.

articleTitle: Research on the application of virtual simulation technology in law experiment teaching under the background of educational informatization
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Virtual simulation system law teaching system usually adopts multi-level technology and modular technology, which makes the teaching system have good scalability, allows users to carry out practical a operation in actual law teaching, and adds new experimental teaching modules at the same time. The goal of establishing law laboratory is to create a diversified and systematic teaching environment. Based on computer technology, make full use of virtual simulation technology to establish three- dimensional legal model and construct virtual simulation legal experiment system. It can further realize the data analysis of virtual simulation technology and law teaching. The laboratory system has a complete data protection mechanism. All data confidence in the system will be backed up by the system, using incremental backup and stage overall backup model. It can better preserve the data information and operation process generated in the process of law experiment teaching, and Hitler can quickly restore even if data loss occurs.

articleTitle: A New Mathematical Method of Evaluation on Vietnam’s Higher Education System Reveals the Need of Improving Accessibility and Research Based on Experimental Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper designs a mathematical evaluation model based on analytical hierarchy process (AHP) to assess higher education systems of countries worldwide. After applying the model to higher education systems of China, the USA, and Vietnam, the article quantifies and compares the education indicators of the three countries. By analyzing Vietnam's historical education data based on principle component analysis (PCA), the article identifies the most remarkable aspects for improvement. The paper also provides a prediction model on Vietnam’s higher education system and makes a forecast. Based on this prediction and previous evaluation results, the article proposes a series of education development actions for Vietnam.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Mixed Teaching Mode of “Object-Oriented Programming” Course Based on Superstar Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper analyzes and thinks the advantages and disadvantages of traditional teaching methods of java course. The thinking and practical application of the hybrid teaching mode based on the superstar platform are conducted. This paper takes the practice application and analysis from three main aspects incluing pre-class preview, after class consolidation expansion and hybrid assessment mechanism. After a semester of practice, students ’learning interest and learning effect are improved significantly. Superstar teaching platform has the incomparable advantages in traditional teaching methods in promoting teaching practice innovation reform and improve students’ innovation ability.

articleTitle: Study on the Causes of Over Education in China's Labor Market Based on Experimental Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper uses the data of Chinese General Social Survey (CGSS) in 2017 for empirical research, selects personal factors, family factors and work factors as the main independent variables, and takes over education as the dependent variable, and then establishes a logistic binary regression model for regression analysis after variable assignment to explore the factors affecting the occurrence of over education in the labor market. Finally, it analyzes and discusses the reasons and puts forward relevant countermeasures and suggestions, which can be used as a reference to alleviate the problem of over education.

articleTitle: Construction of Personalized Physical Education Application Platform under the Background of internet plus—First-class Course University Sports-Martial Arts
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Under the new social development pattern of “internet plus”, network personalized teaching has become an important direction of traditional educational innovation and reform. Aiming at martial arts education, a special category of education, a personalized application platform of physical education with functional modules such as knowledge retrieval, course recommendation, course learning and learning effect evaluation is built by using Web technology under B/S framework and MySQL database. Relying on the recommendation algorithm under personalized recommendation system to complete the construction of student user characteristic model, in order to meet the requirements of different students’ personalized martial arts course learning, it also effectively solves the problems of unbalanced supply environment of martial arts education in schools, weak teachers and insufficient teaching effect.

articleTitle: Dynamic logo design form under the New Media Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper is mainly to explore the form and method of logo design under the new media technology. New media technology makes the logo design move from static to dynamic, breaking through the limitations of two-dimensional static, and realizing multidimensional space effects of various forms. The dynamic logo changes the traditional static design mode and extends the connotation meaning of logo communication. Starting from the expression form of new media dynamic logo design, this paper discusses that multi-form logo is an important component of dynamic logos design and pays more attention to the emotional and interactive characteristics, then explores the development trend of new media dynamic logos design with examples.

articleTitle: Study on the Online Teaching of College English Course in the Era of "Internet + Education"
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Nowadays, online teaching and learning as a new form of education has been widely used for all age groups and in almost all subjects. Under the background of "Internet + Education", college English classes are also trying to explore new teaching modes and methods, such as MOOC, micro-class, flipped classroom [4]. From the beginning of 2020 till now, because of the spread of the pandemic, there are many countries and regions that have been seriously affected and therefore have to convert the ordinary classroom teaching to complete online teaching. This article takes the 2019-2020-2 semester, in which the author’s university has launched complete online teaching, as an example and explore the online teaching mode of college English course. In the paper, the online teaching modes that was used for the whole semester are first introduced; Then, the study compares students’ academic performances of College English II with their scores of College English I when they had classes in campus; finally, the advantages and disadvantages of online teaching and learning are discussed in details based on interviews of teachers and students involved in the online course, suggestions for college English teaching and learning are also provided afterwards.

articleTitle: Knowledge Map Analysis of School-Enterprise Cooperation Education in Electronics and Communications Based on Python
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Based on the 500 related literature collected on CNKI from 2010 to 2020, we studied the situation of school-enterprise cooperation education in electronics and communications major in China. We extracted, segmented, categorized, converted, and cleaned the titles, authors, sources, keywords, publication years, number of citations, number of downloads and other parameters of the papers based on Python programming. After processing the data source with Python, the keywords were extracted and clustered in the visualization tool. Creatively, we drew the regional heat map of the research results, which showed the difference of the whole China more intuitively. We found that the research topics of school-enterprise cooperation education mainly focus on cultivating applied talents, teaching reform and innovative practice. Still, the depth of cooperation is insufficient, and the regional development is unbalanced. Finally, we come up with some practicable suggestions. The future cooperation mode will focus on the cooperation of schools, enterprises, government, industry, and other subjects, and take the new engineering construction as an opportunity to promote the deep integration of cooperation.

articleTitle: Exploration and Practice of Online and Offline Mixed Teaching Mode in Higher Vocational Colleges Based on Internet Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The rapid development of digital, intelligent, networked and multimedia information technology has triggered a revolution in traditional education, injected infinite vitality and vigor into teaching, and led to the emergence of a variety of new teaching modes. Among them, online and offline hybrid teaching is a new teaching model that integrates traditional offline teaching with online teaching. It gives full play to the advantages of online and offline teaching, and has become a new development trend. Taking "circuit analysis and testing course" as an example, this paper analyzes the learning characteristics of Higher Vocational Students, and explores and practices online and offline mixed teaching mode suitable for Higher Vocational Colleges from many aspects. The practice has proved that the online and offline mixed teaching mode has stimulated students’ enthusiasm, initiative and creativity, and achieved a good teaching effect.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of ideological and political teaching system based on big data analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the advent of the era of "big data", ideological and political education in colleges and universities must be innovated and reformed to meet the requirements of the current era. Big data technology emphasizes the data integration and data analysis, combining with the characteristics of the development of the college political education itself and with the Internet technology application, construct with functions of intelligent data analysis and recommendation of the education teaching system in colleges and universities, which changes the single network auxiliary teaching platform for the adaptive learning platform, emphasizes the effectiveness of college ideological instruction teaching, expand the influence of ideological and political education in colleges and universities so as to improve the learning effect of ideological and political courses.

articleTitle: Online Teaching Application Design for the Postgraduate Entrance Examination of Industrial Design
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: According to the data, 89% of postgraduate students majoring in industrial design will spend three quarters of their energy in finding materials for the postgraduate entrance examination and the experience posts of senior students who have been admitted to the target institutions. In view of this phenomenon, a question and answer application for industrial design postgraduate entrance examination deserves more attention. In the research process, firstly, data are obtained through competitive product analysis, user interviews and questionnaire surveys. In addition, users' real needs are also collected. Secondly, KANO model method is employed to determine the priority of requirements, the strategic layer and the scope layer. Finally, based on the preliminary analysis results, the application interface is designed to determine the framework layer, structure layer and visual layer. The final result is that in the context of the development of new media, the postgraduate entrance examination education is modernized and reformed, which successfully reduces the energy and time of industrial design postgraduate entrance examination students searching for information during the preparation period.

articleTitle: Deep Feedforward Sequential Memory Networks Based Mispronunciation Detection for Tibetan Students' Mandarin
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Computer assisted pronunciation training system (CAPT) can detect the wrong pronunciation produced by non-native speakers and provide positive feedback. CAPT is helpful to improve the pronunciation level for L2 learners’ accurately. Tibetan students’ Mandarin is influenced by their native language pronunciation habits. So, this feature leads to their pronunciation being obviously different from that of standard mandarin. This paper used CNN model as a fundamental, and we introduced acoustic model: DFSMN and CTC. This acoustic model implemented a method of speech recognition on Tibetan students’ mandarin mispronunciation detection. In order to continue improving the detection performance, we used extended initial final (XIF) as bias primitives and design 64 bias types. Experiment results show that the proposed method in this paper can effectively detect mispronunciation and provide correct feedback, with the DA of 88.02%, FRR of 7.95% and FAR of 25.74%.

articleTitle: Teaching Quality Evaluation of Higher Vocational Basic English Based on Perception Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the further development of globalization, China’s opening up to the outside world is further expanded and relevant foreign exchanges are further deepened. During this process, more and more vocational work needs or involves foreign exchanges. As vocational school students of the new era, they are in urgent need to have the ability, however this is still the weakest link in English teaching in higher vocational colleges. This paper mainly constructs the influencing factors model of student satisfaction, and puts forward the corresponding model hypothesis. This study designed the "student satisfaction scale" and "the influencing factors scale of student satisfaction", and tested the reliability and validity of the initial scale. The results showed that the reliability and validity of the initial questionnaire were ideal, but there were a few items with unsatisfactory reliability and validity. The research deleted the items, and finally formed a more ideal scale of reliability and validity. The purpose of this paper is to improve the theoretical system of English grading teaching in higher vocational colleges, promote the reform of English grading teaching in colleges, formulate the teaching objectives and syllabus of English education suitable for their own vocational characteristics, design the suitable teaching contents, and explore a new compound teaching mode of "grading + module" in Higher Vocational English.

articleTitle: Digital Storytelling in Chinese Education (2005-2021): A Scientometric Analysis by Using CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Since its birth in the late 1980s, digital storytelling (DST) has been widely used in various fields, especially in education. DST has been confirmed a powerful educational tool. This paper makes a scientometric analysis of the research phases’ trends and focuses on the study of DST in Chinese education by using the CiteSpace System, based on the data of the research papers published between 2005 to 2021, which is retrieved from the CNKI database. It finds that researches on DST in Chinese education from 2005 to 2021 proceed in three distinct phases: the preliminary phase (2005-2009), the acceleration phase (2009-2017), and the mature phase (2017-2021), and that the studies are extended from the technological studies to the application studies. The top six keywords in the field are respectively DST, information technology, information literacy, designing, stimulating students, and primary school mathematics. The application of DST in primary education has been the newly emerged research focus and trend.

articleTitle: Model Analysis of News and Communication System Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: news communication is one of the most important application fields of big data technology. This paper mainly expounds the basic concepts of the application of big data technology in the field of news communication, including data sources and data characteristics, as well as the value of big data application in news communication. Through the construction of intelligent analysis and decision-making system based on big data technology, the research and development of intelligent news management and control platform has realized the unification, transformation, association, classification and storage of various communication protocol data of different devices on the news communication working face. Taking the field of news communication as an example, this paper uses a large number of big data technologies to effectively deal with the characteristics of large-scale information data, dynamic data application and strong heterogeneity in news communication, and analyzes and puts forward the data collection and application process of news communication. Combined with the technical background of big data era, this paper discusses the necessary value of adopting big data acquisition technology in the field of news communication, and puts forward the research framework and technical development route of big data in the field of news communication.

articleTitle: The Application of the Lexile Framework for Reading in Spanish Reading Course
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the context of education informatization, the use of Internet platform-assisted teaching has become a trend. This paper takes 83 students of Spanish major as the research object, and uses the achieve3000 Lexile Framework for Reading as the research platform. The research adopts a combination of quantitative and qualitative methods to analyze the application effect of the platform in the students’ reading courses. It is divided into three parts: test, questionnaire, and statistical analysis. During the research process, a total of four sets of Lexile data were collected, and SPSS and R software were used for statistical analysis. The independent sample T experiment results showed that: after using the platform for course-assisted teaching, The students’ reading ability has been improved, and the results have reached the expected level.

articleTitle: The Reform and Development of Physical Education in Colleges and Universities in the Era of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the era of artificial intelligence, traditional physical education methods can no longer meet the needs of contemporary college physical education, and it is even more difficult to adapt to the development needs of physical education in the new era. And through the new era of human artificial intelligence technology, physical education can be gradually reformed, and artificial intelligence technology can be reasonably used to construct an intelligent robot system for physical education. The content, scenes, methods and processes of physical education can be continuously innovated and diversified. The evaluation system can better adapt to the individual development needs of contemporary college students. Artificial intelligence makes physical education more intelligent, curriculum construction more scientific, and teaching methods more innovative and future.

articleTitle: The Role of Computer Network Technology on the Development of Art and Design Education
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern society, art design education has attracted the attention of all walks of society, and the existing art design teaching content has been improved and innovated. Rapid progress in computer network technology, especially in the art design education industry, which influenced the development of art design education. This paper mainly from the concept and characteristics of "computer technology data software", through charts, examples, analogy and other demonstration techniques, demonstrated the influence of "computer technology data software" on the development of art and design, and put forward the influence of "computer technology data software" on art and design discipline, fully understand the "computer technology data software" about the development of art and design discipline.

articleTitle: Application of Computer and Mathematics Software in University Mathematics Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In recent years, the development of science and technology is becoming more and more rapid, computer technology is constantly improved, and the fields involved are also increasing. The application in the field of education is also further expanding, which plays a crucial role in college mathematics. The world’s research on mathematical software originated in the 1950s, and began to occupy a very important position throughout mathematics. This paper is mainly aimed at the application of computer and mathematics software in college mathematics teaching, to provide new ideas for the development of university mathematics, heap computer technology and mathematics software for a series of optimization and improvement, give play to students' independent ability, improve the teaching methods, so that the university of mathematics teaching has been steadily improved.

articleTitle: Study on the Effective Mechanism of Network English Independent Learning Platform Based on Multi Agent of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Big data and cloud computing are a new computing model, which plays a great role in promoting the education, teaching and colleges and universities in China. The Internet connects various fields, realizes information sharing through the network, and realizes the efficient integration of all kinds of resources. Independent learning in the online environment has been widely used in English education, which is also the basic requirement of English education. The English independent learning platform built by Agent agent is conducive to cultivating students' ability of individualization, unity and cooperation.This paper expounds the characteristics of online English independent learning, then expounds on the construction process of multi-Agent model building, puts forward the advantages of computer network independent learning, and provides a theoretical guarantee and experimental basis for the online English independent learning platform.

articleTitle: Measuring Team Learning of High-technology Firms in China : a regression analysis model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In this study, we develop a scale about team learning in China, combing the Chinese social culture characters such as great power distance, collectivism orientation and uncertainty avoidance. Survey data from 82 teams in 14 high-technology firms are used, first to establish structural validity of the scale by exploratory factor analysis and confirmatory factor analysis, and second to test the relationships between team learning and team performance using regression models. Results show that there are three dimensions in team learning, including internal learning, vicarious learning, and contextual learning. The three dimensions of team learning positively influence team performance.

articleTitle: Use VR Technology to Construct Physical Education Teaching Auxiliary System
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: VR technology is a technology that many research teams have focused on in recent years. VR technology combines human-machine interface technology, sensor technology, artificial intelligence and other technologies. It can create a lifelike artificial simulation environment for users through wearable sensing devices, simulating various perceptions of people in the natural environment, and bringing reality to users Feelings. At present, physical education in our country has the problems of insufficient student enthusiasm and insufficient professionalism of teachers. In order to solve these problems, we can try to bring VR technology into the physical education classroom. The virtual teaching environment platform designed in this paper uses VRML-Java synchronization and coordination technology and 3-layer B/S structure, takes the virtual unit as the main part, sets different parameters, completes virtual services, builds a real scene for students, and helps students immerse themselves in In sports. This platform has also built a complete system service to meet the teaching needs of teachers and students, and fully mobilize students’ enthusiasm for sports.

articleTitle: Dynamic evaluation of higher education system based on TOPSIS model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Firstly, the entropy weight method and TOPSIS model are applied to evaluate higher education system longitudinally. Secondly, considering the defective nature of the evaluation system of a single country, the evaluation system is optimized by adding the time weight factor to obtain the horizontal evaluation of multiple countries. Finally, Norway is selected as the research object of this paper, and the specific improvement plan is proposed and tested for its validity by analyzing the current situation in Norway. The results show that the improved system score is significantly better than the current system.

articleTitle: Research on Preprocessing of Rectal Pressure Signal Based on WPT-ICA and EMD-ICA
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Comprehensive diagnosis of rectal function after low rectal resection, which will ultimately help patients recover, is an essential issue in the field of anorectal research. One of the medical methods to evaluate rectal function is anorectal pressure measurement. However, since the collected signals are usually one-dimensional sequences accompanied by much noise, it is crucial to preprocess the rectal pressure signals. This paper proposes rectal pressure signal preprocessing algorithms based on WPT-ICA and EMD-ICA, which constructs virtual multi-channels by decomposing the original signals, and uses independent component analysis to perform blind source separation of multi-channel signals, and uses correlation coefficient as the indicator to realize the preprocessing of rectal pressure signals. Many simulation experiments show that the correlation coefficient of the two algorithms can reach more than 0.99, and the experiment using laboratory real rectal pressure data has preliminarily verified the effectiveness of the algorithms.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis and Comparison of Survey Result on English Teaching of Two Groups after Experimental Teaching by SPSS 23
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In order to improve current higher vocational English teaching, a comparative teaching featuring dynamic class teaching has been conducted for a semester. This paper constitutes a report on the survey results on different states of higher vocational English teaching of experimental group and control group after an experimental teaching with different teaching models, and provides a thorough statistical analysis by SPSS 23. The objective is to compare teaching effect of the two different teaching models and prove the strength of dynamic class model.

articleTitle: An empirical analysis of the current situation and influencing factors of college students' psychological crises
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In order to understand the current situation of college students suffering from psychological crises, discuss the factors affecting the psychological crises of college students, and prevent the psychological crises of college students. In this essay, a self-made questionnaire was used to investigate the psychological crises status and influencing factors of college students in a comprehensive university in Jiangsu Province. The results show that personality characteristics, psychological tendency, emotional characteristics, past failure experience, professional satisfaction, employment prospects and dormitory relationship are strongly correlated with whether college students suffer psychological crises.

articleTitle: A study on the pronunciation of nasal initial syllables in Shigatse dialect based on Glottal MS-110
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper selects a native speaker of Shigatse dialect in the Wei Zang dialect area as the research object to study the parameters of airflow when the nasal sound of Shigatse dialect is used as the initial consonant.Three parameters of nasal obstruction were collected for comparison, including the duration of articulation, average air velocity and airflow. The results show that the three parameters follow the rule of pronunciation duration, average air velocity and airflow is ད[ŋa]>ཉ[ɳa]>མ[ma]>ན[na]. The reference values of acoustic and airflow parameters obtained in this paper can provide theoretical basis and technical support for throat diseases, dysphonic diseases and postoperative evaluation of Tibetan native speakers.

articleTitle: The Developmental Analysis of Creative Talents in Shenzhen’s Film Production Industry Based on the “3T” Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The cultural and creative industries in Shenzhen have made significant progress in the past decade. While the film production industry, as a leading role in the cultural and creative industries, is just unfolding. How to build a team of creative talents in Shenzhen’s film production industry is a noteworthy issue. This paper adopts the 3T model proposed by Florida, which has a profound impact on the creative economy, and deploys the quantitative method to examine reasonable strategies for talent development according to the correlation between the research object and the three different elements of the "3T" model (Talent, Technology, and Tolerance).

articleTitle: Research on Teaching Reform of Test Technology Foundation Based on the OBE Education Concept
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In view of the clear export characteristics of military college students, combined with the problems existing in the current teaching process of the basic course of testing technology, this paper uses mind map to readjust the course teaching content and optimize the teaching mode of experimental course and theoretical course based on the OBE education concept. The teaching and assessment mechanism of online and offline integration were explored which can effectively improve the teaching efficiency and quality as well as ensure that students can understand, learn and use the knowledge well. The teaching reform lays a solid foundation for the learning of subsequent professional courses and the needs of the first post.

articleTitle: System Construction of College Students' Education Management based on Big Data Analysis Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The management information of college students is complex and changeable, and it is easy to have the problem that college information is difficult to control. China’s University information system is mainly divided into several major systems: educational administration system, student system, Party mass system, book system and security system. These systems will produce a large amount of data information every day, and also need to invest some human, material and human resources for mining, analysis and decision-making. The use of big data technology in college student management can better improve the authenticity and reliability of student management data, so as to screen the most valuable information from a large number of cumbersome data, speed up the data mining and analysis speed of college management system, and effectively improve the decision-making efficiency of colleges and universities. At the same time, colleges and universities can also design and develop more humanized management and service systems close to students through the advantages of big data technology, promote the informatization of colleges and universities, and provide strong technical guarantee for the development of smart campus.

articleTitle: Influence of Computer-generated Feedback on English Writing by Using Analysis of Variance
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The development of computer technology has made it possible to give immediate scoring and qualitative feedback to students’ writing. The purpose of the present study is to examine the influence of computer-generated feedback on Chinese high school students’ English writing. The paired sample t-test results suggested that English writing proficiency was significantly improved by providing automated writing feedback (p<0.001). One-way ANOVA analysis indicated that the writing scores on sub-skills related to content, organization, vocabulary usage, sentence construction, spelling and punctuation were significantly enhanced in the post-test (p<0.05/p<0.001). The statistical results of questionnaires showed that the students considered computer-generated feedback less effective than teacher written feedback (p< 0.05). Therefore, it would be more effective if both teacher written feedback and computer-generated feedback were used as feedback types in teaching writing for high school students in EFL context.

articleTitle: Analysis of Digital Media Image Data in "A Place to Nowhere"
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the popularization of digital media technology and equipment, movies are playing an increasingly important role in people's lives. Digital media image processing technology mainly relies on computers for design, and its application has brought a very big change of the movie viewing effect. This article introduces the meaning of emerging technologies of digital media, the practical application of computer image processing, and takes the film "A Place of Nowhere" as an example, and analyze its image processing data to discuss the application value of digital media image data onto movies.

articleTitle: Simple Implementation of Ensemble Learning Based Spark
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In recent years, machine learning has been playing an important role in mining the potential value of data. In the industry, large Internet enterprises generally build distributed machine learning platforms to provide more efficient machine learning service capabilities. However, most of the current ensemble learning in machine learning is only stand-alone version, which has some problems such as high time cost, memory inability to match large-scale data sets, and slow improvement of hardware performance. Distributed ensemble learning can greatly improve machine learning efficiency and reduce time costs based on large-scale data sets. It makes ensemble learning play a more effective role in large-scale data scenarios. In this paper, the decision tree is used as the base learner to extend Bagging and Boosting algorithms to the Distributed computing engine Spark, and the Spark Resilient Distributed Dataset is used to implement the random forest and optimal subset algorithms. With runtime, speedup and F1-score as evaluation indexes, comparative experiments were carried out on different a number of data sets and node numbers. The results show that F1-score is basically unchanged, and the runtime and speedup of the two algorithms are basically linear with the increase of node number. This shows that the distributed algorithm greatly reduces the time cost when the accuracy is basically unchanged. The parallel algorithm based on spark has good scalability and can support experiments on larger data sets.

Index Terms: Increase In The Number Of Nodes

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Train-to-Train Emergency communication in Tunnel Based on Double hop Relaying
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: As for the high bit error rate (BER) problem of train-to-train (T2T) communication system caused by multipath effects under high-speed railway (HSR) tunnel scenario, we designed a T2T emergency communication physical layer model based on double hop relaying. To meet the needs of emergency communication, we planned a 3D space trajectory of relaying through the interval tracking analysis of train operation states. To reduce the effect of multipath on the performance of wireless transmission links, we established a multi-antenna transmission model which was composed of frequency shift key control modulation (FSK), space-time block coding (STBC), pilot estimation. According to the multipath delay power distribution obtained by deterministic model of the tunnel, we derived the expression of average BER and outage probability in double hop relaying. The simulation results show that the BER and outage probability of the link are in line with the safety business requirement for train control, which are obtained by setting the number of antennas and channel attenuation parameters. The research result of this paper provides a certain theoretical basis for the high reliability transmission of T2T communication.

articleTitle: Abstractive summarization of long texts based on BERT and sequence-to-sequence model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Manual summarization of long text is labor-costing and time-consuming. Therefore, the automatic text summarization methods are necessary for information retrieval, text semantic mining, and question answering. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end automatic text summarization model (BSSA) based on the Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) and sequence-to-sequence model. First, the BERT model extracts the text feature as a part of the encoder. Second, the long short-term memory network generates the semantic feature of the text as another main part of the encoder. Finally, the decoder with an attention mechanism generates the abstractive summaries. The experimental results on both the Chinese and English datasets show that the BSSA model achieves significant improvements over the baseline models.

articleTitle: Construal Level and Guilt Promote Pro-Environmental Behavioral Intention: Based on Analysis of Variance
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The present study examined whether feasibility with respect to the distance between the trash bins and individuals significantly affects the waste sorting intention, and whether guilt promotes people’s waste sorting intention. Two factor mixed experimental design (feasibility: high vs. low) × 2 (guilt vs. control) was adopted to investigate the interactive effect of the spatial distance and guilt on waste separation behavioral intention. The sample of the study included 62 adults. We used the t-test and chi-square test to measure their behavioral intention. Analysis of variance (ANOVA) was conducted with the sorting intention of participants. The data was analyzed using SPSS.The results showed that participants having shorter distances with the sorting bins were more likely to perform the waste separation behavior than those which were far away from the sorting bins. However, sense of guilt played a significant role in moderating the relation between feasibility and waste separation behavioral intention in the adults. To conclude, individuals’ pro-environmental behavioral intention can be influenced by spatial distance, and the sense of guilt can perform pro-environmental behavior in individuals, even in situations with low feasibility.

articleTitle: Exploration And Practice Of Blended Teaching Based On Mobile Internet And Matlab : Taking The Course Of Mathematical Analysis As Example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Mathematical analysis is the most important course for students majoring in mathematics and engineering. This article discusses the blended teaching based on mobile internet and Matlab in the teaching of Mathematical Analysis course in local colleges and universities. The article first discusses the background of construction of the blended golden course. Then the importance of mathematical analysis courses and the necessity of developing blended teaching via mobile internet and Matlab are explained. Thirdly, we discuss how to use mobile internet and Matlab in the blended teaching for Mathematical Analysis course in local undergraduate colleges. Finally, we use the statistical u-test model to show that blended teaching based on mobile internet and Matlab has effectively improved the teaching effect and academic performance of students.

articleTitle: Cyborg: the new subject formed by man-machine convergence in digital educational space
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Compared with the traditional school classroom, the network classroom has changed a lot, not only a change in teaching methods and teacher-student interaction, but also a highly media convergence of people and media, which produce a new subject in classroom, cyborg. The new subject comes from the change of classroom environment, realizing through three steps: "the fusion of virtual and real space", "the unclear boundary between public and private", which leads to "the difficulty of role conversion". Cyborg has new behavior logic, which lead to the deconstructing in views of teacher-student, curriculum, teaching, and finally, the traditional pedagogy. As a result, the managers of education system and educators should realize the turning of subject in classroom, formulating better and suitable policies.

articleTitle: Applications Research of Multi-Modal in English Vocabulary Teaching Based on Experimental Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Multimodal vocabulary teaching means that teachers use pictures, colors, audio, video, actions and other means and resources to make the teaching ecology diversified. Even at present, multimodal vocabulary teaching has become an upsurge. Therefore, the application of multimodal theory in senior high school English vocabulary teaching has great theoretical and practical value. The author selects two classes of senior one in a senior middle school in Hangzhou as the research object, a total of 84 people. Among them, class 1 is the experimental class and class 2 is the control class. The experimental class adopts the vocabulary teaching method based on multimodal theory to carry out teaching activities, while the control class still adopts the traditional English vocabulary teaching method. Through the analysis of the experimental data, it can be concluded that the multimodal vocabulary teaching mode and language symbols interact to participate in the construction of meaning. Their interaction can not only effectively mobilize students’ vocabulary learning initiative, but also gradually improve students’ comprehensive ability of listening, speaking, reading, writing and translation.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of New Media in the Communication Strategy of Cultural and Creative Industry : Taking Chinese Game Industry as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The cultural and creative industry(CCI) is closely concerned with cultural soft power, and has become one of the economic pillars of many countries in recent years. With the widespread application of new media technology, its development model is also undergoing transformation. Using the Chinese game industry as an example, this article shows and analyzes some new media communication strategies, including Big Data Social Media Marketing, Planning the dedicated intellectual property, Games social, Celebrity influence, Live mode, Crossover cooperation. Moreover, Combined with the policy and development status of the cultural and creative industry, this paper gives suggestions and expectations for the future development of the industry. Through the way of example analysis and literature research, this study confirmed that the new media environment promotes the development of Cultural and Creative Industries. And it also studies the actual marketing strategy analysis, which gives practitioners and researchers a new concept for reference. Besides, the author puts forward the personal opinion to perfect the future industry related policy laws and regulations, as well as appeals to the public cultural inheritance, works with high quality and value.

articleTitle: Research on Accounting Information Sharing Mechanism : —Based on economic management perspective
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Accounting information sharing plays an important role in giving full play to the resource allocation effect of accounting information and improving economic management. The establishment of a socialized accounting information public service platform focusing on the disclosure of financial report data is one of the main tasks of the "13th Five-Year Plan" for accounting reform and development of the Ministry of Finance. Aiming at a series of problems caused by multiple submissions, different calibers, mutual independence, and non-sharing of current accounting information, this article explores the mechanism and realization path of accounting information sharing from the perspective of economic management, and proposes vertical integration, horizontal interaction, and Internal integration, unified nationwide accounting information sharing service system. Use cloud computing technology to establish an accounting information platform to realize "counting out and sharing resources" of accounting information.

articleTitle: Research on the Internet Ideological and Political Education of College Students Based on Orderly Logistic Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Government agencies and universities at all levels in China have formulated measures to implement ideological and political education in the Internet environment. Based on 1,428 survey samples from Guangdong Industry Polytechnic, under the condition of controlling the gender and grade control variables of college students, we use an ordered logistic regression model to analyze the challenges faced by college students’ ideological and political education. The empirical results show that grade and the dependent variable are significantly positively correlated, while gender is not significant. The other regression coefficients p all show significant negative correlation, that is, the more college students have access to Internet information, the longer the fragmented reading habits, and the longer online time, the more obvious the impact on their ideological and political education. This paper investigates the challenges faced by college students’ ideological and political education in the Internet context, and proposes coping strategies and eight implementation paths for three-levels of practitioners, hoping to improve the effectiveness of college students’ ideological and political education.

articleTitle: How should college modernized education deal with students' social media use? On social media platform: the impact of fear of missing out on College Students' Self-esteem
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In today’s universities, more and more college students frequently use social media, and what impact will this use have on them? How should schools face this situation? In order to answer these questions, this study selects the common use scenarios in college students’ daily life, such as fear of missing out and the impact on their self-esteem, and the use of social media is likely to have a negative impact on college students to a certain extent. This study aims to fill these gaps in the field of literature. In this study, 483 college students filled in the research scale. The results show that fear of missing out will increase college students’ different social media self-presentation, in which positive self-presentation will further produce online social anxiety and have a negative impact on self-esteem. My research shows that the positive self-presentation of social media caused by college students’ fear of missing out will make college students have a fragile self-esteem. Therefore, in modern university education, college students should be encouraged to display honest self-presentation and adopt the combination of positive self-presentation and honest self-presentation to make them have a strong self-esteem.

articleTitle: Application of "Four-step Progressive Practice" Teaching Method in the Course of "Entrepreneurship Guidance for College Students" in Vocational Education – Based on an Econometric Validation Analysis of "Fuzzy Set" Panel Data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Based on an econometric validation analysis of "fuzzy set" panel data, this paper verifies the effectiveness of the "Four-step Progressive" teaching method in teaching entrepreneurship courses for students at polytechnic colleges. It is basically concluded that the method is significantly related to the employment and entrepreneurship of college students, and can provide some reference for the teaching reform of vocational education.

articleTitle: Adaboost algorithm based on optimized loss function assists highway investment risk assessment
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Highway investment projects have the characteristics of large investment scale, long engineering period, and high requirements for engineering technology, quality, and safety. Throughout the construction period, materials, technology, personnel, environment, natural disasters, etc. will have an impact on the project. At present, academic circles at home and abroad have conducted in-depth and extensive research on the theories and methods of risk prediction for highway investment and construction projects. However, due to the many influencing factors of highway projects, the degree of influence of various influencing factors on the project varies greatly under different environments, and it is difficult to quantify the influencing factors with a general index system. Therefore, the current project risk research evaluation still adopts the method of expert scoring review and case study, and the survey and evaluation methods mainly use questionnaire survey method and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. This type of method has serious subjective factors, and it relies too much on expert experience, and often can only evaluate specific projects, and it is difficult to provide reference and expand directions for other projects. This paper introduces the optimized Adaboost algorithm to intelligently evaluate highway investment risks. Taking the past actual investment project data of China Jiaotong Second Highway Engineering Bureau as the research object, through the optimization of the loss function of the traditional Adaboost algorithm, the existing highway investment risk data and the model is constructed to realize the intelligent evaluation of the new project investment risk. The experimental results show that the optimized model improves the accuracy of risk prediction by 26%, and the effect is significant. It can provide risk assessment and decision-making services for future highway investment projects.

articleTitle: DID-Based Analysis on Higher Education Development Strategy in China
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Project 211, Project 985 and the Double First-Class Initiative are the 3 major higher education strategies in China. Does the above-mentioned development process have the characteristics of paradigm shift? To make it clear, the DID (Difference-in-Difference) Analysis is used, an approach in assessing the effects of a public policy. Based on the DID model, the Double First-Class Initiative, compared with Project 211 and Project 985, is more different than similar in areas like historical background, management system and mechanism, construction tasks and contents. That can be manifested from GDP increase and gross enrollment, flexibility and educational investment, contents and position, in the 2 periods between the year 2014-2015 and the year 2016-2017, which may be put with specific values, and evaluated comparatively through DID analysis. It is found out that a clear significant change occurs in areas like yearly GDP increase, gross enrollment, percentage taking up in GDP, mechanism flexibility, the contents and position, but not in yearly investment increase, or its rate. Hence the transition from Project 211 and Project 985, to the Double First-Class Initiative, is probably a shift in paradigm. The research provides a new perspective for paradigm shift in China’s higher education policy.

articleTitle: Exploring How Novice Medical Teachers Actually Teach in the Workplace: A Qualitative Study
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: A competent clinical educator not only improves trainees’ learning, but also ultimately ensures patient safety. However, most clinical teachers lacked formal teaching trainings. Little is known how doctors deliver teaching on the ground. This study is to explore how novice medical teachers deliver teaching in the frontline of health service in China. Semi-Structured in-depth interviews are used to investigate perspectives of novice supervisors from a China-based institution from April to May, 2019. It found that eleven clinicians were recruited, and the emerged six themes were related to interviews, such as preparedness, recognised identities, active teaching, collaboration with clients, ways to deal with challenges, and reflection and evaluation. Preparedness includes self-learning, group learning, and combination of individual experience. Five identities were indicated while preparing for teaching. Supervisors taught with modification, focused on learners, developed teaching format, and adapted teaching to speciality context. Teaching in clinic was intertwined with patients and trainees, and thus, reflection and evaluation were conducted in these two lines. Challenges merged from clinical settings were availability of resources, such as teaching materials and institutional supports. Unprepared supervisors learnt to teach through various approaches that combine school learning and working experience. The identities resulting from culture and social context allowed supervisors to actively shape the implementation of teaching. Supports such as faculty training, assurance of resource, workload balancing, are needed to ensure and improve the quality of teaching in clinical settings.

articleTitle: Research on the Cultivation Mode for Shipping Talents under the Background of Hainan Free Trade Port Based on Big Data Descriptive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: One of the primary duties of vocational education is to serve the needs of development of local economy. As the implementation of the Master Plan for the Construction of Hainan Free Trade Port, many ocean-going ships and shipping companies choose to register in Hainan, resulting in a significant increase in the demand for ship-related talents. For a long time, China has implemented strict registration system for ships, which only registration of vessels owned by local residents or companies are allowed. As a result, more than 2000 units of Chinese-funded international sailing ships choose to register in countries allowing open registration and fly flags of convenience for easier registration and taxes preference. On June 1, 2020, the Chinese government released the Master Plan for the Construction of Hainan Free Trade Port, putting forward to building more liberal shipping system in Hainan, China. Hainan Free Trade Port International Ship Registry Center has been established in order to facilitate ocean-going ships to register in Hainan with "Yangpu, China" as the registry port, and to attract Chinese-funded vessels under flags of convenience or foreign-funded vessels to register in Hainan.This paper uses descriptive analysis with the big data worldwide of commercial ships of 1000 GT and above released by United Nations Committee on Trade and Development (UNCTAD) 2019 to find out the general condition of Chinese-funded vessels in order to make a prediction of shipping talents demand in Hainan Free Trade Port.The descriptive analysis of big data is the analysis of various characteristics of a set of data in order to describe the characteristics of the measurement sample and the overall characteristics it represents, and to reveal the characteristics with charts, curves and other visual methods, provide advice and reference to user when making decision.The descriptive big data analysis shows that there are 34.91% of Chinese-funded ocean-going ships flying the flag of convenience, while the tonnage of those vessels accounts for 55.9% in 2019. The result reveals that a large number of Chinese-funded ships are sailing under the flag of convenience. The state promptly formulated the "master plan" including to establish international registration system so as to attract Chinese-funded ships to return and register in Hainan. In fact, the latest statistic shows the trend of returning of those Chinese-funded ship is obvious since the implementation of the plan. As a result, the free trade port needs a large number of shipping talents, including seafarers, shore-based management personnel, and other ship-related professionals. However, the cultivation scale of ship-related talents in Hainan cannot meet the huge demand for shipping talents caused by increasing registration of international trading ships and companies.This paper proposed a demand-orientated cultivation mode for shipping talents in higher vocational education in the view of serving the development of local economy under the background of Hainan Free Trade Port.

articleTitle: Based on Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Real-scene 3D Design and Implementation of Virtual Simulation Experiment System for Mine Smart Supervision in Large-scale Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Mine development is an economic activity in 3D space. UAV real-scene of 3D has become a new technical means for smart supervision of mine development. In order to better cultivate talents who understand not only the real-scene 3D data production of UAV, but also the knowledge, processes and economic calculation methods related to mine supervision with UAV data production, this paper designs and develops a virtual simulation experiment system that covers the entire process of mine surveying operations such as smart supervision applications and large-scale application project planning in the context of real-scene mines of 3D. The experimental system overcomes the traditional teaching method due to time, space and equipment limitations, which is difficult to meet the education needs of many students. It’s also provides practical training and experimental supporting programs for the urgent needs of new Geomatics Engineering technology application and modern management of natural resources for the construction tasks in the "Realistic 3D China Construction Technology Outline".

articleTitle: Analysis of the validity of the teaching evaluation data based on information entropy : —Take the teaching evaluation data of the Computer Department of Qinghai University as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The student evaluation mechanism plays an increasingly important role in the evaluation of classroom teaching quality in colleges and universities, and it has an important impact on improving the quality of teaching. In order to effectively analyze the authenticity of teaching evaluation, take the objective teaching data of Qinghai University's Department of Computing as an example. Under the a priori test of the coefficient of variation, effectively combining the proportion of the mean value and the information entropy, a measure of objective teaching evaluation data is proposed. The method of real information volume. The specific index items that reflect the real information under generalization evaluation are found, and the analysis result is nearly 5/6 consistent with the prior detection of the coefficient of variation, which further verifies the effectiveness of the method in this paper. However, feedback from the objective data is only part of the teaching evaluation information. Most of the assessees’ indicator feedback is good, and a few of the assessees are unqualified. The analysis results have certain reference significance for discovering the inherent laws of teaching evaluation data, assisting teaching management, and improving teaching quality.

articleTitle: English Classroom Face-to-face and Online Discussion Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the introduction of information technology, face-to-face discussion and online discussion have become the common formats of classroom communication, which is the necessity motivated by the willingness to communicate for language learning.
