Based on the previous studies into the influence factors of the willingness to communicate and the advantages of online discussion conducted on the online teaching platforms, this study explores the use of in-class face-to-face discussion and synchronous online discussion in English classrooms. After learning three types of English courses required by the College English curriculum, a group of Chinese university students completed a survey on their perception of the discussions organized during the English class time in the classroom. From the statistic analysis done by both the quantitative approach and the qualitative approach, the findings suggest that students’ interest and usefulness of the content are the major drives to motivate students to join in in-class discussion. However, lacking quick feedback from the interlocutors within limited time in class, more than half of students prefer face-to-face discussion, which implies that online teaching platforms are in need of being improved in terms of the function of grouping ideas so as to make quicker responses and feedback possible.

articleTitle: Application of Micro-lecture in Table Tennis Teaching for Children
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Objective: To improve children’s learning interest in table tennis and the basic techniques and build a solid foundation for lifelong exercise, this paper develops micro-lectures for teaching children table tennis in accordance with the law of their physical and mental development, as well as the techniques and tactics of this sport. Methods: This paper mainly adopts the experimental method, questionnaire surveys and mathematical statistics. The results show that: (1) The proposed micro-lectures on theoretical foundation, tactic demonstration, national ball culture and interesting table tennis by this research are feasible. (2) Table tennis teaching micro-lectures for children can promote their interest in table tennis learning. (3) Table tennis teaching micro-lectures for children can improve their basic table tennis techniques.

articleTitle: Construction of Multidimensional International Language Training System based on Analytic Hierarchy Process for Modern Hotels
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the improvement of living standards, people are more and more willing to consume tourism, which promotes the development of modern hotel industry. Firstly, this paper introduces the definition, characteristics, innovation and significance of international language. Then, the analytic hierarchy process is used to analyze the objective and subjective factors in the process of international language learning, and an international language training system for modern hotels is constructed. Finally, it discusses how to achieve the systematic teaching goal through online and offline teaching and on-campus and off-campus training, so as to provide senior hotel management talents with good international language application ability for the modern hotel industry.

articleTitle: Research and Practice on Course Design of Ship Bridge Resource Management : Working Process Systematic Curriculum Development Based on the Grey Correlation Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the shipping industry, most ship casualties are caused by human factors. To deal with these kind of situation, Bridge Resource Management (BRM) in the mandatory training standards for ship officers was adopted by International Maritime Organization (IMO) in Manila Amendment to the STCW Convention of 2010. This paper uses big data grey correlation analysis of human error based on written accident investigation report. The grey correlation big data analysis is a multi-factor statistical analysis method, which uses grey correlation degree to describe the strength and order of the relationship between factors on the basis of the sample of each factor. If the sample big data column reflects the change trend of the two factors is basically the same, the correlation degree between them is large. On the contrary, the correlation degree is small.Big data grey correlation analysis of human error based on written accident investigation report data for over 100 vessels under collision casualty between 1993 and 2003 the statistical probability of ship accidents being caused by human factors is 86%. Therefore, it is necessary to strengthen the training of BRM courses for seafarers and reduce human error resulting in casualties during navigation. As the contents and model of BRM training vary from home to abroad, there is no unified BRM training curriculum in China. The statistics of the National BRM assessment examination in the past six years by China MSA, the average pass rate is only 83%, which does not match the requirement of the trend of increasingly large and modernized ships. So it is necessary to develop appropriate BRM courses. With the theory of work process systematization, this paper summarized the typical working process of BRM, takes the risk degree as the reference frame, constructs the learning situation from simple to complex, and constructs the BRM course based on work process systematization. It is well used to train crews to apply Bridge Resources correctly, and to operate ships and avoid risks in different situations so as to get the ability of proper understanding of practical condition and changing tendency; the ability of sensitive observation of practical condition and changing tendency around ship; the ability of thorough identification of influence of changing situation around ship on movement and the ability of proper prediction of near-term future and safety situation and to eliminate the casualties caused by human errors.

articleTitle: A Study on the Effect of Data-driven Traditional Chinese Medicine English Corpus on Students’ Learning Anxiety in ESP Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: To investigate the learning anxiety of college students in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) English ESP teaching in a domestic college of TCM, analyze the causes, and propose to improve it by using the data-driven model of TCM English corpus. 330 students were randomly selected for grouping experiment. The self-made TCM English Ability Scale, Corpus Data-driven Effectiveness Scale and Foreign Language Classroom Anxiety Scale (FLCAS) were used to measure, and the relevant data were analyzed by SPSS 24.0. The results are shown that students’ learning anxiety in TCM learning was at a serious level; There was no significant difference in learning anxiety among students of different genders and ages; The data-driven model of TCM English corpus can significantly improve students’ English performance; There is a significant negative correlation between the data-driven effectiveness of TCM English corpus and students’ learning anxiety; The data-driven effectiveness of TCM English corpus can significantly predict students’ learning anxiety. Based on the data-driven theory, the effective application of TCM English Corpus in ESP teaching can improve students’ motivation, interest and efficiency in the process of English learning.

articleTitle: The Ecological Affordances of Blended Learning Mode in College English Teaching Based on Information and Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Due to the pervasion of Information and Communication Technology (ICT) in all facets of human lives, the utilization of ICT in College English education becomes an unavoidable trend in the current competitive world. Undeniably, traditional teaching approach is not meeting modem learning needs, but the wide application of online resources and means fails to guarantee the improvement of students’ motivation, engagement and academic performance. The blended learning is a product of the integration of ICT into curriculum. It combines face-to-face classroom teaching methods with online educational materials and opportunities, mixing the strengths of both learning environments and overwhelming almost all their shortcomings. This paper aims to adopt the theory of affordance to frame the use of ICT within the blended learning mode in College English teaching and investigate the ecological affordances the ICT-facilitated blended learning environment provides.

articleTitle: Visual analysis of female and innovation: research progress and hotspot analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The aim of this study is to investigate the academic progress in the female and innovation study. Firstly, this paper used the systematic literature research method to screen the literature related to women and innovation, and obtained 130 relevant papers which are published between 2005 and 2021. Then CiteSpace 5.8.R2 visualization software was used to perform co-citation analysis and research hotspot and frontier analysis on the literature. At the end of the paper, future research directions on women’s innovation were proposed.

articleTitle: Research on the Hot Spots and Trends of Innovation and Entrepreneurship in Higher Vocational Colleges Based on Document Visualization Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Analyze the achievements of China’s higher vocational colleges in the field of innovation and entrepreneurship, sort out the theories and research frameworks in this field, grasp research hotspots and trends, and provide reference suggestions for the cultivation of innovative technical talents in higher vocational colleges. With bibliometrics as the theoretical basis and research methods, using research methods such as knowledge graph generation, cluster analysis etc. to carry out visual analysis and research in the field of innovation and entrepreneurship in higher vocational colleges. From the dimensions of publication trends, research institutions, distribution of hot spots, and evolutionary trends, it systematically displays the dynamic map of vocational colleges’ education models in the field of innovation and entrepreneurship and talent training research. The development of innovation and entrepreneurship in higher vocational colleges in my country is divided into five stages, and research trends and hotspots in this field are predicted. Based on this, higher vocational colleges are expanding their research perspectives, innovative research methods. The research content is more detailed and indepth in three aspects to make relevant suggestions.

articleTitle: Design and development of a highly integrated three-dimensional teaching material for mining based on live drone
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Stereoscopic teaching materials are based on traditional paper-based teaching materials, with the help of modern information technology, and through the scientific integration of multimedia, multi-form, multi-role and multi-level teaching resources thus proposing an overall teaching solution for a course. With the current development of technology, teaching materials need to be reformed in line with the situation, strengthening the development of three-dimensional teaching materials and building three-dimensional teaching materials that are rich in supporting resources, diverse in form and highly interactive. In recent years, the environmental damage to mineral resources has been serious and the comprehensive management of mining areas has received unprecedented attention. However, due to the remoteness of mining sites, teaching activities are difficult to organize and traditional paper-based teaching materials are difficult to achieve good teaching results, so it is necessary to develop three-dimensional teaching materials on mining. In this paper, we develop a highly integrated three-dimensional teaching material on mining by using aerial photography of drones as the information carrier, and organically integrating high-precision panoramic images from drones, three-dimensional tilted models, VR technology and paper long-form maps. It provides an extremely detailed and hierarchical information carrier for teaching courses in mining, incorporates rich knowledge content to digitally present the mine and carries out the integration of online and offline education.

articleTitle: Research on the effectiveness of narrative design into science educational products in the science and technology museum based on the user experience hive model and Likert scale analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The effectiveness of narrative design applied to science educational products is studied. By sorting out the research status of science educational products in the science and technology museum, the feasibility of introducing narrative design into science educational products is explored, and the elements of narrative design for science educational products are constructed and the design path is explored. Using questionnaires, background data records, user interviews, and other methods to collect user feedback, data analysis, and combined with the user experience hive model, Likert scale analysis, completed an empirical study of the effectiveness of the science educational program "The Story of Ten Bottles" of Wuhan Science and Technology Museum. The results show that narrative design can improve the effectiveness of science educational products’ content communication in practice.

Author Keywords: the path of narrative design of science educational products

articleTitle: Exploration on Internationalization of Graduate Education under the Big Data-Driven Era -- Based on the Nanyang Technological University Case
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: As the basis of the output of high-end talents, graduate education has gradually become a hot topic of academic research under the background of national globalization and informationization strategy. This study summarizes the experience of Nanyang Technological University’s graduate education internationalization management model based on the big data-driven model. Based on The Eclectic Theory of International Production, this study innovatively explored the combination of internationalization and informationization of graduate education in China from the Ownership-Location-Intemalization perspective, and summarizes strategies and methods for improving the internationalization of graduate education, so as to contribute to the internationalization of graduate education in China.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis on Evaluation Index System of Higher Education Based on CIPP Evaluation Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The development level of higher education is an important symbol of a country’s comprehensive national strength and development potential. In view of the comprehensive evaluation system of higher education, this paper uses the CIPP evaluation model to conduct qualitative and quantitative processing of the eleven indexes collected. Perform Max-Min data normalization; Using the TOPSIS evaluation model based on entropy weight, the weight coefficients of each index are determined, and the comprehensive scores of higher education evaluation system are obtained. The comprehensive ranking of the fourteen countries analyzed is selected in this paper. The experiment analysis result shows our model has strong vitality and sustainable development ability, and plays a certain guiding role in the development of national higher education. Through factor analysis, the key indicators affecting the higher education evaluation system are found to verify the correctness of the TOPSIS Evaluation model based on entropy weight.

articleTitle: The Status Quo and Path of Traditional Chinese Music Communication on Short Video Platforms - Taking TikTok as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the rapid development of new media, the new information communication environment has been further optimized and constructed, and both the content and mode of communication have changed to a great extent. The dissemination of traditional Chinese music with the help of new media is conducive to the improvement of people’s aesthetic ability, cognitive ability and emotional experience. This paper studied and analyzed the current situation of the spread of traditional Chinese music in TikTok through short video transmission and questionnaires, and concludes that TikTok as a new media platform should undertake the responsibility of spreading the traditional music culture.

articleTitle: Research on educational video summary extraction algorithm based on semantic analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Educational videos are growing exponentially, and efficiently obtaining core video clips has become an urgent problem. Keyframe extraction is an effective means of creating video summaries, which reduces the storage burden and improves video retrieval speed. To address the importance of text information in educational videos, we propose a new keyframe extraction algorithm based on inter-frame text semantic analysis - KFEVSA. Firstly, text recognition is performed based on OCR technology, and the sampled frames are stored separately according to text frameset and non-text frameset. Secondly, text- similarity and perceptual hashing algorithms are used to process the two framesets to generate their respective key framesets. Finally, the two sets of keyframes are combined in chronological order to generate the final video summary set. The experimental comparison on a benchmark dataset of educational video summaries created by multiple users shows that this method accurately describes the video content and generates fewer redundant frames than traditional methods.

articleTitle: Serious Game Design of Cultural Heritage Education based on the Experiential Learning Cycle Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Traditional cultural heritage education mainly relies on the museum’s display design and supplementation of exogenous materials, and most digital cultural heritage displays are based on the same principle. This process makes it difficult for tourists to absorb cultural knowledge actively and effectively. This article proposes a serious game of cultural heritage education based on the experiential learning cycle model, which provides a single-player experience environment on the computer with 3D modeling in the context of cultural heritages, and strengthens people’s active construction of cultural heritage knowledge through game narrative, interaction and knowledge cards. Subsequently, a user test was conducted to verify whether the game design plays a role in real users. A total of 55 postgraduates participated in the experiment. Results show that the proposed design is feasible and can play a positive role in enhancing the learning effect, learning experience and learning initiative of learners, but more comprehensive tests are still needed to better investigate its use in formal education environments.

articleTitle: Research on a Blended Teaching Mode Design Focused on Students’ Language Output in the Course of Selected Reading of English Newspapers and Periodicals
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This article aims to investigate a more efficient blended teaching mode to strengthen students’ language output through a project-based and content-based course design in the course of Selected Reading of English Newspapers and Periodicals. With the assist of WeChat-based Teachermate platform and web-based interaction and evaluation tools, the output-oriented English newspaper reading course successfully combines the technology application and language-learning together to realize an effective teaching situation. By designing a series of output-oriented tasks and conducting a variety of big data researches, both students and teachers pursue not only language proficiency, but also other skills and capacities like information-processing ability, media knowledge and skills, etc. to fit into this information-and-news explosion era.

articleTitle: Student evaluation system of comprehensive practical courses in Vocational Colleges Based on Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The fuzzy analytic hierarchy process uses the membership degree of the evaluation set to represent the comprehensive evaluation results, realizes the quantitative calculation of the problems with unclear boundary to determine the nature, and realizes the objective overall evaluation of the evaluation objects restricted by many factors. By analyzing the problems of the existing student evaluation system of comprehensive practical courses, this paper determines the evaluation indexes in the student evaluation system. Using the fuzzy analytic hierarchy process, firstly, the membership matrix is established, then the weight matrix is obtained by normalizing the weight coefficient of experts, and the fuzzy evaluation matrix is synthesized. Finally, the evaluation result is obtained by multiplying the weight matrix and the fuzzy evaluation matrix. This paper selects the single chip microcomputer comprehensive practice course as the starting point to verify the feasibility of the evaluation system, and continuously improve the connotation of the system through practice. The course experimented shows that the student evaluation system of the comprehensive practice course has a good effect in the whole of week training single chip microcomputer technology.

Author Keywords: Integrated practical course of single chip microcomputer

articleTitle: Application of big data analysis in college employment
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Nowadays, the Internet is developing rapidly, changing people’s lifestyle, and constantly impacting the field of college employment, making the employment of college graduates gradually difficult. However, similarly, the emergence of computer big data has also brought a new opportunity to the field of college employment. Big data analysis can collect and sort out the online recruitment information and relevant data in Shanghai, attract enterprises and students to register, screen suitable talents for enterprises and provide jobs for college graduates, solve the needs of both sides, improve the accuracy and efficiency of college employment, and alleviate the employment difficulty of college graduates. This paper constructs a big data platform, which collects the data information of college students and enterprises, understands the user needs, connects them to various data sources and target storage systems, then analyzes the data information of both sides, and designs a work recommendation model based on multiple linear regression, so as to find suitable jobs and enterprise employees for college students and enterprises.

articleTitle: Exploration and Practice of Blended Teaching Based on Hierarchical-Classification-Gradation Teaching and Evaluation Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In view of the problems faced by personnel training of preselected non-commissioned officers(NCO) in data exchange equipment operation, such as the unclear characteristics of course teaching content, the optimization of teaching organization form and content, the strengthening of students’ information literacy, and the imperfection of multi-party linkage talent training mechanism, we take the online and offline blended teaching as the main starting point, establish a hierarchical-classification-gradation teaching and evaluation model, and use online and offline blended teaching to promote the teaching reform of data exchange equipment operation through mixing enriching the forms of equipment operation and maintenance practice teaching activities, expanding the training channels of equipment operation and maintenance, and promoted the improvement of students’ innovative and practical ability, it has formed a training quality improvement mode of data exchange equipment operation specialty of "advanced stratification, learning classification and target classification". Through the statistics, comparison and analysis of the three-year teaching assessment data, it shows that the blended teaching mode can improve the learning efficiency of students.

articleTitle: Application of SeeFiberTool and SeeFiberLaser in the Curriculum of Fiber Optics
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Fiber optics plays a very important role in the curriculum frame of optics and photonics for graduate and postgraduate students in the major of optical engineering. Here we introduce the basic functions of two useful self-developed software namely SeeFiberTool and SeeFiberLaser. By embedding physical equations, SeeFiberTool is a convenient tool collection that can be installed on either smartphone or a personal computer. SeeFiberLaser is a powerful virtual simulation lab for the numerical simulation of pulsed and continuous-wave fiber lasers. Their applications in the teaching process of fiber optics are discussed in order to improve the teaching qualities.

articleTitle: A method for recommending multi-interest learning resources based on capsule networks and learning styles
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the integration of Internet technology and the education field, online education has been developing rapidly. Learners tend to use online education platforms as a fast and efficient way to acquire knowledge. Nevertheless, it is not easy for users to get the learning resources they are interested in from massive data. Introducing recommendation algorithms commonly used in the e-commerce field into e-learning platforms is an efficient way. However, the current recommendation systems are not sensitive enough to the multiple-interest extraction of learners, which leads to the ineffectiveness of recommended learning resources. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a learning resource recommendation method based on capsule networks and learning styles for learners’ multiple interests. The Felder- Silverman learning style quantified table is introduced to model users’ learning style preferences. Experiments prove that the method proposed in this paper is more efficient in real datasets compared with existing recommended methods.

articleTitle: Distributed storage method of College Students' Digital Archives Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The existing distributed storage method of college students’ digital files has the problem of imperfect storage medium structure, which leads to the execution time of the method being too long. A distributed storage method of college students’ digital files based on cloud computing is designed. College students with the information dependencies, chain of digital archive information resources characteristics, through the storage management equipment or software access control data, adjust the structure of a storage medium, quantify the cluster of storage medium load, using cloud computing resource integration model was constructed, after the catalog file directory information uploaded to the central archives, optimization of distributed storage mode. Experimental results: The average execution time of the distributed storage method of college student digital files in this paper and the other two distributed storage methods of college student digital files are respectively 1979 ms, 2561ms, 2624 ms, proving that the distributed storage method of college student digital files integrated with cloud computing has higher application value.

articleTitle: Application of BIM Technology to project management objectives
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Under the new situation, it is the general trend to carry out practical innovation and theoretical reform of engineering project management. We must break through the traditional thinking and re-establish the new thinking of project management with the three basic objectives of quality control, progress control and investment control. BIM Technology can play a great role in construction project management and open up a new road for project management, it has also become a bridge and tool for the construction industry to fully move towards informatization, so as to help project managers make scientific management and scientific decisions and create high-quality projects.

articleTitle: Study on the application of the Mass Communication Technology in Ideological and Political
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, human beings enter into the information society, accompanied by the growth of various new technologies. Thus mass communication inaugurates the era of mass media, which provides opportunities and brings great convenience for the ideological and political education. Meanwhile, the ideological and political education confronts a great challenge. The mass media provides modern channels and means which also expands the influence and difficulty of ideological and political education. How to effectively use the mass media as a carrier of the ideological and political education is very worthy to be considered. This study uses a narrative qualitative approach by introducing the situation and concept of the research of the ideological and political education under the mass media environment, clarifying characteristics and classification of the mass media at home and abroad, and discussing the positive effects and negative effects of mass media. The way to deal with negative effects is given for the mass media to better serve the ideological and political education.

articleTitle: Construction of Business Continuity Management Audit Information Model based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In order to realize the improvement of business continuity management audit level in the daily work of an enterprise, this paper constructs the data and information processing model of business continuity management audit based on Bayes network structure and fuzzy set theory, and introduces the cloud data analysis technology in big data technology. In this model, the deep neural network model is mainly used for analysis and calculation to improve the work efficiency and quality of the data information processing model, and it is expected to play a greater role in future work.

articleTitle: Application of mixed teaching based on Linux information processing technology platform : Taking the course of basic accounting as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the development of educational technology, traditional classroom is gradually changing to mixed learning. Hybrid teaching mode is a new teaching mode that organically combines online teaching with traditional classroom teaching. Teachers change their role from teaching to guidance, students change from passive to active, and learning activities are more rich and flexible. The implementation of hybrid teaching needs to rely on the teaching platform with interactive function, the open teaching platform based on Embedded Linux information processing technology, take imx6 as the core processor, and operate independently in process mode according to the functional requirements of different information processing, so as to facilitate the upload and playback of video resources and effectively improve the teaching quality. As an introductory course of accounting major, Fundamentals of accounting adopts mixed teaching method, which has significantly improved the teaching effect and is deeply welcomed by students.

articleTitle: Signal processing technology curriculum reform for short-semester professional postgraduates
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper introduces the curriculum reform achievements of signal processing technology course for short-semester professional postgraduate students majored in electronic information in Shanghai University. In order to cultivate the innovation and active learning ability, the latest academic research papers are used to carry out case and project based teaching by combining industry expert lectures and MOOC video lectures, with signal processing theory lectures. By reforming objectives of the practical teaching system and implementing complex modern signal processing algorithms for several actual engineering cases, a new blending learning system is constructed with course algorithm implementation, personal project practice, and group project practice. A teaching case on the application of adaptive filtering in active vibration control is taken as an example to introduce the specific process of the course teaching of how to carry out the teaching activities in the short semester system of Shanghai University.

articleTitle: Using SPSS to Analyze the Mental Health Status of Community Residents and Explore the Service Path
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The community is the cell unit of the city, and the adaptation to community life is an important sign of mental health. This study uses SPSS to perform variance analysis on subjective well-being and mental health,compares the psychological differences between different groups of people,verifies the mental health service needs of community residents,and proposes to start from the aspects of precise policy implementation, team training, linkage mechanism, etc.,and propose construction Optimize the specific implementation model of the gradual development path of"activity-project-comprehensive",and try to improve the community psychological service mechanism of "prevention-intervention-treatment-recovery-maintenance-development" and explore a new model of grid-based community psychological service. <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>

articleTitle: Research on Visualization Structure Representation of Image Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: A study of the visual properties of image processing technology and the design features of image processing. In the context of today’s general development of computer and digital media technology and visual interaction technology, decoding research and analysis of image processing information based on a variety of means such as psychology, linguistics, semiotics and imaging technology, resulting in a cross-disciplinary approach to image processing technology. The study of the hierarchical structure of image processing, the development of forms of image processing for visual communication, and the clarification of forms of decoding the feedback of images sent and received in the context of interaction. Image processing technology is particularly important in the context of the information visualisation era, where a clear image processing logic is required and where multiple aspects such as the logical structure of information, the hierarchical information structure, and subjective mapping have a greater impact on the approach to image processing.

articleTitle: Design and Practice of the Online Flipped Classroom under the Guidance of Learning Drive Based on a Network Teaching Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In view of the lack of data extraction and analysis means in the current flipped classroom teaching and the inability to accurately judge whether teaching can effectively stimulate students’ learning drive, starting with the research on the impact on students’ learning motivation, an online flipped classroom teaching mode is designed and practiced which includes three stages: online self-study guidance before class, online discussion guidance in class and online expansion guidance after class. At the same time, with the help of network teaching platform the data of classroom interaction, self-study ability and learning drive are statistically analyzed. The data show that this model plays an obvious role in stimulating students’ learning drive, improving teamwork and self-study ability, but it also brings psychological pressure and difficulties to students. The research results provide support for exploring the core advantages of flipped classroom, improving students’ internal motivation, and improving and optimizing the teaching mode of online flipped classroom.

articleTitle: Exploration of Iterative Task-driven Actual and VR Equipment Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Equipment teaching is an important teaching form in post-oriented education, as well as an important way to realize the transformation from mastering technical principles to equipment application ability. With the rapid development of VR technology, the training based on virtual reality (VR) equipment can be used as an effective supplement to the actual equipment training. However, in the teaching process, the long-term existence of problems still cannot adapt to the teaching requirements of post ability orientation in the new situation. In this paper, focusing on improving the effectiveness of equipment teaching mixed with VR devices, we explore the teaching method with iterative task-driven actual and VR equipment teaching. Firstly, the equipment teaching objectives are analyzed from three aspects of knowledge, ability, and quality. Then, the main idea of iterative task-driven teaching is introduced. Thirdly, the implementation approach of iterative task-driven equipment teaching is given, as well as the relationship between actual equipment training tasks and VR equipment training tasks. In this manner, it can effectively integrate and internalize knowledge in equipment practice, and improve the comprehensive ability and thinking level of the trainees.

articleTitle: The Significance of Research on Attentional Bias in Internet Addiction to Improve Education and Teaching Methods--Research Based on Meta-analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Internet addiction is a big problem in today’s society, and adolescents’Internet addiction is especially common. Therefore, it is of great significance to use the characteristics of attentional bias research on Internet addiction to improve teaching and education methods. Meta analysis technology is used to study the relationship between adolescent Internet addiction and attention bias, in order to alleviate the symptoms of adolescent Internet addiction, improve the mental health level of students at all levels and types of schools in the future education, and provide information on the school mental health related fields in future education. The theoretical value and practical significance of teaching and research. This research searched the following databases to identify seven articles: PubMed and web of science. The search terms are: Internet addiction, attention to bias, attention to measurement. Data processing adopts CMA2.0 (comprehensive Meta analysis), SPSS 2.0 and EXCEL. In the confirmed seven studies, all provided evidence that these addicts have cognitive biases. The purpose of this study is to explore the significance of attentional bias in Internet addiction to education. It turns out that the research paradigm of attentional bias in Internet addiction can accurately identify adolescents with Internet addiction. The second teacher can use the attentional bias of Internet addiction to design teaching methods. Third, the study of attentional bias in Internet addiction contributes to the development of educational forms.

articleTitle: Research on the Teaching Strategy of BOPPPS in the Intelligent Environment of Smart Classroom
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Smart classroom is a new classroom built with the help of Internet of things technology, cloud computing technology and intelligent technology. Combined with the existing problems in teaching practice, this paper demonstrated and analyzed the feasibility and necessity of the deep integration of smart classroom intelligent environment and BOPPPS teaching from three aspects, and put forward the six link teaching strategy of BOPPPS teaching smart classroom intelligent environment, so as to promote the innovation of BOPPPS teaching model and the reform of teaching strategy in the smart classroom environment.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Communication of Short Videos for Male Make-up : -A Topic Modeling Analysis Based on Tweet Data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In recent years, male beauty bloggers on short video platforms have gradually emerged and swept the Internet as a new group that differed from female beauty bloggers and others. And this has become a common phenomenon. In this paper, computer communication and Big Data are used to analyze the tweet data of male beauty bloggers, and build a topic model to reconstruct the transmission path of male beauty short videos and summarize the law behind it.

articleTitle: The application and prospect of educational technology innovation in adolescent cognitive development
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Traditional educational technology is mechanically repetitive and boring, and ignores the cultivation of non-intellectual factors, which limits the ability of multi-angle thinking. With the innovation of science and technology and the development of society, adolescent education technology is constantly updated. VR, AR and MR technologies, for example, not only revolutionize education and teaching technologies, but also promote the cognitive development of teenagers. The integration of VR, AR and MR technologies into the education of teenagers not only expands the tools and space of education and teaching, but also plays a positive role in the cognitive development of teenagers, the cultivation of thinking and the formation of children’s personality and psychology. At present, there are many researches on the application of virtual reality and augmented reality to adolescent cognitive development in primary and secondary schools. However, there are still few researches on the construction of a new teaching method of "multi-mode + human-computer collaboration" by carrying out cognitive development teaching based on MR and focusing on multi-mode data representation such as vision, hearing and touch. Based on this, this paper will focus on VR and cognitive development teaching based on MR technology.

articleTitle: A two-stage underwater image enhancement method
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Scattering and absorption result in color shift and low visibility of underwater images. To handle the mentioned issues, this paper proposes a two-stage underwater image enhancement method. In the first stage, this paper proposes a piece-wise linear stretching method to remove the color shift. In the second stage, this paper introduce a contrast enhancement method based on local mean value to improve the contrast and detail of the output image, which uses a sliding window to enhance each pixel value by scanning pixel-by-pixel. Experiments on a real-world underwater image enhancement dataset demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms several state-of-the-art methods in qualitative and quantitative.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Digital Network Technology in the Countryside under the Internet Background
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, Internet technology and the progress of rural modernization have gradually become closer. Problems such as rural imbalance and network congestion still exist. Therefore, the empowerment of rural areas with digital network technology is both an objective reality and a future trend. This article combines the advantages of network communication technology, sensor technology, video surveillance technology and digital media 3D, CG, and VR technology in information dissemination to the countryside. At the same time, a method of capturing and identifying rural tourism based on network data is proposed, which is an idea for the innovation and development of digital network technology in rural design, and hopes to provide help for relevant workers.

articleTitle: Research on Data Analysis, Processing and Model Construction of "Purple Collar" Talent Development Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Aiming at the new situation of the development of vocational education under the background of the intelligent era, this article combs the data of professional talents in the intelligent manufacturing industry under the background of big data, adopts big data analysis methods, studies the data distribution and statistical algorithms of "purple collar" professional talents, and builds professional talents. The data processing model of the talent ability of the position proposes a digital solution for the training mode and path of "purple collar" talents.

Author Keywords: cultivation and construction of "purple collar" talents

articleTitle: Study on the Application of Artificial Intelligence Technology in Empowering Education : Taking "Intelligent Learning Partner" as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, society has entered an era where artificial intelligence is integrated with all aspects of life, and the impact of artificial intelligence on education has attracted more attention. How does artificial intelligence technology development and what are key technologies integrated with education? And its current development status in the field of education. This article takes the "Smart Learning Partner", an educational product that integrates several number of smart technologies from the Beijing Normal University Future Education Advanced Innovation Center, as an example, and its three application cases in teaching practice: 1. Hybrid based on "Smart Learning Partner" The exploration and analysis of the model teaching model, 2. "Smart Study Partner " to promote the exploration of the precision teaching of junior high school history, 3. The construction and application model research of the discipline ability development evaluation learning and teaching system.

articleTitle: Construction and application of constitution online learning Platform based on mobile Internet technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Based on Mobile Internet technology (Mobile Internet) constitution online learning platform is a suitable for the current college students group application, relying on Mobile terminals, in the Mobile communication network environment can be used in the network online learning platform. Under the mobile Internet technology, relying on the widespread use of mobile terminal equipment and comprehensive coverage of mobile communication network, mobile Internet applications are gradually diversified, and the functions covered are further enriched and powerful. Successively set up by the constitution on the basis of online learning platform is designed to enrich college students knowledge of the constitution of the way to learn, such as online learning, games, problem solving, interactive communication function module, convenient for students to use of fragmented time to improve the in-depth study and comprehensive understanding of the constitution of knowledge, make up for the shortcomings of traditional passive rigid teaching way, it can effectively improve the enthusiasm of students to study the constitution.

articleTitle: A Survey and Analysis of Flipped Classroom in Microsoft Office Application Course Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With accelerating development of vocational education, traditional teaching methods can no longer meet the needs of higher vocational colleges, and a large number of new teaching models like flipped classrooms have emerged. This article takes the “Modern Information Technology” course in a higher vocational college in Huangshi as an example. A total of 108 students were surveyed, including 60 boys and girls and 108 questionnaires were distributed before the implementation of the project. Subsequently, the practice of flipped classroom was carried out. After the practice, the questionnaires were issued again. It turns out that, 34.55% of students like flipped classrooms very much, compared with traditional teaching. 50.91% of the students said they like flipped classroom; 14.55% of the students said that the effect of flipped classroom is average. After the practice of flipped classroom teaching, students have a positive attitude towards the flipped classroom teaching model, and 80% of students are more willing to add the Internet to the classroom.

articleTitle: Systematic analysis of big Data Mining Technology in Higher Mathematics Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the application and development of big data technology, it began to enter the digital era. Through big data technology, we can perceive and record large-scale and various data information of mathematics teaching, analyze and process these data information, and deeply excavate the internal structure and core system of mathematics teaching. With the data mining and data operation under big data technology, the digital process of mathematics teaching is promoted. At the same time, big data technology processes a large amount of data information in mathematics classroom through the functions of storage, analysis and visualization. Big data technology provides a new teaching model for mathematics teaching, establishes an effective mathematics teaching model, and helps higher mathematics teaching realize all-round data teaching and intelligent learning.

articleTitle: Study on the Application of the Digitalization and Information Technology of Community Governance in the Post-epidemic Era
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Digital information technology played an important role in community governance during the outbreak of the epidemic in China. In the post-epidemic era, through research on the development process of digital information technology in community governance, it was found that there were "information islands" in the digital direction of community governance during the new epidemic, and the use rate of digital information platforms was low and active. Therefore, by creating a digital information platform for community residents, proposing an information collection model for community residents, further strengthening the construction of the "new infrastructure" of the community through digital information tools such as WeChat groups, mini-programs, and APPs, and increasing the usage rate of digital information tools such as location bracelets during the quarantine period of the epidemic in the community, we promote the use of digital information technology in community governance. The project aims to promote the use of digital information technology in community governance in the post-epidemic era in the direction of sharing information, professionalizing education, publicizing the platform, and sustaining "wisdom", to create a modern "smart (digital) community".

articleTitle: Cartoon image processing and promotion strategy based on AI intelligent technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper mainly explores cartoon image processing from the perspective of intelligent technology. It takes cartoon image shaping as the starting point to construct cartoon image intelligent database. On this basis, this paper proposes an AI intelligent cartoon image processing method. The algorithm concept of this technology is novel and the process is clear. It can intelligently identify the physical image and shape the three-dimensional scene of cartoon image. Using intelligent technology to process information materials can improve the high effectiveness and influence of cartoon images. This paper focuses on the common characteristics of brands and cartoon images to discuss the compatibility of brands and cartoon images, and further promote the development of brand vision.

articleTitle: A Case Study on Cultivation of Intercultural Communication Competent: An Approach of Collaborative Blended teaching in EFL Classroom
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the visualized analysis of CiteSpace 5.8 R1, the study presents findings on the emerging research issues of Intercultural Communication Competence (ICC) in EFL classroom. Since 2002, researchers have begun to explore the technology of telecollaboration to promote ICC from students’ perspective, but they seldom pay attention to the collaboration between teachers in ESP course with information technology - digital teaching platforms. Through the case study of the ESP course Intercultural Communication implemented at an application-oriented college, the paper tries to explore the efficacy of the approach, a collaborative blended teaching model between Chinese and foreign teachers, which aims to improve students’ ICC through lecture, case study, and project-based learning. With qualitative and quantitative data collection, the paper explores how the application of cooperative blended teaching in process, such as pedagogical objectives, selection of teaching materials and web tools, learning tasks, evaluation on students’ performance and achievement. The findings showed that students perceived the со-blended teaching positive for intercultural communication as teachers setting the models in well designed tasks. With the assistant of an online teaching platform, the problems students faced, such as pragmatic use of English, the lack of confidence in communication and strategies in English learning, can be solved.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Case Teaching Mode of Management Science and Engineering under the Support of Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the advent of the information age, the modern information technology with computer network as the core not only changes the human life, work and learning mode, but also brings unprecedented impact to the educational problems in the new century. The combination of information technology of multimedia network and various different courses is also the most popular teaching mode, through the combination of information technology management science and engineering major, to a certain extent can promote the diversification of teaching content, create a good environment for students 'learning of learning environment, make information technology really become students cognitive, explore and solve problem tools, at the same time cultivate students’ information literacy and use information technology to explore, solve problem ability. This paper tells the new way out of management science and engineering under the support of information technology, and puts forward its own views for this model.

articleTitle: Research on information management innovation of graduation project (Thesis) in Universities
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The graduation design (Thesis) of Application- oriented Colleges and universities in Shaanxi Province generally has the problems of poor quality and formality of practical activities. The main reason is that the research on management innovation lags behind the actual teaching needs. The author investigates and analyzes the existing management model of Applied Undergraduate Colleges and universities in Shaanxi Province. In order to solve the existing problems, it is proposed to refine specialty classification, strengthen specialty classification practice and innovate the diversified management of graduation design (Thesis) form in the information environment. Continuously improve the information management level of graduation project (Thesis) and improve the quality of graduation project (Thesis).

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Teaching Effects of Case Teaching Method in the International Finance Course under the Background of Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the development of information technology and the advent of the Internet age, newly sprouted things such as short videos, news portals and learning platforms have gradually enriched the traditional teaching forms, in which the case teaching method is representative. Teachers can use modern teaching platforms and tools, such as Rain Classroom, TikTok and MOOC, to further enrich teaching cases and innovate the forms of case-based teaching. In the background of information technology, in order to study the teaching effects and influencing factors of innovative case teaching, this paper selects the course of International Finance for empirical analysis, and finds that colleges and universities should make efforts, both investment and research, in teachers’ training, teaching content, teaching facilities and so on. Only in this way, colleges and universities can improve the actual effects of case teaching mode and achieve the purpose of training practical skills for applied talents.

articleTitle: Research and practice of teaching mode of Big Data Acquisition and Cleaning based on OBE concept
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Big data acquisition and cleaning is the first part of big data processing, mainly to solve the problem of data sources and dirty data cleaning, to provide qualified data samples for the subsequent big data analysis and application. The course of Big data acquisition and cleaning is the first professional core course of data science and big data technology. The course has many difficult knowledge points, involves many tools and software, is closely integrated with the application, and requires the high practical ability of students, so it is impossible to achieve the teaching purpose by the traditional teaching method. In this paper, based on the OBE concept, the teaching content, teaching methods, and course assessment methods are reformed. From the point of view of the students’ learning effect and evaluation results, the course reform has achieved the desired effect.

articleTitle: Research on Cultivating Professionals for Language Service Industry in the Era of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Emerged as a technology-driven industry in the era of big data, the language service industry has rapidly blossomed into a robust type of worldwide service business and created a global market with huge demand for high-quality multilingual talents. The language service industry socially conditioned in the Chinese world, currently progressing to scenes of competing intellectual technologies, has been faced with unprecedented development opportunities, and cultivating language-service professionals has steadily gained in importance. This paper starts from a brief review of the definition of language services, expounds the status quo of language service industry in China, analyses the demand characteristics and market trends of this industry driven by big data, and points out practical strategies and viable countermeasures pertinent to talent cultivating, so as to provide refreshing insights into language-service talent cultivation in the context of digitalization.

articleTitle: SPSS Analysis of the National Identity of Chinese College Students
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Chinese college students’ national identity is analyzed based on a questionnaire survey and SPSS, showing that students are influenced by western thoughts and hence they reject rigid teaching styles in patriotism education. For this phenomenon, new teaching strategy is proposed which applies the PERMA model and new media technology in the colleges’ ideological and political courses improves students’ national identity.

articleTitle: Research on the construction of interactive hybrid teaching mode based on mobile intelligent link technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In recent years, the network teaching platform of college classroom based on mobile intelligent connection technology has emerged, which has promoted the reform of education supply mode and teaching method. Based on the investigation of online learning tools and learning time of contemporary college students, this paper studies and establishes a new course teaching method suitable for application-oriented colleges in the Internet era. Relying on mobile intelligent learning platform, it combines interactive and mixed different teaching methods. This paper explores the reasonable construction of interactive and mixed teaching mode between intelligent teaching platform and offline teaching in professional courses in colleges and universities based on new media, cloud computing and big data technology, and puts forward personal opinions on the construction of interactive and mixed course mode in colleges and universities based on mobile intelligent connection technology.

articleTitle: The Exploration of the Teaching Effects of Behavioral Finance Course Based on the PAD Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the advent of the Internet era, the innovative teaching mode of presentation-assimilation-discussion (PAD) classroom has also experienced great development. Also, the use of the PAD platform, such as Duifenyi, provides new ideas, new methods as well as new functions for traditional teaching. This paper takes the course of Behavioral Finance as an example to carry out the teaching design of the PAD mode with the help of the online platform. This paper empirically tests the teaching effects of PAD mode based on the comparison of the control class and the experimental class, which proves that PAD classroom can effectively improve students’ understanding level and academic performance. This finding provides valuable experience for the other financial courses teaching.

articleTitle: The Influence of Online Teaching in Undergraduate Colleges and Universities on Teaching Effect
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the scope of online teaching promotion in undergraduate colleges and universities, the influence of online teaching in undergraduate colleges and universities on teaching effect is gradually increasing. This paper reveals that online teaching activities of undergraduate colleges and universities have significant impacts on teaching effect by the aid of teachers’ online teaching ability, students’ online learning literacy, colleges and universities’ online teaching management mode, online teaching media equipment, and external contexts. This paper also reveals that the action mechanism of these factors. Finally, countermeasures and suggestions to improve the effect of online teaching in undergraduate colleges and universities are proposed, including enhancing teachers’ online teaching ability, improving students’ online self-learning literacy, improving the management level of online teaching in colleges and universities, and improving the equipment of online teaching media.

articleTitle: Data Security in Enterprise Management Under Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With more and more data and information in people's life and work, the digital economy is growing explosively. The rapidly developing digital economy relies on various advanced technologies to serve us, such as Internet of things technology, big data technology and artificial intelligence technology. Data security in enterprise management under big data technology is also one of the important contents that people pay attention to. Depending on advanced science and technology can greatly improve the data security of enterprise management.

articleTitle: Research on Cluster Analysis of Ideological and Political Education Path of College Students Based on Precise Supply and Experimental Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The precise supply of ideological and political education is an urgent requirement to meet the diversified needs of college students in the new era. In this paper, the cluster analysis method is adopted to classify many data points with "similar" characteristics into the same category, we apply K-means for clustering students into 5 clusters so as to implement precise supply. We also apply Linear Regression to describe the relationship among the variables. Linear regression is a regression analysis that mines the variables that have inluence on the dependent variable which reprensents precise supply in our problem. In our paper, we take advantage of Least square method for fitting a line. The idea of precise supply should run through the whole process of ideological and political education for college students. It is necessary to improve the refined level of ideological and political education for college students in the new era from the aspects of finding out the ideological base of college students, studying the educational content, innovating the educational methods and building up excellent teams.

articleTitle: Using Hawgent to develop dynamic mathematics teaching materials
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Discrete function is a common form of function expression and has important applications in the field of engineering technology. In order to improve students’ understanding of discrete functions, it is necessary to use dynamic and graphical methods to interpret discrete functions. This research uses Hawgent dynamic mathematics software to develop teaching materials for calculating geometric summation. Taking two classes in Guilin, Guangxi as the experimental objects, the students’ scores were analyzed through SPSS22.0 software. The results of the study showed that the class performance of the students in the experimental class was more active than the classmates in the control class, and their grades improved a lot. It shows that dynamic mathematics technology helps to strengthen students’ interest in learning, and strengthens the effect of combining engineering technology with mathematical knowledge. Teachers should make more use of dynamic mathematics technology to develop mathematics textbook materials.

articleTitle: Exploration and Practice of Online-Offline Mixed Teaching Mode Based on Internet + Intelligent Technology in Post- epidemic Period : — Take the course of phytogeography as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The Internet plus intelligent technology online teaching has become an important development direction of higher education in the world since the period of COVID-19 and it will continue in the post-epidemic period for its compensations for the deficiencies of traditional classroom teaching. Based on the internet plus intelligent technology such as the teaching platform Tencent Classroom and Apps such as QQ or Wechat, the exploration and practice of online and offline mixed teaching mode was carried by taking the phytogeography teaching as an example. This paper put forward the measures of the three aspects of building high-quality network resources, designing classroom teaching content and optimizing evaluation system to implement the online and offline mixed teaching mode of plant geography. It showed a good overall teaching and learning effect by using teaching platform for online teaching and QQ group or wechat group as assisting communication and interaction for online or offline learning. The results could provide some references for the application of the online and offline mixed teaching mode in phytogeography teaching.

articleTitle: Research on the cultivation of professional system ability in Computer Education
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Computer majors have high requirements for students' practical ability, but now many colleges and universities prefer theoretical teaching when training computer majors, and the curriculum arrangement is not clear, resulting in students' lack of computer professional system ability. At present, the embedded system, mobile computing system, parallel computing system and other new computing systems in the computer system are developing rapidly. When cultivating computer talents, colleges and universities should ensure that students understand and deeply understand the overall computer system, master the correlation and logical level of various software or hardware parts in the computing system, and have the ability to develop and build computer systems. This paper analyzes the development characteristics of today’s computer technology, probes into the problems in cultivating computer talents in Colleges and universities, and finally explains in detail how to use technical ways to cultivate computer professional system ability, so that students can independently develop a computer system including CPU, operating system and compiler.

articleTitle: An Exploratory study on the application of artificial intelligence technology in the teaching of Japanese language in university
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the global development of AI technology, governments around the world have issued white papers in the hope of applying AI technology to the field of education. The question of how artificial intelligence can facilitate language learning has drawn the attention of the global AI industry and the education industry. The question of how to effectively enable AI to promote education is also an urgent issue for the education and computer industries to address. This paper focuses on the feasibility of implementing key technologies such as big data technology, virtual reality, human-computer interaction, and intelligent assessment into several major courses of university Japanese language teaching by analyzing them. To help Japanese language educators effectively leverage artificial intelligence technology to drive effective progress for Japanese language learners, intending to trigger more productive teaching and learning reforms.

Author Keywords: Teaching Japanese as a Foreign Language

articleTitle: Research on Solving Functional Zero Problem : Based on Polya's Problem-solving Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Functional zero problem has always been the focus and difficulty in the National College Entrance Exam mathematics. Since functional zero problem involves a large amount of knowledge and operation, senior students often spend a lot of time and energy in solving the problem, but they have little or no effect. Therefore, it is significant to carry out research on solving functional zero problem. Polya, a famous American mathematics educator, put forward Polya’s problem-solving theory in the long-term practice of mathematics education. Its core content is a "How to solve the problem table". Polya’s problem-solving theory is conducive to the formation of effective problem-solving ideas for the solution of problems. In view of this, this research takes Polya’s problem-solving theory as the theoretical basis and tries to apply Polya’s problem-solving theory to solve functional zero problem: step one, understand the problem; step two, devise a plan; step three, carry out the plan; step four, look back.

articleTitle: The relationship between big data and the training of engineering management professionals
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the rapid development of social technology, big data has become a wind vane leading the development of all walks of life. Engineering management is a level discipline under the level of management science and engineering. As an important applied discipline in the field of management, this discipline aims to cultivate all-round talents suitable for the future development of the engineering field. The logical architecture of big data in the engineering management system is mainly divided into four parts: four stages: data collection, data preprocessing, data analysis and data application. Therefore, the concept of big data must be established in engineering management as one of the purposes of cultivation. This paper analyzes the application of big data development in the training of engineering management professionals, and makes some reasonable suggestions according to practical problems.

articleTitle: Practice of Blended Teaching Mode on Teachermate Platform Combining Production-oriented Approach and Ideological and Political Construction : Take College English Cultural Curriculum as An Example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the teaching reform of College English, lots of trendy teaching modes are used. Blended teaching mode, which reforms traditional in-class teaching, satisfies the educational need in cultural curriculum and its related learning platforms diversify teacher-student interaction. Therefore, this article explores educational process through three stages of “before class, in class and after class” with the help of Teachermate learning platform under the practice of blended teaching, taking college English cultural curriculum which is guided by production-oriented approach and the ideological and political construction as an example. With the combination of available teaching mode and localized teaching theory, the teacher can master learning conditions of students and arrange educational process reasonably. After a semester of education, students have more enthusiasm to learn English course and know the way to promote Chinese culture.

articleTitle: Information Technology and Cultural Education Model Based on World Heritage Site Kulangsu
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the localization of STEM education, this research tried to integrate interdisciplinary knowledge based on local characteristics and culture. We designed and developed a C-STEAM curriculum with the cultural background of Kulangsu, a World Heritage Site, to allow students to perceive culture from the perspective of engineering disciplines and develop their creative thinking and comprehensive Internet application skills. This curriculum integrates the fields of art history, architecture and gardening, programming, as well as engineering design. Using Kulangsu as a model, we also developed a sandbox teaching aid that included 150 architectural puzzles, Arduino boards, and expandable sensors. In the teaching practice, students' creative thinking and comprehensive application skills were statistically analyzed. The teaching effectiveness was comprehensively evaluated by having students use the IoT mindset to solve problems.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Card-type Intelligent Teaching System Based on Combination of Online and Offline
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper expounds the problems of students’ learning after class in vocational colleges, and points out the importance of teaching auxiliary equipment. In order to effectively improve the teaching quality and enhance students’ enthusiasm for learning after class, the research team puts forward the Card-type Intelligent Teaching System (CITS). CITS includes playing-cards (offline) and website (online). CITS was applied to teaching experiments. The experimental results show that CITS effectively improved students’ learning efficiency (97.1%). In the cultivation of good learning habits, CITS was widely recognized (76.5%). Due to the learning function of mutual questioning, CITS promoted students’ learning cooperation (88.2%) and enhanced the friendship between students.

articleTitle: Research on Color Image of Interactive Interface of Medical and Health APP
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
