abstract: This article analyzes the image of the color of the medical and health APP interface. Firstly, 13 samples are selected according to the current ranking of downloads of medical and health apps in the market, and the sample colors are extracted by the K-means clustering method and implanted into the interface model; secondly, the color image perceptual vocabulary is obtained by the multi-dimensional scaling analysis and the systematic clustering method; finally, combining the Semantic Differential Method and the five-level Likert scale, the representative samples are scored by imagery words to obtain the color image perception data, and the imagery perception scatter diagram is established to quantify the user’s perceptual perception into intuitive data. By analyzing the data, we can get the tendency and characteristics of the color scheme of the medical and health APP interface, as well as the relationship between them and the imagery words, to provide theoretical and methodological guidance for the color design of medical and health APP interface and better meet the perceptual needs of users.

articleTitle: Research on Restructuring Path of Children’s Digital Publishing Supply and Demand Chain
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the era of rapid development of intelligent technology, the children’s digital publishing industry is facing a disruptive change, and this change may be realized through the reconstruction of the supply and demand chain. The value power of source content creation and the ability to gather users have been deconstructed. The increase in the amount of content requires platform institutions to have a more professional content operation system. The convenience of payment technology has greatly increased the digital content payment rate of users of children’s digital products. A development model of the supply and demand chain of children’s digital publishing with more innovative flexibility and enabling effects.

articleTitle: Reformation and Exploration of Practical Teaching in New Generation of Information Technology Related Majors Based on Online Practice Teaching Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Under the background of the integration of science and education, to meet the needs of a new generation of information technology-related majors innovative practice teaching demand for diversified experimental environments and experimental teaching resources, an online practice teaching platform based on Kubernetes was planned and constructed, and a platform is provided for teachers to convert scientific research achievements into teaching materials relying on the online practice teaching platform. It also provides students with large-scale distributed experimental resources allocated according to their needs. The online practice teaching platform adopts a distributed architecture deployment, and uses advanced container orchestration technology to construct a student’s experimental environment. Through the use of the online practical teaching platform, the level of practical teaching management has been improved, and the scientific, humanized and intelligent management of practical teaching has been realized.

articleTitle: The Application of Digital Media Art in Art Museum Public Education Based on Human-Computer Interaction Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: At present, the country’s attention to culture and social life has increased, and the construction of art galleries and art galleries in different forms and properties in various regions has developed rapidly. As one of the main functions of art galleries and art galleries, public art education has become a hot topic. With the development of digital media technology, digital media technology has been introduced into the public education of art museums, such as 3D holographic projection technology, which can vividly display works in front of people. This article focuses on the application of digital media art in art museum public education based on human-computer interaction technology. After analyzing the problems of art museum public education, the questionnaire survey method is used to analyze the actual situation of the application of digital media art in art museum public education. According to the survey results, digital media are frequently used in art museum exhibitions, with more than 40% of them frequently used. Then, the innovative suggestions for art museum public education mainly focus on interactive mode, and the use of digital media art should not be put the cart before the horse.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Teaching Innovation in Secondary Vocational Schools Based on CDIO : —Take "Single-Chip Microcomputer Principles and Applications" as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Information technology has been widely used in all walks of life, and the cultivation of computer application ability of secondary vocational students is increasingly important. But the teaching model of computer courses in most secondary vocational schools is outdated, it seriously affects the quality of teaching and is not conducive to cultivating practical talents. Under the background of the CDIO concept, this article introduces the PBL teaching model to carry out the innovation of the single-chip microcomputer course teaching, and builds a complete and project-oriented teaching model. While improving the teaching quality and the student learning quality, it can also provide references and suggestions for the reform of other courses.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Network Technology in Study Management of Overseas Students in China
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the continuous development of computer network technology, its application in learning and education management also occupies an important position. With the advent of the information age, overseas students from all over the world feel the connotation of Chinese cultural and educational knowledge. More and more overseas students choose to study in China. The rational use of computer network technology can improve the efficiency and ability of overseas students' learning management. Moreover, as the epidemic situation in China is normal now, most of the teaching can only be done through the network, so the computer network technology is more and more widely used in the teaching management of international students. Therefore, we should actively explore the optimization and transformation of the study management and application of international students, and analyze and explore its application, so as to further promote the improvement of the study level of international students and the promotion of teaching management.

articleTitle: Study on Harmful Information Regulation of Cyberspace From Perspective of Critical Discourse Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Cyberspace has been full of harmful information and does great harm. Using discourse analysis technology can identify and locate bad information quickly and effectively in cyberspace, and take corresponding measures according to different levels and standards of threats, especially shielding radical and extreme discourse and information within a controlled range to create a safe cyberspace ecology. This paper will analyze the harmful information of cyberspace with the theory of critical discourse analysis, and try to put forward feasible regulatory path to serve the overall national security.

articleTitle: Studies on International Discourse Construction of Chinese Literary Classics with the Approach of Computer-assisted Translation
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: To show more of the Chinese literary classics to the outside world, boost their influences and improve speech rights of Chinese nation in the new era, this dissertation, with the method of computer-assisted translation (CAT), concentrates on international discourse construction of Chinese literary classics by analyzing successful translation cases of Chinese literary classics as well as their common reasons for translation success, and strategies of discourse construction of Chinese Literary Classics. The study finds out scholars are dedicating to publicizing Chinese culture for long, that studies on medio-translatology have been paid much attention since 2015 in China, that The Analects of Confucius , Lv Xun's works, Shih Chi, Book of Poetry etc. are some successful translation cases we can refer to; that more elements like political background, cultural belief, potential readers' needs should be covered while choosing a source text and that some strategies of discourse construction are recommended.

articleTitle: An Effective Online Course with the Application of Multimedia – a Case Study of English Public Speaking Course
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Online teaching has been prevalent in many courses especially during the Covid-19 pandemic. Although a number of concerns have been raised towards the effectiveness of this teaching mode particularly for those skill-based learning classes, such worries can be solved in a large extent by using multimedia throughout the pedagogy. This article takes the course of English public speaking as an example where the constructivism theory was adopted with the assistance of multimedia devices to illustrate the above idea, indicating that the multimedia-applied online-teaching method can be further engaged in other secondary language learning courses.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Virtual Technology in modern sports training
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: From the current social situation, computer virtual technology has a certain application in many fields and has attracted the attention of many experts and scholars studying computer big data technology. There are also many experts and scholars who have done research in big data computer technology and have linked computer virtual technology with modern sports training. They also further learned of the specific application ideas of computer virtual technology in modern sports training. Through the significance and characteristics of computer virtual technology, the difficulties encountered in modern sports training. At the same time, this article researches the application and development of computer virtual technology in modern sports training. Computer virtual technology can also better enrich the training form of modern sports, and can also lay the foundation for the development of modern sports training.

articleTitle: Construction of flipped classroom teaching model based on mobile learning platform
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the continuous development of information technology and the increasing popularity of mobile terminal equipment, mobile learning has become a new form of college students’ course learning, an effective supplementary means to flip the classroom, and effectively solved various problems faced by economics teaching under the background of educational informationization. In this paper, the advantages of mobile terminal, mobile learning platform and flipped classroom teaching model are combined, including pre-class knowledge transfer, knowledge internalization in class and after-class knowledge consolidation three stages based on mobile learning platform flipped classroom teaching model, which lays a foundation for the application of the new teaching model in the course of Western Economics.

articleTitle: Research on the Development of Vocational Education in China from the Perspective of Niche
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Based on the environmental characteristics of the development of the vocational education in China, this paper introduces niche theory to define and define the niche of vocational education. According to the internal and external environmental factors and interaction process of vocational education, this paper constructs a golden diamond matching model for the interaction between the vocational education and the environment. On this basis, this study distributed 300 questionnaires and verifies the relevant data with SPSS18. The results show that this model is more scientific and feasible.

articleTitle: Promoting English Learners’ Intercultural Competence through Technology-enhanced Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Intercultural Competence has been regarded as an essential aspect of second language teaching and learning in recent decades and technology-enhanced model has been strongly advocated to promote learners’ Intercultural Competence. The technology-enhanced model has some distinctive benefits as well as potential challenges. The study explores the effectiveness of using technology-enhanced approach, which was based on a Web-based system, Teachermate Platform, to promote English learners’ IC ina university from China. 45 learners who learned English as a foreign language involved in this study. The qualitative and quantitative methods were used to analyze the data. Basing on the theoretical framework of IC and a questionnaire, the analysis of the data suggests that this teaching design can be effective for helping learners to increase multicultural knowledge, develop a more open mind and objective attitude towards people and cultures in the globe and acquire more sensible intercultural skills. Overall, the students’ perceptions on the teaching intervention are positive.

articleTitle: The Application and Practice of Computer Technology in Piano Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Computer technology has been widely applied in the piano course teaching in universities. Compared with the traditional piano course teaching, the effect of computer technology is mainly used in MIDI music technology, drawing software and visual piano performance analysis. By establishing the MIDI demonstration library, it can effectively strengthen students 'independent learning efficiency, and the integration of music theory and its teaching methods and computer technology can stimulate students' creation consciousness.

articleTitle: The Construction of College English Teaching Model Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The five most representative systems, including PEG, IEA, Y, BETSY, and E-rater, have been applied abroad, while the automatic composition scoring system developed for language learners has been applied. Among them, ICALL, an intelligent computer-assisted language teaching system mainly with sentence automatic analysis technology, has entered the field of education and teaching and changed the direction of language teaching in colleges and universities. From the "deep learning" algorithm to the specific application of artificial technology, the current English teaching system has been improved.

articleTitle: Research of Effective Structural Engineering Course Teaching Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Summarizing and analysing the inherent nature of structural engineering intelligent teaching, the effective method of intelligent teaching is proposed. Teaching effectiveness with intellectualization is greatly improved. After the analysis of the status of students, the inherent nature and characteristics of teaching are pointed out. Based on the use of complex features of old and new knowledge with artificial intelligence method, the progress and logic and mental model of the traditional mode of engineering course teaching on theory and practice are probed into. Computer program has been used to carry out engineering structure design and engineering course teaching and information editing.

articleTitle: Image Inpainting Based on Self-attention and Gated Convolution
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Recently, significant progress has been made in the challenging task of image inpainting based on deep learning methods. These methods can produce visually sound image structure and texture but generally result in distorted or blurred surfaces. It is mainly due to the inefficiency of convolutional neural networks in replicating spatial location information from a distance. We propose a novel Image inpainting model, named IISAGC (Image Inpainting based on Self-Attention Gated Convolution), which combines the self-attention and Gated Convolution mechanisms. This method can combine novel image structures with explicit use of the surrounding image features and remote pixel relations as references to make better predictions during network training. The model is a two-stage generation network based on a U-Net structure, which can process missing images in any position. Qualitatively and quantitatively, compared datasets including faces (CelebA), textures (DTD), Google Street View, Paris Street View show that our proposed method can obtain high-quality visual inpainting results.

articleTitle: Self-talk improves sports performance: an intervention study for children based on experimental and mathematical statistics analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Self-talk is a widely used self-regulation strategy in sport psychology, but it is unclear whether children can benefit from self-talk strategy. The present study (2 × 3 design) examined whether low-grade children in primary school can benefit from self-talk intervention. 88 students (47 males, 41 females, Mage = 7.5 years old) were randomly divided into three groups for elbow plank task, the: motivational self-talk group (n = 30), instructional self-talk group (n = 29) and control group (n = 29). One-way ANOVA revealed that the percentage of improvement in the motivational self-talk group was significantly higher than the instructional self-talk group and the control group while there was no difference between the latter two groups. Additionally, repeated measures ANOVA revealed a significant trial by group interaction effect in the willingness to continue elbow plank. Pairwise comparisons revealed that motivational self-talk group improved whereas performance of the other two groups did not change significantly. Motivational self-talk is more effective for young children.

articleTitle: A study on the modern Educational Technology based on Data Engineering Promoting College Students’ employment satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: At present, the employment situation of college students was very severe, with slow employment, lazy employment and difficult employment, and the current trend has became more and more intense. The employment problem of college students has attracted widespread attention from the society. How to promote the employment of college students has become an urgent problem in social development. This paper firstly analyzes the employment consciousness of college students, studies the preparation employment ability, and finally expounds the relationship between employment satisfaction, employment consciousness and employment ability preparation. At the same time, It is suggested that colleges and universities establish data models, build engineering thinking and strengthen the information construction of graduate employment based on data investigation. Moreover, colleges and universities can release employment and recruitment information timely through various modern technology information platforms, so as to truly realize the modern educational management. it is hoped to bring reference and help to the majority college educators so that the graduates can be correctly guide to obtain high-quality employment.

articleTitle: Research on the application of establishing VR technology in dance communication
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the development of information technology, VR technology has been applied in real estate development, entertainment games, handicraft production and other fields. At the same time, VR technology has also promoted the development of education and teaching. The emergence of this emerging technology has improved the teaching efficiency and teaching quality. VR technology is also called virtual reality technology. Its main feature is the combination of multimedia technology, pictures and video, sensors and other related technologies and application to education and teaching, so as to improve students’ learning ability. For the application of VR technology in dance communication, we present our own insights and analyze the future VR technology.

articleTitle: Dynamic Monitoring of University Discipline Construction Performance Based on Two-dimensional Input-Output Model and Least Squares Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Universities are academic organisations built by disciplines, and the level of discipline construction is an important basis to reflect the strength of universities. Discipline performance management is a dynamic and cyclical process. In order to study the performance of discipline construction, a two-dimensional input-output model is established to monitor the process of discipline construction in universities, and a least squares model is established to monitor the result of subject construction. Using these two models, we carried out a comprehensive study on the performance process and results of discipline construction performance in the selected 11 universities. It provides a certain references for the sustainable development of discipline construction.

articleTitle: The Study of Media Literacy Education System for Tourism Practitioners in the Context of Rural Revitalization Strategy Based on the Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: As a technology productivity tools, network skills have become the essential ability of rural tourism practitioners. This paper analyses the network media literacy education of rural tourism practitioners by the interviews with dozens of senior tourism practitioners. Through content analysis, the paper extracts the core elements, including demand, goal, participants, education content, etc., and a media literacy education system for rural tourism practitioners has been established. Research shows that rural tourism media literacy is not only the basic skill guarantee for practical activities, but also can promote the communication and innovation of rural culture, protect the unique intangible cultural heritage, and improve the well-being and harvest of residents. This study provides new insights and experience for the implementation of rural revitalization strategy based on the integration of tourism and Internet.

articleTitle: Research on campus sports event education in higher vocational colleges in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, under the information background
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the change of The Times, people’s life has undergone great changes, sufficient material wealth, but the work pressure is getting bigger and bigger, which makes modern people must have a strong constitution. In fact, to improve the physical quality of the Chinese people on the whole, we need to do a good job in sports, which can not only exercise, but also learn knowledge in sports. Therefore, this article using Excell2016 software and spssl6.0 statistical software to analyze the statistical data, study the value of school sports education, and the current situation of Guangdong big bay area campus sports event education, and on the basis to explore the new period of Guangdong big bay area vocational school sports events new path of education has positive significance.

Author Keywords: The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area

articleTitle: Information Statistical Analysis on the Effect of Anxiety Level on College Procrastinators and Non-procrastinators on Academic Grades
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to examine the relationship between procrastination and anxiety based on subjects’ academic grades. A large amount of research has shown how stress works as a causation and an outcome of procrastination, but rare information about non-procrastinators. Additionally, whether academic grades affect the relationship between stress and procrastination was not found. In this study, the data of Westside Test Anxiety Scale Validation, Procrastination Scale, and the demographic questionnaire were collected and analyzed with statistical analysis (correlation, regression, and t-test) to investigate the effect of anxiety level on procrastinators and non-procrastinators. Among a mixed population of college students, neither the major purpose of correlation nor logistic regression was found significant. However, there was a significant result found in the statistical analysis of the t-test that non-procrastinators experience more anxiety than procrastinators which was close to the hypothesis that procrastination negatively correlates with anxiety (besides it was not based on GPA).

articleTitle: A study of attention bias differences between overweight and normal weight female college students based on BMI, WHR, waist circumference and hip circumference
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In today's society, obesity has become an increasingly serious topic. Obesity not only brings about health problems, but also has a certain psychological impact. Especially for women who love beauty. Obesity is a key factor that has a huge impact on their normal life. Obese women have negative concerns about their body shape, tend to have negative emotions, and even show some pathological characteristics, which can be reflected by attention bias. This study screened 26 overweight female college students (BMIŁ25; BMI, Body Mass Index) as experimental group and 26 normal weight female college students (18.5flBMI<25) as control group. Experimental materials include body fat, thin body images and neutral pictures, This study used questionnaire to detect point detection paradigm and overweight female college students attention to fat shape and thin body bias and characteristics. The results of this study showed that: (1) In terms of response time, the main effect of cue validity was significant, the cue validity was greater than the cue invalidity, and there was inhibition of return, while other effects were not significant; (2) BMI and waist circumference of the experimental group had no significant correlation with the reaction time of the subjects; there was a positive correlation between WHR and the effectiveness of the thin body cues; in other cases, no significant correlation between WHR and response time; hip circumference was negatively correlated with response time in all six conditions. Conclusions: There was no significant difference between overweight female college students and normal weight female college students in attention bias to body shape, and there was inhibition of return in both groups. Overweight female college students did not have difficulty in dissociating attention from fat body type cues.

articleTitle: A cross-modal multimedia retrieval method based on semi-supervised learning and category information alignment
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, traditional unimodal media information retrieval can hardly meet users’ retrieval needs for different data, therefore, cross-modal information retrieval is the key to breakthrough and solve the problem, however, the difficult problem faced by cross-modal information retrieval is how to effectively and accurately semantically match heterogeneous data and compare media objects of different modalities in different feature spaces. To address the difficult problem of cross-modal information retrieval, this paper proposes a cross-modal multimedia retrieval method with semi-supervised learning and category information alignment, which aligns different modal information by introducing category information to minimize the discriminative loss in the common representation space and the loss among individual modalities, and then constructs a homogeneous high-level semantic space based on the underlying feature space of different modal objects, and applies the semi-supervised learning method to cross-media retrieval. The semi-supervised learning method is applied to cross-media retrieval to achieve semantic matching of multimedia objects of different modalities. Finally, by comparing this method with traditional cross-media retrieval methods, the experimental results show that this method has greatly improved the accuracy of retrieval results compared with traditional cross-media retrieval techniques.

articleTitle: Construction of University Political Teaching System Based on Probabilistic Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The development of computer technology has made intelligence a way to solve problems in many industries. There are some problems in political teaching in colleges and universities, and colleges and universities urgently need to build an ecological political teaching system, and the conceptual neuron network model can be a means of realization. A conceptual neuron network is a branch of artificial intelligence technology that can help the system perform accurate discriminant analysis. This article takes the current situation of ideological and political education in colleges and universities as the research background, and tries to establish an artificial intelligence network research learning platform based on the depth of college political culture. This article introduces the probabilistic neural network, and uses the neural network to build a system that can reflect the defects of school politics teaching and propose solutions to the defects. Finally, it is verified by MATLAB that the artificial intelligence prediction based on the probabilistic neural network has good convergence and fault tolerance. And data processing capabilities. The construction of this system allows universities to clearly observe the parts of political education that need to be strengthened through data, which is conducive to the improvement of political education.

articleTitle: EBS-Based Key Management Scheme in Heterogeneous Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of high cost and poor scalability of the key distribution scheme for heterogeneous sensor networks, a hierarchical key management scheme based on EBS is proposed. In this scheme, the sensor nodes are divided into three layers, the common node layer, the cluster head node layer, and the sink layer. The authentication of the public keys between the sink nodes and the base station use a certificate and a non-multiple signature mechanism. And the authenticated sink node uses an EBS key management scheme based on the combination theory to generate and distribute keys for the cluster head node. Performance analysis shows that this scheme reduces the storage and calculation overhead of key management to a certain extent, and improves the security and scalability of the network.

articleTitle: Influence of Social Short Videos on Social Capital of College Students Based on Experimental Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Tik Tok app was a product of the mobile Internet era, which had similarities and differences with typical SNS. College students’ perception and acceptance of Tik Tok had certain sensitivity, and their use will also have an impact on college students’ life. In this paper, Tik Tok was connected with social capital and college students’ adaptation, so as to broaden the research scope of media social capital, understand the specific use of the mobile short videos by college students and the adaptability of the media environment, and then discuss the influence of social apps of short videos on college students’ social capital. The results showed that in the dimension of "use intensity", the variables that were significantly positively correlated with bridging social capital were "dependence" and "number of updated original works", while "degree of dependence" was very effective in predicting bonded social capital. In the dimension of "use motivation", the variables "information acquisition motivation", "interpersonal communication motivation" and "self-presentation motivation" were both significantly positively correlated with bridging and bonded social capital.

articleTitle: College English Teachers’ Roles in Fostering Learner Autonomy in the Context of Blended Learning - An Empirical Research from the Perspective of Students based on SPSS 25.0
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Previous research has revealed that learner autonomy depends on teachers’ roles. Yet, College English teachers’ roles in fostering learner autonomy in blended learning context remains understudied. The present research seeks to investigate the ideals and realities of College English teachers’ roles in promoting learner autonomy in blended learning classes. Quantitative research method is adopted in the study. Two questionnaires with Likert-scale were administered to 100 undergraduate students. The collected data were processed in SPSS 25.0. Descriptive analyses of the collected data were carried out to reveal students’ expectations of teachers’ roles and teachers’ real practices while a paired-samples t-test was conducted to figure out whether there is a significant difference between students’ expectations and teachers’ real practices. The findings reveal that, in the blended learning context, teachers are expected to play diverse roles in fostering students’ learning autonomy, and the roles of teachers that students expect most are a resource provider, counselor and techno-literate person. However, teachers as a assessor, facilitator and guide are much less expected by students. Teachers’ real practices mostly show no conformity with students’ expectations, which indicates that teachers fail to meet the need of students. Suggestions are made to foster students’ autonomy in the blended learning context.

articleTitle: Design of Interactive Display of Ancient Chinese Musical Dances Based on Somatosensory Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: "Xishi’s Clogs" is a famous ancient Chinese musical dance. In this paper, we present the design procedure of interactive display of "Xishi’s Clogs", in which dancer’s posture and gesture are recognized by Kinect. Upon recognition, corresponding ink-paintings created by Processing are generated and projected, which interact with the dancer on the real stage to create a digital and interactive expression of Chinese musical dance. Our new approach takes the application of somatosensory technology to the ancient Chinese musical dance performance and provides many possibilities for digitalized display of traditional Chinese culture.

articleTitle: Application on Intelligent Prediction of Agricultural GDP in Zhejiang Province Based on ARIMAX Multivariate Time Series Data Analysis Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Agricultural output value is an essential indicator of Zhejiang’s economic resources. This study effectively predicts the gross value of Zhejiang’s agricultural production, studies its changing laws, and accurately predicts its growth trend. And this research is of great significance for ensuring the economic development of Zhejiang Province.Using the time series of the agricultural output value of Zhejiang Province from 1978 to 2016, this study takes the first-order difference to identify whether the data are static ones by unit root detection, and the autocorrelation and partial correlation function graphs are checked to determine the order and then the input. Comparing between the AIC and BIC information criteria of the variables, the optimal data model is selected for predictive analyses. This method can be applied to determine the factors that impose the most significant impact on the forecast of agricultural production value. By mining the original data, this study identifies the additional suitable items, thus boosting the prediction effect and improving accuracy.The model established in this study can deliver accurate prediction with comparatively high theoretical and practical value.

articleTitle: Research on Blended Teaching Model Under the Background of Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The Principle of Single-chip Computer is a comprehensive course with strong theory and practice, which is closely related to science and technology. Under the background of the continuous development of information technology, the traditional teaching model can not meet the information instruction environment and stimulate students’ interest. Therefore, the author puts forward a new blended teaching model suitable for the development of new technology. This model runs through the development process of actual projects and emphasizes student-centered learning. The implementation of the course content is completed through a blended learning model combining students’ online self-study and offline self-design. The characteristic of this model is to make full use of the resources of the network course platform to enable students to complete relatively simple project links independently, such as self-study of basic knowledge. In this way, the class hours saved can deepen the depth of offline practical teaching. This model has been implemented in four classes of two sessions in our school. The practice has proved that this teaching model effectively improves students’ learning autonomy and ability of engineering practice.

articleTitle: The transformation of teaching paradigm of Financial Management empowered by information technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the development of education modernization and artificial intelligence and other new technologies, the deep integration of information technology and education and teaching has created conditions for the transformation of teaching paradigm of financial Management. At present, the "financial management" course teaching information technology can assign a misunderstanding between the technology standard, function instead of myth and the main body the harm of alienation, in order to solve this problem, need to set up information technology can assign ecological position of classroom teaching, clarify information technology can assign a basic train of thought, carry out information technology can assign classroom teaching practice.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of SPOC Online and Offline Blended Teaching in Engineering Cost Specialty Course
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The research on blended teaching first arose in America. Since 2009, the related research on the theory and practice of blended teaching has shown an obvious growth trend in China. Blended teaching is a relatively broad concept, and SPOC is one of its most influential forms. Via constructing online and offline blended teaching mode, and using SPOC form to carry out practical research on teaching reform of engineering cost specialty course, and then summarizing and studying its laws, the problems of students’ low participation, insufficient deep learning, and weak applicability in traditional teaching can be tackled, which plays an innovative role in technology, curriculum structure design, and platform construction.

articleTitle: A Strategical Study on Cybersecurity Knowledge Dissemination for Teenager Based on Short Video Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the era of digital information, digital life has become an indispensable part of teenagers. The age of teenagers that get access to the internet is getting lower. With insufficient self-protection awareness, they are prone to be influenced by unhealthy information. This paper proposes that short video technology enjoys an advantage over traditional dissemination channels such as pictures and words. Short video technology contains large sets of data. Through data analysis and data processing, we can further analyze the feasibility of applying short video technology to promote cybersecurity knowledge for teenagers and appeals the society, schools and families to educate teenagers on safe use of the internet.

articleTitle: Basketball players’ competitive thinking mode based on simulation technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the current technology software cannot meet the needs of basketball players, the investigator used simulation technology to investigated the simulated competitive thinking of the national basketball team, in which they emphasize the need for competitive thinking simulation and the cooperative development model.The simulation sport thinking was summarized. There are advantages in many aspects, but traditional competitive thinking should still be the dominant training method." At the same time, the degree of similarity of the team’s competitive thinking model has different effects on team performance obvious to see. When the basketball team’s overall competitive thinking pattern is more similar, team performance is also more significant.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis of Apologies in Primary EFL Textbooks in China Based on Python
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This study attempts to explore the frequency, distribution, interpretation, and contextualization of speech act of apologies in primary EFL textbooks in China. We introduced Python as the text mining tool, since Python software aims to analysis the cooccurrence of the words, and be able to process large amounts of data, extending scripts to additional narratives and bigger samples, and interoperability, handling data that are structured differently with ease and efficiency. The linguistic forms of apologetic expressions are basically "sorry, excuse me, oh, and oops" with pure "an expression of an apology". The results show that the contexts are inclined to be homogeneous and simple within the settings of buying things and inviting to an activity. The contextualization, distribution and interpretation are interrelated. This study has implications for research on pragmatic knowledge in primary school textbook analysis, adaptation, and development.

articleTitle: Improvement of Online Game Anti-Cheat System based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the popularity of video games and the increase of game players, cheating has become more common. Thus, game operators have designed and applied various anti-cheating systems. However, they each has some problems, the most general of which is the lag of penalty. In this article, AI models will be applied to improve anti-cheating systems. The paper first discusses the existing anti-cheating systems and their drawbacks, referring to some relevant literature. After that, two main scenarios are proposed, and one of them is actually modeled, trained and tested. This part is mainly done with python coding and the help of YOLOv5 program. The model still has room for improvement, but it does have substantiated the feasibility of above schemes.

articleTitle: Digital evaluation of labor education in Colleges under big data(based on AHP)
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: As an important part of quality education, formulating a perfect labor education evaluation system will help to grasp the education orientation and continuously improve in the feedback. Combined with Big data analysis, this paper establishes the element model of College Students’ labor education. According to the model, three primary indicators, 10 secondary indicators and 21 indicator observation points are used to form the evaluation indicators of College Students’ labor education. The weight of the indexes can be calculated based on AHP. During the implementation of the evaluation index, the appropriate weight is selected according to the corresponding principles, which can be used as a system to evaluate the labor education of college students.

articleTitle: Investigation on the influence of WeChat public account on the teaching and learning of chemistry based on fuzzy search and mathematical statistics in large datasets
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the information age, the way people receive information is becoming more and more diversified. The popularity of WeChat provides a new way for information dissemination. WeChat public accounts have gradually been tapped to assist the teaching and learning of chemistry, which greatly promotes teaching and learning efficiency. By investigating the application of domestic WeChat official accounts in chemistry based on fuzzy search and mathematical statistics in large datasets, this article suggests that chemistry official accounts are currently mainly used in chemistry in universities, while there are very few applications in basic middle school chemistry fields. The application and research of public accounts in basic chemistry has a broad space for development.

articleTitle: Practical data analysis of PAD classroom in College English Intensive Reading Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: PAD classroom model is a classroom teaching model proposed and proved effective in practice in recent years. It is very suitable for a variety of courses. There are some problems in the current college English intensive reading course, resulting in the poor results of English teaching. English teachers need to seek new classroom teaching methods to stimulate classroom vitality and improve teaching quality. PAD classroom model is a good innovative way of English intensive reading course. This paper discusses the benefits of PAD classroom to college English teaching, selects 50 freshmen to experiment with traditional English teaching methods and PAD teaching methods, analyzes the changes brought by PAD teaching mode to students' English performance from the result data, and explores the changes that PAD can bring to today's teaching system. From the experimental data, PAD classroom can improve students' academic performance by about 10%, which is a very effective teaching method.

articleTitle: Is It New Poetry or the Emperor’s New Clothes? —An Overall Investigation of Three Poetry Collections and a Man-machine Poetry Competition of Artificial Intelligence Poet Xiaobing
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: "Microsoft Xiaobing" is an "artificial intelligence framework girl" created by the Microsoft R & D team to explore the "emotional computing framework". The poet Xiaobing is just one of her versatile identities. The poet Xiaobing was declared to have gained "emotion" and "creative power", and published three poetry collections, and she also won a grand victory in the "man-machine poetry competition". Looking deeply and comprehensively at these three poetry collections, they seem to be the three evolutions of the artificial intelligence poet on the way to obtain "emotion" and "creativity". In fact, it was an unsuccessful attempt followed by two concessions. The "algorithm" in Xiaobing’s system can’t calculate the poetry of New Poetry, Xiaobing’s "deep learning ability" can’t help "Plain People" become real poets, and the big data of modern poetry can’t stimulate Xiaobing’s creativity. Xiaobing now stays at the stage of word selection and sentence making, and can’t do anything about the layout of poetry. In the future, as long as Xiaobing cannot integrate into human life as an emotional individual, she will never be able to write creative New Poetry. Xiaobing can still write poems all the time, but they are only poems in the robot world. For humans, they are just "the emperor’s new clothes".

articleTitle: Study on compound consonant initials of Xiahe dialect based on speech aerodynamics
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In view of the unique characteristics of compound consonant initials in Xiahe dialect of Amdo dialect, this paper analyzes the pronunciation characteristics of compound consonant initials in syllables, the aerodynamic relationship between pre consonants and main consonants, and the peak of pronunciation airflow from the perspective of speech aerodynamics. In terms of the proportion of pronunciation duration, fricative and uvular as pre consonants occupy a dominant position, but they are opposite in compound consonants with nasal sounds as pre consonants; From the proportional relationship of average air velocity, it can be seen that the main consonant accounts for a larger proportion in the consonant initials; From the position of the peak air flow, except for the compound consonant whose pre consonant is voiced fricative, which is affected by vocal cord vibration, the peak air flow is at the position of the front consonant.

articleTitle: Thematic Progression from the Perspective of Machine Translation--A Case Study of Culture and Tourism Translation
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the early 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> century, Neural Machine Translation sprouted, inspired by linguistics, syntax and semantics, to dig into the connection between lines in multi-dimensions. This method has solved to some extent the inaccurate semantic translation of discourse. A discourse is composed of sentences based on one theme and progressed with Theme and Rheme. In the process of progression, the Theme and Rheme are not chosen randomly. Meanwhile, within a certain semantic frame, not all the sentences are close related with the theme. With the help of Neural Machine Translation research, this paper is aimed to analyze the effective progression of sentences in translated version within a certain semantic frame, and thus improving C-E translation, especially that of culture and tourism discourse.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Integrated Teaching Service Platform based on Feature Selection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: From the perspective of vocational skills training of students in higher vocational colleges, the "craftsman spirit" should be integrated into the vocational education practice teaching system, combined with the practice teaching system at all levels, to build the practice teaching service platform of mechanical and electrical integration professional group. Feature selection algorithm, this paper build a practical teaching system model, this study put forward the model validation and applied based on the decision tree, variance and feature selection is chi-square feature selection model, the experimental data from students’ learning practice of the survey results, through comparing the different results, it can be seen that the model put forward by the research of classification results have higher accuracy, Therefore, the fusion model designed in this study can improve the prediction accuracy, and is conducive to the design of electromechanical integration professional group teaching service platform, to promote the teaching reform process of higher vocational colleges.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Twin SVM Investment Evaluation Model for Listed Company
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With China’s market economy development, more and more investors focus on the analysis of listed company investment value, such as wisdom Agriculture sector, expecting to get good investment reference. Mixed listed companies financial status, coupled with that the stock market is a complex system, it is difficult to accurately predict the future trend. But a healthy company after a long-term stable operation is bound to achieve substantial profit. The fuzzy clustering method is constructed to screen financial indicators systems that affect listed companies’ investment value by avoiding risk philosophy for a sound investment. Financial data from the previous year of 963 companies were made as training samples to establish data mining model of the investment value in the listed companies based on Twin SVM, then predict the investment value of the companies in next year based on the data of this year. And based on the same test samples, traditional SVM and twin SVM were tested and compared. Results show that, our Twin SVM can obtain higher accuracy and faster calculation speed than ordinary SVM.

articleTitle: Statistical Algorithm model of College English Teaching based on artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces the principle, characteristics and practical application of artificial intelligence technology in college English teaching system. The system analysis platform of college English teaching is established by using artificial intelligence technology. The platform system is mainly divided into two parts. The first is the expert system model of teacher English assisted instruction based on expert system theory, which is combined with the generation and framework of data analysis. Artificial intelligence has been widely used in college English teaching. Artificial intelligence technology has the advantages of intelligence, data, networking, multimedia and so on. And teaching information collected through artificial intelligence technology mining at the same time, the data using statistical algorithms accurately grasp the students' learning status, to improve and enhance English software platform operation function, improve the operation speed, efficiently for statistical analysis of students' learning behavior, effectively will artificial intelligence technology and system construction depth fusion, promoting the development of digital college English teaching.

articleTitle: A Study on the Movie-going Situation of College Students and Urban Cultural Development in Xi’an Based on Lasswell's 5W Communication Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In an era featured with the rapid urban cultural transmission, this paper performs statistical analysis on the questionnaire data of Xi’ an college students’ movie-going situation through Lasswell's 5W (who, say what, in which channel, to whom, with what effect) communication model. Based on the statistical results of the questionnaire which was distributed through the Questionnaire Star APP, this paper mainly focus on the movie-going frequency, the production places, the appropriate ticket price and the channels for movie information obtaining delving into the current movie market of college students in Xi’an through several dimensions including control, content, media, audience, and effect analysis in which aspects of weak influence are excluded while key determinants retained. According to the principles of economics, the AD-AS model is developed to analyze and process the data. The short-term aggregate demands-aggregate supply model equation is: AD = F (p), SAS= F (P), AD = SAS. The equation of the long-term aggregate demand-aggregate supply model is: AD= f(p), LAS=Yf, AD=LAS=Yf. The balance between the social economy and aggregate demand as well as aggregate supply was also predicted through the income and price levels. In addition, by comprehensively considering the impact of the post-epidemic era, as a general background, this paper sorts out the direct and indirect effects of various factors on movie-going behaviors. In the end, it provides theoretical support and scientific reference for the prospects of the Xi’an film market and industrial development, meanwhile offering reliable case models for the empirical research of China’s film industry.

articleTitle: Research on the status of extra-curricular sports exercise platform in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area in the Information Era
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the development of information technology, The physical quality of higher vocational students in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area is still declining year by year on the basis of the diversified forms of extracurricular physical exercise year by year, therefore, This paper first investigates the status of extracurricular physical exercise platform in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, The statistical data were analyzed using Excell2016 software and spsslö.O statistical software, Research results (1) The main purpose of extracurricular physical exercise for higher vocational college students in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area is to strengthen their physical fitness and meet the examination standards, For 25% and 22%, respectively; (2) There are many types of higher vocational students in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, But the projects are more scattered; (3) Students’ extracurricular exercise time is mainly about afternoon exercise. Conclusion: There are three main factors affecting the extracurricular physical exercise of higher vocational college students in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, namely, lack of field equipment accounting for 80%, lack of exercise atmosphere, and economic conditions accounting for 58% and 42% respectively. Finally, on this basis, the optimization measures of the extracurricular physical exercise platform for higher vocational colleges in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area are put forward. It is of positive significance to explore the new educational path of sports activities in higher vocational colleges in Guangdong Greater Bay Area.

Author Keywords: The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area
